# 602.470. Diagnostic extensibility

Third-party/framework code có thể add:

custom event
custom metric

nhưng không phá runtime invariants.

Extension phải tuân:

limits

# 602.474. Application namespaces

# 602.475. Namespace validation

Tooling có thể reject event namespace collision.

# 602.476. Error namespace

Stable error codes cũng phải namespace.

---

# 602.477. Health namespace

Health checks có namespace tương tự.

# 602.478. Metric namespace

Metrics phải có application/module namespace để tránh collision.

# 602.479. Diagnostic API naming

# 602.480. Standard library placement

Core language compiler không cần implement toàn bộ diagnostics semantics.

metadata

# 602.481. Runtime placement

# 602.486. Symbol packaging

Release packaging nên giữ:

tách biệt.

Diagnostic metadata phải tham gia cache key khi nó ảnh hưởng binary.

# 602.488. Source unchanged

Nếu source và diagnostic build settings không đổi:

```

có thể reuse.

# 602.489. Build ID cache consistency

Cached binary phải giữ đúng build ID và diagnostic metadata.

---

# 602.490. ABI compatibility

Thay đổi diagnostic runtime ABI phải không âm thầm phá binary compatibility.

---

# 602.491. Runtime version

Artifact ghi:

```text

```

---

# 602.492. Compiler version

Artifact ghi:

```

# 602.493. Language version

Artifact ghi:

Artifact ghi:

# 602.495. Feature set

Artifact có thể ghi:

```

nhưng không dump toàn bộ compiler configuration nếu không cần.

# 602.496. Reproduction hints

Crash report có thể ghi:

optimization_level
debug_info_level
diagnostic_level
target_triple
```

---

# 602.497. No secret compiler flags

Build metadata phải redacted nếu compiler command chứa secret.

---

# 602.498. Command-line privacy

Runtime không tự ghi full process command line nếu platform policy cho rằng nó có thể chứa secret.

---

# 602.499. Environment privacy

Environment capture phải opt-in hoặc filtered.

---

# 602.500. Core invariant summary

BOOTSTRAP-602 phải bảo đảm:

```text
1. Logging is structured.
2. Disabled logging is near-zero cost.
3. Diagnostic memory is bounded.
4. Crash handling does not depend on normal application lifecycle.
5. Crash artifacts are versioned.
6. Stack/build identity are preserved.
7. Secrets are never emitted by default.
8. Config identity links to BOOTSTRAP-601.
9. State/checkpoint identity links to BOOTSTRAP-600.
10. No mandatory network service exists.
11. No mandatory third-party observability library exists.
12. Platform differences are isolated behind native backends.
13. Runtime can degrade gracefully.
14. Diagnostic failures do not normally crash the application.
15. Full observability can be stripped from minimal binaries.
```

---

# 602.501. Acceptance criteria

BOOTSTRAP-602 được coi là hoàn thành khi implementation có thể chứng minh:

### Security

### Performance

- [ ] disabled log near-zero cost;
- [ ] bounded memory;

### Integration

- [ ] BOOTSTRAP-600 checkpoint linkage;

# 602.502. Reference implementation layering

Implementation nên chia:

L1  Logging
L2  Context

58321.content:
# BOOTSTRAP-602 — NATIVE APPLICATION LOGGING, DIAGNOSTICS, CRASH REPORTING & OBSERVABILITY RUNTIME 5.0

## 602.0. Mục tiêu

BOOTSTRAP-602 định nghĩa hệ thống:

- structured logging;
- diagnostics;
- tracing;
- metrics;
- health/status;
- crash handling;
- panic/fatal error reporting;
- native stack capture;
- crash artifact;
- minidump/core-dump abstraction;
- symbolization;
- diagnostic context;
- correlation ID;
- bounded diagnostic buffers;
- crash-safe emergency logging;
- log rotation;
- diagnostic redaction;
- build/config/state correlation;
- local và production observability.

Mục tiêu chính:

> Một ứng dụng Axiom native phải có khả năng tự quan sát, tự chẩn đoán và tạo artifact đủ để điều tra lỗi mà không bắt buộc phụ thuộc vào một logging/telemetry framework bên thứ ba.

BOOTSTRAP-602 không biến Axiom runtime thành một monitoring platform.

Nó chỉ cung cấp **primitive native, deterministic và composable** để application hoặc framework phía trên xây dựng hệ thống observability.

---

# 602.1. Nguyên tắc thiết kế

Hệ thống phải tuân thủ:

1. native-first;
2. zero/minimal dependency;
3. deterministic;
4. bounded memory;
5. thread-safe;
6. low overhead;
7. crash-safe ở mức có thể;
8. không ghi secret;
9. không block application khi logging bình thường;
10. không làm crash handler phụ thuộc vào allocator;
11. không yêu cầu network;
12. không yêu cầu daemon bên ngoài;
13. có thể disable hoàn toàn;
14. có thể compile-time eliminate log;
15. hỗ trợ Unicode UTF-8;
16. giữ nguyên build identity;
17. liên kết được với configuration fingerprint;
18. liên kết được với application state/checkpoint;
19. có thể symbolicate sau khi process đã chết.

---

# 602.2. Phạm vi

BOOTSTRAP-602 gồm:

```text
Logging
Diagnostics
Tracing
Metrics
Health
Crash handling
Panic/fatal handling
Stack capture
Crash artifacts
Symbolization metadata
Diagnostic context
Correlation
Redaction
Log sinks
Crash-safe emergency buffer
Runtime diagnostics API
```

Không gồm:

```text
Remote monitoring service
Cloud backend
Third-party APM
Distributed database
Analytics platform
Log search server
Dashboard UI
```

Các thành phần này có thể được xây dựng ở layer cao hơn.

---

# 602.3. Kiến trúc tổng thể

Runtime:

```text
Application
    │
    ├── Log API
    ├── Trace API
    ├── Metric API
    ├── Health API
    └── Diagnostic API
             │
             ▼
      Diagnostic Runtime
             │
      ┌──────┼─────────┐
      ▼      ▼         ▼
   Logger  Tracer   Metrics
      │      │         │
      └──────┼─────────┘
             ▼
      Diagnostic Context
             │
      ┌──────┼──────────────┐
      ▼      ▼              ▼
    Console File       Emergency Ring
             │
             ▼
       Crash Runtime
             │
      ┌──────┼─────────┐
      ▼      ▼         ▼
   Stack   Metadata   State
   Dump    Build ID   Snapshot
             │
             ▼
       Crash Artifact
```

---

# 602.4. Logging model

Axiom logging không phải string-printing đơn thuần.

Primitive chính:

```text
log(level, event, fields...)
```

Ví dụ:

```axiom
log.info("server.started",
    port = 8080,
    workers = 8)
```

Không yêu cầu format string runtime nếu compiler có thể tạo structured event trực tiếp.

---

# 602.5. Log levels

Core levels:

```text
trace
debug
info
notice
warn
error
fatal
```

Semantic:

```text
trace  = extremely detailed execution information
debug  = developer diagnostics
info   = normal lifecycle information
notice = significant normal state transition
warn   = abnormal but recoverable condition
error  = operation failed
fatal  = process cannot safely continue
```

---

# 602.6. Compile-time log filtering

Compiler/runtime phải cho phép:

```axiom
@log_level("info")
```

Khi build production:

```text
trace → removed
debug → removed
info  → retained
notice → retained
warn → retained
error → retained
fatal → retained
```

Code bị loại bỏ phải càng gần zero-cost càng tốt.

Không được evaluate argument nếu statement đã bị compile-time eliminated.

Ví dụ:

```axiom
debug(expensive_diagnostic())
```

Nếu `debug` bị disable:

```text
expensive_diagnostic()
```

không được thực thi.

---

# 602.7. Runtime log filtering

Compile-time filtering không thay thế runtime filtering.

Có thể cấu hình:

```text
default = info
network = debug
database = warn
graphics = error
```

Lookup category phải có overhead thấp.

---

# 602.8. Event identity

Mỗi structured event có:

```text
event_id
category
level
timestamp
thread_id
process_id
message
fields
context
```

`event_id` nên là stable identifier.

Ví dụ:

```text
APP.SERVER.STARTED
APP.DB.CONNECTION_FAILED
APP.CONFIG.RELOAD_FAILED
```

---

# 602.9. Event ID stability

Event ID không được phụ thuộc vào source line.

Không dùng:

```text
file + line
```

làm primary identity.

Cho phép source line là metadata phụ.

---

# 602.10. Structured fields

Fields có typed value:

```text
bool
integer
float
string
bytes
enum
duration
timestamp
UUID
path
IP
error
object
array
```

Ví dụ:

```axiom
log.error("db.connect.failed",
    host = host,
    port = port,
    error = err)
```

---

# 602.11. Không ép string hóa sớm

Runtime không nên biến:

```text
integer
duration
UUID
error
```

thành string ngay khi event được tạo.

Structured representation phải được giữ càng lâu càng tốt.

Điều này cho phép sink quyết định format.

---

# 602.12. Log sinks

Core sink interface:

```axiom
trait LogSink {
    fn write(event: LogEvent) -> Result
    fn flush() -> Result
    fn close() -> Result
}
```

Các sink native:

```text
ConsoleSink
FileSink
MemorySink
NullSink
DebugSink
```

---

# 602.13. Console sink

Console sink hỗ trợ:

```text
stdout
stderr
native debugger output
```

Fatal/error mặc định có thể ưu tiên `stderr`.

---

# 602.14. File sink

File sink phải hỗ trợ:

```text
append
create
truncate
rotation
size limit
retention
flush policy
```

---

# 602.15. Log rotation

Có thể rotate theo:

```text
size
time
startup
manual request
```

Ví dụ:

```text
app.log
app.log.1
app.log.2
app.log.3
```

---

# 602.16. Rotation atomicity

Rotation phải cố gắng đảm bảo:

```text
old file preserved
new file created
writer switched
```

Không được mất toàn bộ logging chỉ vì rotation thất bại.

---

# 602.17. Log failure policy

Nếu sink lỗi:

```text
application MUST NOT crash solely because logging failed
```

Trừ khi application tự cấu hình strict logging policy.

Default:

```text
log failure → diagnostic warning → continue
```

---

# 602.18. Asynchronous logging

Runtime có thể cung cấp:

```text
SyncLogger
AsyncLogger
```

Async logger:

```text
producer threads
       │
       ▼
bounded queue
       │
       ▼
writer thread
       │
       ▼
sink
```

---

# 602.19. Bounded logging queue

Queue phải có giới hạn.

Không được:

```text
unbounded allocation
```

khi logging tăng đột biến.

---

# 602.20. Queue overflow

Policy:

```text
DropNewest
DropOldest
DropDebugFirst
Block
FallbackSync
```

Default:

```text
DropDebugFirst
```

Production logging không được làm process chết vì queue đầy.

---

# 602.21. Logging backpressure

Application có thể chọn:

```axiom
logger.policy = .block
```

nhưng đây không phải default.

---

# 602.22. Emergency log buffer

Runtime phải có:

```text
EmergencyRingBuffer
```

Mục tiêu:

> giữ một lượng nhỏ diagnostic event gần nhất ngay cả khi normal logging path bị lỗi.

---

# 602.23. Emergency buffer properties

Emergency buffer:

- bounded;
- lock-minimized;
- preallocated;
- không phụ thuộc heap trong crash path;
- overwrite circular;
- thread-safe.

---

# 602.24. Crash-safe logging

Trong crash handler, runtime không được thực hiện operation có thể:

```text
allocate
deadlock
wait indefinitely
load arbitrary module
initialize complex runtime
```

Crash path phải sử dụng subset an toàn.

---

# 602.25. Crash handler

Runtime cài handler cho native fatal conditions.

Platform mapping:

```text
Windows → SEH / unhandled exception
Linux   → signals
macOS   → signals / Mach facilities
Android → platform-native crash facilities
iOS     → platform crash mechanisms
WASM    → runtime trap abstraction
```

Implementation cụ thể nằm trong platform backend.

---

# 602.26. Crash categories

Crash artifact phải phân biệt:

```text
panic
fatal error
unhandled exception
illegal instruction
access violation
stack overflow
abort
signal
assertion failure
runtime invariant violation
```

---

# 602.27. Panic

Axiom panic là explicit unrecoverable runtime condition.

Ví dụ:

```axiom
panic("internal invariant violated")
```

Panic phải:

1. ghi diagnostic;
2. capture context;
3. capture stack;
4. tạo crash artifact nếu khả thi;
5. terminate process theo policy.

---

# 602.28. Recoverable error không phải panic

Không được dùng panic cho normal error.

Ví dụ:

```axiom
file.read(path)
```

có thể trả:

```text
Result
```

thay vì panic.

---

# BOOTSTRAP-602 — NATIVE APPLICATION LOGGING, DIAGNOSTICS, CRASH REPORTING & OBSERVABILITY RUNTIME 5.0

**Status:** Architecture / Implementation Specification  
**Layer:** Native Runtime / Bootstrap  
**Depends on:** BOOTSTRAP-600, BOOTSTRAP-601  
**Primary concern:** Logging, diagnostics, tracing, fault capture, crash reporting, observability  
**Non-goals:** Application state persistence, configuration management, telemetry SaaS, remote monitoring service

---

## 602.0 — Mục tiêu

BOOTSTRAP-602 định nghĩa subsystem diagnostics/observability native của Axiom.

Subsystem này phải cung cấp:

1. Structured logging.
2. Diagnostic events.
3. Runtime diagnostics.
4. Lightweight tracing.
5. Correlation/context propagation.
6. Assertion and panic diagnostics.
7. Unhandled exception/fault capture.
8. Crash artifact generation.
9. Stack trace capture.
10. Symbolization.
11. Emergency crash buffer.
12. Health/status diagnostics.
13. Runtime performance counters.
14. Integration với BOOTSTRAP-600 state/runtime lifecycle.
15. Integration với BOOTSTRAP-601 configuration/deployment.
16. Local-first operation.
17. Deterministic machine-readable output.
18. Bounded memory usage.
19. Minimal disabled-path overhead.
20. Không phụ thuộc third-party logging/crash framework.

Thiết kế phải phù hợp với mục tiêu Axiom:

> Diagnostics phải mạnh khi cần nhưng gần như biến mất khỏi executable khi ứng dụng không sử dụng chúng.

# 602.1 — Nguyên tắc kiến trúc

```text

    ├── Event Registry
    ├── Context
    ├── Tracer
    ├── Health
    └── Fault Manager
             ↓
      Platform Diagnostics
             ↓
      Output / Crash Artifacts
```

Không được để application phụ thuộc trực tiếp vào:

- Windows Event API
- POSIX syslog
- Android logging
- Apple logging framework
- debugger-specific APIs
- third-party logger
- third-party crash reporter.

Platform layer chỉ nằm dưới abstraction.

# 602.4 — Diagnostic levels

Axiom định nghĩa:

```text
TRACE
DEBUG
INFO
NOTICE
WARN
ERROR
FATAL
```

Thứ tự:

```text
TRACE < DEBUG < INFO < NOTICE < WARN < ERROR < FATAL
```

Mỗi logger có threshold.

Ví dụ:

```axiom
log.debug("parser", "token accepted")
```

Nếu threshold là `INFO`, compiler/runtime phải loại bỏ tối đa chi phí không cần thiết.

# 602.5 — Compile-time elimination

Axiom hỗ trợ:

```axiom
diagnostics.level = info
```

Compiler có thể loại bỏ:

```text
TRACE
DEBUG
```

khỏi binary nếu không cần runtime override.

Ví dụ:

```axiom
log.debug("network", expensive_debug_value())
```

Không được phép gọi:

```text
expensive_debug_value()
```

nếu DEBUG đã bị compile-time elimination.

---

# 602.6 — Lazy diagnostic arguments

API nên hỗ trợ:

```axiom
log.debug("parser") {
    "token={token} ast={dump_ast(ast)}"
}
```

Closure/block chỉ được thực thi khi event enabled.

Compiler có thể lower thành:

```text
if logger.enabled(DEBUG):
    evaluate block
```

Không dùng random UUID làm event definition.

```text
event_id
name
category
severity

```

# 602.10 — Event categories

```text
core
memory
io
network
graphics
parser
compiler
application
security
database
```

---

# 602.11 — Message model

Axiom hỗ trợ:

```axiom

```

nhưng runtime ưu tiên structured representation:

```text
event = SERVER_STARTED
fields:
    port = 8080
```

Message text là presentation layer.

---

# 602.12 — Structured logging format

Diagnostic record canonical:

```text
{
    timestamp,
    severity,
    event,
    category,
    fields,
    source,
    thread,
    process,
    context,
    trace
}
```

JSON không phải internal representation bắt buộc.

JSON chỉ là output encoder.

---

# 602.13 — Binary internal event

Internal event nên dùng binary layout:

```text
Header
    timestamp
    severity
    event_id
    flags
    payload_size

Context
    thread_id
    process_id
    trace_id
    span_id

Payload
```

Mục tiêu:

- cache-friendly
- append-only
- không allocation
- dễ serialize
- crash-safe hơn text.

# 602.14 — Event ownership

Diagnostic event sau khi commit vào queue phải độc lập với lifetime của application object.

Không lưu raw pointer tới object trong event.

Ví dụ không hợp lệ:

```text
event.field = pointer_to_local_string
```

nếu event được xử lý asynchronous.

```text
bool
i8/i16/i32/i64
u8/u16/u32/u64
f32/f64
char
string
bytes
enum
duration
timestamp
path
UUID-like ID
source location
```

# 602.16 — No arbitrary object serialization

Không tự động serialize object graph khi logging.

Điều này tránh:

- recursion
- allocation lớn
- deadlock
- secret leakage
- crash trong crash handler.

Application phải explicit:

```axiom

# 602.20 — Runtime logger configuration

```

File sink hỗ trợ:

```text

size limit

# 602.24 — Log rotation

Ví dụ:

```text

app.log.1
app.log.2
app.log.3

Không truncate file hiện tại trước khi file mới sẵn sàng.

# 602.25 — Crash-safe file handling

File logger không được là dependency bắt buộc của crash handler.

Crash handler chỉ sử dụng:

```text

```

và minimal OS write primitive.

# 602.26 — Memory sink

Memory sink dùng cho:

- testing
- diagnostics UI
- crash context
- embedded systems.

# 602.27 — Ring buffer

Diagnostic core phải hỗ trợ bounded ring buffer.

Ví dụ:

```text
capacity = N events
```

Khi đầy:

```text
drop oldest
```

hoặc policy configurable:

```text
drop_oldest
drop_newest
block
```

Default:

```text
drop_oldest
```

---

# 602.28 — Emergency ring buffer

Ngoài normal ring buffer có:

```text
EmergencyDiagnosticBuffer
```

Đặc điểm:

- preallocated
- bounded
- no heap allocation
- no locks nếu có thể
- usable during fatal failure.

---

# 602.29 — Crash buffer

Crash buffer giữ các event gần nhất:

```text
last N diagnostic events
```

Khi crash:

```text
crash report
    +
    recent diagnostic events
```

Điều này rất quan trọng để biết chuyện gì xảy ra ngay trước fault.

# 602.30 — Producer path

Normal event path:

```text
application
   ↓
enabled?
   ↓
encode
   ↓
ring buffer
   ↓
worker
   ↓
sink
```

Không được:

```text
application
   ↓
format string
   ↓
filesystem
```

trên hot path mặc định.

---

# 602.31 — Async logger

Logger mặc định có thể asynchronous.

Producer chỉ cần:

```text

```

Consumer xử lý sink.

---

# 602.32 — Synchronous mode

Application có thể yêu cầu:

```axiom

```

Dùng cho:

- startup debugging
- deterministic tests
- crash reproduction.

---

# 602.33 — Flush

API:

```axiom

```

Semantics:

> mọi event đã enqueue trước thời điểm flush phải được chuyển đến sink hoặc báo lỗi.

---

# 602.34 — Flush timeout

Có thể:

```axiom
log.flush(timeout = 100.ms)
```

Không được block vô hạn.

---

# 602.35 — Shutdown

Shutdown sequence:

```text
stop producers
↓
flush
↓
close sinks
↓
release resources
```

Crash handler không phụ thuộc shutdown thành công.

---

# 602.36 — Backpressure

Logger không được làm application chết chỉ vì sink chậm.

Default:

```text
bounded queue
drop policy
```

---

# 602.37 — Dropped-event accounting

Nếu events bị drop:

```text
diagnostics.dropped_events
```

phải được cập nhật.

Có event:

```text
DiagnosticEventsDropped
```

nhưng event này phải tránh tạo infinite recursion.

---

# 602.38 — Recursive logging protection

Nếu logger phát hiện:

```text
logger → sink → logger
```

phải ngăn recursion.

Trong failure path:

```text
disable normal logging
use emergency output
```

---

# 602.39 — Diagnostic context

Context chứa metadata implicit:

```text
request_id
user_operation
component
trace_id
span_id
```

Ví dụ:

```axiom
with diagnostic.context(request_id):
    process_request()
```

---

# 602.40 — Context propagation

Context được propagate qua:

```text
function calls
async tasks
thread execution
request handlers
```

nhưng không nhất thiết phải propagate qua process boundary.

---

# 602.41 — Context implementation

Diagnostic events passed to sink are owned by runtime unless explicitly borrowed with documented lifetime.

---

# 602.350 — Borrowing

Diagnostics API should avoid exposing complex reference/borrow semantics to application developers.

Prefer value/opaque handles.

---

# 602.351 — Pointer exposure

Raw pointers are not part of normal diagnostics API.

Platform internals may use them.

---

# 602.352 — Handle model

Opaque handles:

```text
LoggerHandle
TraceHandle
SinkHandle
CrashContext
```

---

# 602.353 — Handle invalidation

Invalid handle usage must return defined error or no-op according to API contract.

No use-after-free.

---

# 602.354 — Resource ownership

Runtime owns:

```text
global sinks
buffers
worker threads
crash state
```

Application owns optional custom sink objects according to registration contract.

---

# 602.355 — Diagnostics in libraries

Libraries should never initialize their own independent global logging infrastructure.

---

# 602.356 — Library logger identity

Library:

```text
Logger("library.name")
```

uses application diagnostic runtime.

---

# 602.357 — Multi-runtime process

If supported, process should still avoid duplicate crash handlers.

Multiple Axiom runtime instances must coordinate.

---

# 602.358 — Runtime singleton policy

Logical diagnostics service is process-scoped.

---

# 602.359 — Dynamic runtime loading

If runtime loaded/unloaded dynamically, diagnostics service lifetime must outlive registered modules.

---

# 602.360 — Fork semantics

On fork-capable targets, child process must reinitialize unsafe diagnostic state before using async logging.

---

# 602.361 — Exec semantics

After exec:

```text
new process_instance_id
```

---

# 602.362 — Crash after fork

Child crash handler must not rely on parent worker thread state.

---

# 602.363 — Signal mask interaction

Diagnostics signal installation must coexist with application signal policy.

---

# 602.364 — Signal chaining

If platform permits:

```text
Axiom handler
→ previous handler
```

according to explicit policy.

---

# 602.365 — Signal ownership

Runtime must document which signals/faults it owns.

---

# 602.366 — Debugger precedence

When debugger attached, policy may:

```text
break
capture
delegate
```

---

# 602.367 — Production debugger

Production runtime must not assume debugger exists.

---

# 602.368 — Panic recovery

Recoverable panic path must preserve diagnostic context.

---

# 602.369 — Stack unwinding diagnostics

If unwinding:

```text
panic
→ capture stack
→ unwind
→ recovery
```

Diagnostic event should preserve original panic location.

---

# 602.370 — Nested panic

Panic during panic handler:

```text
terminate via emergency path
```

---

# 602.371 — Error context

Error chain should support:

```text
operation
source
cause
diagnostic ID
```

---

# 602.372 — Cause cycle

Error cause cycle must be impossible or detected.

---

# 602.373 — Maximum error depth

Decoder/formatter uses bounded depth.

---

# 602.374 — Human formatting

Diagnostic CLI should present:

```text
ERROR [NET-1203] Connection failed
  host: ...
  reason: ...
  at: module:function(file:line)
```

---

# 602.375 — Machine formatting

JSON output should preserve typed fields:

```json
{
  "severity": "error",
  "event_id": 1203,
  "fields": {
    "port": 443
  }
}
```

Exact JSON schema will be frozen separately.

---

# 602.376 — Binary format efficiency

Binary event format should avoid repeated:

```text
field names
category names
module names
```

through intern tables where beneficial.

---

# 602.377 — String interning

Interning must be bounded.

Never allow unbounded attacker-controlled string table.

---

# 602.378 — Attacker-controlled logging

Application may log user input.

Therefore:

```text
max string length
max field count
max event size
```

must be enforced.

---

# 602.379 — Log injection

Human text sinks must escape:

```text
newline
control characters
terminal escape sequences
```

when configured for security-safe output.

---

# 602.380 — Terminal safety

Color/control output only enabled when explicitly safe.

---

# 602.381 — File name safety

User-provided category/event names must never become arbitrary file paths.

---

# 602.382 — Resource exhaustion defense

Every diagnostic path must have bounded resource consumption.

---

# 602.383 — Event rate limiting

Optional:

```text
max events/sec/category
```

---

# 602.384 — Rate limit algorithm

A simple token bucket or equivalent bounded algorithm is sufficient.

---

# 602.385 — Rate-limit diagnostics

Dropped due to rate limit:

```text
rate_limited_events
```

counter.

---

# 602.386 — Burst handling

Short bursts should be tolerated within configured bucket.

---

# 602.387 — Sampling vs rate limit

Sampling chooses events statistically/policy-wise.

Rate limiting enforces resource bound.

They are separate mechanisms.

---

# 602.388 — Error prioritization

Errors should not necessarily be dropped because debug traffic is high.

Separate priority queues may be supported.

---

# 602.389 — Queue architecture

Possible:

```text
high priority ring
normal ring
```

High priority bounded separately.

---

# 602.390 — Fatal path priority

Fatal event should use emergency buffer directly.

---

# 602.391 — Logger ordering

If multiple queues are used, exact cross-priority ordering is not guaranteed unless timestamp/sequence number is included.

---

# 602.392 — Sequence number

Each process may maintain monotonically increasing:

```text
event_sequence
```

for diagnostics ordering.

---

# 602.393 — Atomic sequence

Use atomic increment only if multi-thread global ordering is needed.

Otherwise thread-local sequence may be sufficient.

---

# 602.394 — Global ordering semantics

Global event sequence gives total order of enqueue operations, not necessarily wall-clock execution order.

---

# 602.395 — Clock and sequence

Crash artifact should prefer:

```text
sequence + monotonic timestamp
```

for reconstruction.

---

# 602.396 — Trace/span clock

Span duration uses monotonic clock.

---

# 602.397 — Health timestamps

Health transitions include monotonic duration and wall timestamp where available.

---

# 602.398 — Diagnostic state machine

Global state:

```text
UNINITIALIZED
EARLY
RUNNING
DEGRADED
SHUTTING_DOWN
STOPPED
CRASHING
```

---

# 602.399 — State transition invariants

Illegal transitions must be rejected or ignored safely.

---

# 602.400 — Degraded state

Diagnostics enters DEGRADED if:

```text
sink unavailable
worker failed
disk unavailable
```

Application continues.

---

# 602.401 — Crash state

Once:

```text
CRASHING
```

normal diagnostic APIs are disabled or redirected.

---

# 602.402 — Emergency writer

Emergency writer supports only:

```text
fixed buffer
minimal formatting
platform write
```

---

# 602.403 — Emergency formatting

Allowed primitives:

```text
integer
hex
enum
fixed string
address
```

---

# 602.404 — Emergency string limits

All strings bounded.

---

# 602.405 — Address formatting

Pointer/address formatting must not dereference memory.

---

# 602.406 — Memory probing

Crash handler must not attempt arbitrary memory probing.

---

# 602.407 — Stack probing

Only platform-safe stack capture mechanism.

---

# 602.408 — CPU context integrity

CPU context must be captured as close to fault as practical.

---

# 602.409 — Fault address

If platform supplies:

```text
fault_address
```

capture it.

---

# 602.410 — Instruction address

Capture:

```text
instruction_pointer
```

---

# 602.411 — Access type

Where available:

```text
read
write
execute
unknown
```

---

# 602.412 — Crash reason

Canonical:

fault_kind
fault_code
platform_code
```

---

# 602.413 — Platform code preservation

Unknown platform-specific error code must remain available as numeric value.

---

# 602.414 — Cross-platform normalization

Normalization must not erase important platform-specific information.

---

# 602.415 — Crash artifact privacy levels

```text
minimal
standard
diagnostic

---

# 602.416 — Minimal crash artifact

Contains:

build
platform
fault
instruction pointer
stack

# 602.421 — Crash report cleanup

age
count

limits.

# 602.426 — Health state persistence

Health state normally process-local.

Persistent health history belongs to deployment/monitoring layer.

# 602.427 — Diagnostic history

Runtime history bounded by ring buffers.

# 602.428 — Long-term history

Not part of core runtime.

# 602.429 — Remote monitoring boundary

# 602.430 — No vendor lock-in

# 602.432 — CLI tooling

must check schema and bounds.

# 602.439 — Self-hosting transition

After Axiom compiler self-hosting:

→ Axiom diagnostics runtime
```

where practical.

# 602.440 — Compiler-specific events

Compiler categories:

parse
semantic
type
borrow/memory
IR
optimization
codegen
link

depending on final language architecture.

# 602.441 — Diagnostic IDs in compiler

# 602.442 — User error vs internal compiler error

worker diagnostics

Compiler cache metrics:

hit

# 602.446 — Diagnostic event persistence

# 602.447 — CI mode

plain
machine-readable

bounded logs

---

# 602.449 — Error reporting separation

# 602.452 — Localization key

# 602.453 — Developer diagnostics

full function names

# 602.455 — Build profiles

Recommended:

debug
release
release-diagnostic
embedded
minimal

Optimized binary + diagnostic metadata.

# 602.457 — Embedded profile

threads

# 602.458 — Minimal profile

Only:

assert

# 602.459 — Diagnostics feature discovery

# 602.460 — Capability flags

Example:

TRACING
CRASH_CAPTURE
STACK_TRACE
SYMBOLIZATION
HEALTH
METRICS
FILE_SINK
DEBUGGER
```

# 602.461 — Capability stability

Capabilities are versioned.

Unknown capability bits must be ignored safely.

---

# 602.462 — Security hardening

Diagnostics parser/tooling must defend against:

```text
integer overflow
buffer overflow
path traversal
zip bombs if compressed
malicious symbols
```

---

# 602.463 — Symbol file trust

Symbol files are treated as untrusted input.

---

# 602.464 — Symbolization sandbox

Optional external symbolization tool can run isolated from application process.

---

# 602.465 — Runtime attack surface

Keep crash parser out of normal process hot path.

# 602.466 — Diagnostics as optional attack surface

If application doesn't need diagnostics:

# 602.467 — Static linking

Static executable can include only selected diagnostics modules.

---

# 602.468 — Dynamic linking

# 602.469 — Third-party library policy

No third-party library may be mandatory for:

```text
logging
crash capture
stack walking
artifact generation

# 602.470 — OS-native API policy

OS-native APIs may be used behind platform adapters.

# 602.471 — Compiler runtime dependency

# 602.472 — Intrinsics

__source_location
__function_id
__build_id
__thread_id
__stack_trace

# 602.473 — Intrinsic stability

Intrinsics not explicitly public may remain compiler-private.

# 602.474 — Diagnostics metadata section

Loader/runtime reads only if enabled.

# 602.475 — Metadata stripping

# 602.476 — Build artifact packaging

Recommended:

```text
app.exe

```

where:

# 602.477 — Symbol package identity

build_id
architecture
platform

# 602.478 — Mismatch detection

# 602.479 — Diagnostic tool errors

Tooling should clearly report:

unsupported format

missing metadata

---

# 602.480 — Crash report completeness

A crash report is considered valid if it contains:

```text
artifact version
build identity

when available.

---

# 602.481 — Graceful degradation

Unavailable information must be represented as:

```text
unknown

not_captured

# 602.482 — No fake stack frames

# 602.483 — Source location confidence

Tooling should distinguish:

exact

if mapping precision varies.

# 602.484 — Crash report annotations

Post-processing tools may add annotations without modifying original raw artifact.

# 602.485 — Immutable raw artifact

# 602.486 — Derived report

# 602.487 — Chain of custody

# 602.488 — Diagnostic timestamps

# 602.490 — Locale independence

Binary diagnostics must not depend on locale.

# 602.491 — Number formatting

with maximum size.

Limits:

no unbounded resource growth

Axiom diagnostics phải đạt trạng thái:

# BOOTSTRAP-602 — NATIVE APPLICATION LOGGING, DIAGNOSTICS, CRASH REPORTING & OBSERVABILITY RUNTIME 5.0

**Status:** Architecture / Implementation Specification

## 602.0 — Mục tiêu

BOOTSTRAP-602 định nghĩa subsystem diagnostics/observability native của Axiom.

Subsystem này phải cung cấp:

1. Structured logging.
2. Diagnostic events.
3. Runtime diagnostics.
4. Lightweight tracing.
5. Correlation/context propagation.
6. Assertion and panic diagnostics.
7. Unhandled exception/fault capture.
8. Crash artifact generation.
9. Stack trace capture.
10. Symbolization.

Thiết kế phải phù hợp với mục tiêu Axiom:

> Diagnostics phải mạnh khi cần nhưng gần như biến mất khỏi executable khi ứng dụng không sử dụng chúng.

---

# 602.1 — Nguyên tắc kiến trúc

Subsystem tuân theo các nguyên tắc:

```text
Application
    ↓
Diagnostic API
    ↓
Diagnostic Core
    ├── Logger
    ├── Event Registry
    ├── Context
    ├── Tracer
    ├── Health
    └── Fault Manager
             ↓
      Platform Diagnostics
             ↓
      Output / Crash Artifacts
```

Không được để application phụ thuộc trực tiếp vào:

- Windows Event API
- POSIX syslog
- Android logging
- Apple logging framework
- debugger-specific APIs
- third-party logger
- third-party crash reporter.

Platform layer chỉ nằm dưới abstraction.

---

# 602.2 — Ranh giới với BOOTSTRAP-600

BOOTSTRAP-600 quản lý:

```text
application state
runtime lifecycle
checkpoint
restore
state identity
state metadata
```

BOOTSTRAP-602 quản lý:

```text
what happened
when it happened
where it happened
why it failed
diagnostic evidence
runtime health
execution trace
crash evidence
```

Ví dụ:

```text
State:
    current_document = 42

Diagnostic:
    ERROR document parser failed
```

Không được trộn hai khái niệm.

---

# 602.3 — Ranh giới với BOOTSTRAP-601

BOOTSTRAP-601 quản lý:

```text
configuration
profiles
environment
deployment
secrets
configuration fingerprint
```

BOOTSTRAP-602 chỉ tham chiếu:

```text
config_fingerprint
profile_id
deployment_id
build_id
```

Không được ghi secret vào log.

Không được serialize toàn bộ configuration snapshot vào crash report mặc định.

---

# 602.4 — Diagnostic levels

Axiom định nghĩa:

```text
TRACE
DEBUG
INFO
NOTICE
WARN
ERROR
FATAL
```

Thứ tự:

```text
TRACE < DEBUG < INFO < NOTICE < WARN < ERROR < FATAL
```

Mỗi logger có threshold.

Ví dụ:

```axiom
log.debug("parser", "token accepted")
```

Nếu threshold là `INFO`, compiler/runtime phải loại bỏ tối đa chi phí không cần thiết.

---

# 602.5 — Compile-time elimination

Axiom hỗ trợ:

```axiom
diagnostics.level = info
```

Compiler có thể loại bỏ:

```text
TRACE
DEBUG
```

khỏi binary nếu không cần runtime override.

Ví dụ:

```axiom
log.debug("network", expensive_debug_value())
```

Không được phép gọi:

```text
expensive_debug_value()
```

nếu DEBUG đã bị compile-time elimination.

---

# 602.6 — Lazy diagnostic arguments

API nên hỗ trợ:

```axiom
log.debug("parser") {
    "token={token} ast={dump_ast(ast)}"
}
```

Closure/block chỉ được thực thi khi event enabled.

Compiler có thể lower thành:

```text
if logger.enabled(DEBUG):
    evaluate block
```

---

# 602.7 — Structured event

Mỗi diagnostic event gồm:

```text
timestamp
monotonic_time
severity
category
event_id
message
fields
thread_id
process_id
context_id
trace_id
span_id
source_location
```

Các field tùy chọn phải được encode compact.

---

# 602.8 — Event ID

Mỗi event có thể có ID:

```axiom
log.error(
    event = EVT_PARSER_FAILED,
    ...
)
```

Event ID phải deterministic.

Không dùng random UUID làm event definition.

---

# 602.9 — Event definition

Ví dụ:

```axiom
event ParserFailed = 0x120001
```

Compiler tạo metadata:

```text
event_id
name
category
severity
source module
```

Metadata có thể được strip trong release build.

---

# 602.10 — Event categories

Category là string hoặc compile-time symbol:

```text
core
memory
io
network
graphics
parser
compiler
application
security
database
```

Khuyến nghị dùng interned IDs thay vì heap string.

---

# 602.11 — Message model

Axiom hỗ trợ:

```axiom
log.info("server", "Listening on {port}")
```

nhưng runtime ưu tiên structured representation:

```text
event = SERVER_STARTED
fields:
    port = 8080
```

Message text là presentation layer.

---

# 602.12 — Structured logging format

Diagnostic record canonical:

```text
{
    timestamp,
    severity,
    event,
    category,
    fields,
    source,
    thread,
    process,
    context,
    trace
}
```

JSON không phải internal representation bắt buộc.

JSON chỉ là output encoder.

---

# 602.13 — Binary internal event

Internal event nên dùng binary layout:

```text
Header
    timestamp
    severity
    event_id
    flags
    payload_size

Context
    thread_id
    process_id
    trace_id
    span_id

Payload
```

Mục tiêu:

- cache-friendly
- append-only
- không allocation
- dễ serialize
- crash-safe hơn text.

---

# 602.14 — Event ownership

Diagnostic event sau khi commit vào queue phải độc lập với lifetime của application object.

Không lưu raw pointer tới object trong event.

Ví dụ không hợp lệ:

```text
event.field = pointer_to_local_string
```

nếu event được xử lý asynchronous.

---

# 602.15 — Field types

Các field primitive được hỗ trợ:

```text
bool
i8/i16/i32/i64
u8/u16/u32/u64
f32/f64
char
string
bytes
enum
duration
timestamp
path
UUID-like ID
source location
```

---

# 602.16 — No arbitrary object serialization

Không tự động serialize object graph khi logging.

Điều này tránh:

- recursion
- allocation lớn
- deadlock
- secret leakage
- crash trong crash handler.

Application phải explicit:

```axiom
log.debug("user", user.id)
```

---

# 602.17 — Logger

Logger là lightweight handle:

```axiom
let log = Logger("network")
```

Handle không sở hữu global resource.

Có thể copy.

Có thể:

```

Threshold inheritance:

```text
app = INFO

```

Logger lookup không được yêu cầu global lock trên mỗi event.

Có thể dùng:

```text
immutable logger table
atomic configuration pointer
```

---

# 602.20 — Runtime logger configuration

Threshold có thể thay đổi runtime:

```axiom
diagnostics.set_level("network", DEBUG)

human readable

compact

File sink hỗ trợ:

append

app.log

emergency buffer

Memory sink dùng cho:

- testing
- diagnostics UI

# 602.27 — Ring buffer

Diagnostic core phải hỗ trợ bounded ring buffer.

Ví dụ:

```text
capacity = N events
```

Khi đầy:

```text
drop oldest
```

hoặc policy configurable:

```text
drop_oldest
drop_newest
block
```

Default:

```text
drop_oldest
```

---

# 602.28 — Emergency ring buffer

Ngoài normal ring buffer có:

```text
EmergencyDiagnosticBuffer
```

Đặc điểm:

- preallocated
- bounded
- no heap allocation
- no locks nếu có thể
- usable during fatal failure.

---

# 602.29 — Crash buffer

Crash buffer giữ các event gần nhất:

```text
last N diagnostic events
```

Khi crash:

```text
crash report
    +
    recent diagnostic events
```

Điều này rất quan trọng để biết chuyện gì xảy ra ngay trước fault.

# 602.30 — Producer path

Normal event path:

```text
application
   ↓
enabled?
   ↓
encode
   ↓
ring buffer
   ↓
worker
   ↓
sink
```

Không được:

```text
application
   ↓
format string
   ↓
filesystem
```

trên hot path mặc định.

---

# 602.31 — Async logger

Logger mặc định có thể asynchronous.

Producer chỉ cần:

```text
encode → enqueue
```

Consumer xử lý sink.

---

# 602.32 — Synchronous mode

Application có thể yêu cầu:

```axiom
diagnostics.mode = sync
```

Dùng cho:

- startup debugging
- deterministic tests
- crash reproduction.

---

# 602.33 — Flush

API:

```axiom
log.flush()
```

Semantics:

> mọi event đã enqueue trước thời điểm flush phải được chuyển đến sink hoặc báo lỗi.

---

# 602.34 — Flush timeout

Có thể:

```axiom
log.flush(timeout = 100.ms)
```

Không được block vô hạn.

---

# 602.35 — Shutdown

Shutdown sequence:

```text
stop producers
↓
flush
↓
close sinks
↓
release resources
```

Crash handler không phụ thuộc shutdown thành công.

---

# 602.36 — Backpressure

Logger không được làm application chết chỉ vì sink chậm.

Default:

```text
bounded queue
drop policy
```

---

# 602.37 — Dropped-event accounting

Nếu events bị drop:

```text

```

phải được cập nhật.

Có event:

```text
DiagnosticEventsDropped

nhưng event này phải tránh tạo infinite recursion.

---

# 602.38 — Recursive logging protection

Nếu logger phát hiện:

```text

```

phải ngăn recursion.

Trong failure path:

```text

use emergency output
```

# 602.39 — Diagnostic context

request_id

component

span_id

Context được propagate qua:

request handlers

nhưng không nhất thiết phải propagate qua process boundary.

# 602.41 — Context implementation

Không dùng global mutable dictionary.

Ưu tiên:

# 602.42 — Context allocation

Hot-path context nên tránh heap allocation.

# 602.43 — Context lifetime

Context phải tự động restore:

execute

Native API:

---

# 602.475 — Metadata stripping

Release binary can remove human-readable metadata while retaining minimal unwind/build ID.

---

# 602.476 — Build artifact packaging

Recommended:

```text
app.exe
app.sym
app.diag
```

where:

```text
.sym = symbols
.diag = optional diagnostic metadata
```

Exact extension not yet ABI-frozen.

---

# 602.477 — Symbol package identity

Symbol package must include:

```text
build_id
architecture
platform
```

---

# 602.478 — Mismatch detection

Tooling must reject symbols whose build ID doesn't match crash artifact.

---

# 602.479 — Diagnostic tool errors

Tooling should clearly report:

```text
symbol mismatch
unsupported format
corrupt artifact
missing metadata
```

---

# 602.480 — Crash report completeness

A crash report is considered valid if it contains:

```text
artifact version
build identity
fault identity
at least one diagnostic location or fault address
```

when available.

---

# 602.481 — Graceful degradation

Unavailable information must be represented as:

```text
unknown
unavailable
not_captured
```

Never fabricate.

---

# 602.482 — No fake stack frames

Symbolizer must never invent function names.

---

# 602.483 — Source location confidence

Tooling should distinguish:

```text
exact
approximate
unknown
```

if mapping precision varies.

---

# 602.484 — Crash report annotations

Post-processing tools may add annotations without modifying original raw artifact.

---

# 602.485 — Immutable raw artifact

Original crash artifact should remain immutable.

---

# 602.486 — Derived report

Human-readable report is a derived artifact.

---

# 602.487 — Chain of custody

Optional hash of raw artifact can be included in derived report.

---

# 602.488 — Diagnostic timestamps

All timestamps must indicate timezone/UTC semantics where serialized.

---

# 602.489 — Canonical time

Internal canonical wall timestamp should be UTC-based.

---

# 602.490 — Locale independence

Binary diagnostics must not depend on locale.

---

# 602.491 — Number formatting

Machine output uses locale-independent representation.

---

# 602.492 — Unicode

Diagnostics text is UTF-8 by default.

Invalid UTF-8 must be safely encoded.

---

# 602.493 — Invalid string handling

Malformed UTF-8 should not crash logger.

Use replacement/escaped bytes according to encoder policy.

---

# 602.494 — Binary field handling

Binary payloads use:

```text
length + bytes
```

with maximum size.

---

# 602.495 — Large payloads

Large payloads require explicit blob/reference API.

---

# 602.496 — Blob diagnostics

Optional:

```axiom
diagnostics.attach_blob(...)
```

Blob is bounded and separately retained.

---

# 602.497 — No implicit file reads

Logger never reads arbitrary application files to serialize objects.

---

# 602.498 — Diagnostic context serialization

Only explicitly registered context fields are serialized.

---

# 602.499 — Context limits

Limits:

```text
max fields
max bytes
max nesting
```

---

# 602.500 — Core completion invariant

BOOTSTRAP-602 is complete only when:

```text
logging
+ structured events
+ context
+ tracing
+ health
+ counters
+ panic/assert
+ native fault capture
+ emergency buffer
+ stack capture
+ symbol mapping
+ crash artifacts
+ privacy/redaction
+ configuration integration
+ state/checkpoint correlation
+ platform abstraction
+ deterministic versioned format
+ bounded resource usage
+ testing/fault injection
```

đã có architecture và implementation contract.

---

# 602.501 — Required implementation phases

Implementation phải chia thành:

### Phase 1 — Emergency diagnostics

```text
emergency buffer
panic
assert
minimal fault capture
stderr/debugger
```

### Phase 2 — Structured logging

```text
events
severity
logger
ring buffer
console sink
```

### Phase 3 — Persistent logging

```text
file sink
rotation
retention
serialization
```

### Phase 4 — Crash artifacts

```text
stack
CPU context
modules
build ID
.axcrash
```

### Phase 5 — Runtime observability

```text
context
trace
health
counters
```

### Phase 6 — Toolchain

```text
diag inspect
diag decode
symbolizer
artifact validator
```

### Phase 7 — Advanced optimization

```text
compile-time stripping
LTO elimination
zero-allocation mode
sampling
rate limiting
```

---

# 602.502 — Required test matrix

Mỗi target phải test:

```text
logging disabled
logging enabled
queue full
sink failure
disk full
permission failure
flush
shutdown
panic
assert
nested panic
native fault
stack capture
symbol mismatch
corrupt artifact
secret redaction
Unicode
large fields
multithreading
async tasks
startup crash
shutdown crash
```

---

# 602.503 — Cross-platform test matrix

Targets:

```text
Windows x64
Linux x64
Linux ARM64
macOS ARM64
iOS ARM64
Android ARM64
WASM
```

Platform không hỗ trợ feature phải pass bằng:

```text
capability unavailable
```

không phải runtime crash.

---

# 602.504 — Performance acceptance

Benchmarks phải chứng minh:

1. Disabled logs gần như không có overhead.
2. Enabled async logging không serialize toàn application.
3. Ring buffer bounded.
4. No unbounded allocation.
5. Crash path không phụ thuộc normal heap.
6. Diagnostics có thể được linker loại bỏ.
7. Minimal profile có footprint nhỏ.

Exact numerical thresholds được freeze sau benchmark prototype thực tế thay vì áp đặt số tùy ý trước khi có implementation.

---

# 602.505 — Correctness acceptance

Phải chứng minh:

```text
no diagnostic event corruption
no crash-handler recursion
no secret leakage through typed Secret
no invalid artifact parsing
no symbol/build mismatch acceptance
no unbounded resource growth
```

---

# 602.506 — Developer experience acceptance

Developer có thể viết:

```axiom
fn connect(host: string) -> Result<Connection> {
    log.debug("network", "connecting to {host}")

    let span = trace.begin("connect")

    ...
}
```

mà không phải:

```text
import platform-specific logger
configure third-party logger
manage thread-safe queue
format JSON manually
implement crash handler
```

---

# 602.507 — Production usage acceptance

Một native application release phải có khả năng:

```text
start
log
run
report health
crash
produce artifact
restart
inspect previous crash
```

mà không cần cloud service.

---

# 602.508 — Architecture invariant

BOOTSTRAP-602 không được trở thành:

```text
mandatory heavyweight runtime
```

Nó phải là:

```text
capability-based
modular
dead-strippable
bounded
local-first
platform-adapted
```

---

# 602.509 — Final API principle

Application developer chủ yếu nhìn thấy:

```axiom
log.info(...)
log.warn(...)
log.error(...)

trace.begin(...)
health.status(...)

panic(...)
assert(...)

diagnostics.snapshot(...)
```

Phần còn lại thuộc compiler/runtime/tooling.

---

# 602.510 — Final design principle

Axiom diagnostics phải đạt trạng thái:

> **When everything is working, diagnostics are cheap. When something goes wrong, diagnostics become extremely rich without requiring the application to have predicted the failure.**

Đây là nguyên tắc trung tâm của BOOTSTRAP-602.

---

## BOOTSTRAP-602 — Completion Criteria

Task được xem là hoàn thành ở cấp architecture khi:

- Diagnostic API đã được định nghĩa.
- Structured event model đã được định nghĩa.
- Logging pipeline đã được định nghĩa.

- Context/tracing model đã được định nghĩa.
- Health/counter model đã được định nghĩa.
- Panic/assert/fault model đã được định nghĩa.
- Cross-platform crash abstraction đã được định nghĩa.
- Stack/unwind/symbol model đã được định nghĩa.
- `.axcrash` concept và versioning đã được định nghĩa.
- Privacy/redaction boundary đã được định nghĩa.
- BOOTSTRAP-600/601 integration đã được định nghĩa.
- Compiler/linker integration đã được định nghĩa.

- Resource/security limits đã được định nghĩa.

# BOOTSTRAP-603 — NATIVE APPLICATION SECURITY BOUNDARY, CAPABILITY SYSTEM, PERMISSIONS & TRUSTED RUNTIME 5.0

**Status:** Architecture / Implementation Specification  
**Layer:** Native Runtime / Security  
**Depends on:** BOOTSTRAP-600, BOOTSTRAP-601, BOOTSTRAP-602  
**Primary concern:** Security boundaries, capabilities, permissions, privilege separation, trusted runtime  
**Design goal:** Security mạnh nhưng không biến Axiom thành một hệ thống permission phức tạp trong mọi application.

---

# 603.0 — Mục tiêu

BOOTSTRAP-603 định nghĩa security foundation của Axiom native runtime.

Subsystem phải cung cấp:

1. Security boundary.
2. Capability-based access control.
3. Permission model.
4. Privilege separation.
5. Resource authority.
6. Process/module trust boundaries.
7. Sandboxing integration.
8. Secret access control.
9. File/network/device capabilities.
10. Native OS permission mapping.
11. Runtime capability attenuation.
12. Secure defaults.
13. Explicit privilege escalation.
14. Capability inspection.
15. Audit integration.
16. Secure IPC boundary.
17. Plugin/module isolation.
18. Crash-safe security behavior.
19. Compiler/linker security metadata.
20. Minimal overhead when security features are unused.

Core principle:

> **Code chỉ có quyền làm những gì capability của nó cho phép.**

---

# 603.1 — Security architecture

Mô hình tổng quát:

```text
Application
    ↓
Axiom Security API
    ↓
Capability Runtime
    ├── Capability Registry
    ├── Permission Resolver
    ├── Policy Engine
    ├── Trust Boundary
    ├── Resource Guards
    └── Audit Hooks
             ↓
      Platform Security Adapter
             ↓
 Windows / Linux / macOS / iOS / Android / WASM
```

---

# 603.2 — Security boundary

Security boundary là nơi code không còn được mặc định tin tưởng lẫn nhau.

Boundary có thể nằm giữa:

```text
process
module
plugin
sandbox
IPC peer
external resource
```

---

# 603.3 — Trusted Computing Base

Axiom security TCB tối thiểu:

```text
kernel / OS
Axiom loader
Axiom runtime security core
platform security adapter
```

Application code không thuộc TCB.

---

# 603.4 — Không biến toàn runtime thành TCB

Logging, GUI, application framework và business library không được mặc định trở thành security authority.

---

# 603.5 — Capability model

Capability là một opaque authority token:

```axiom
Capability<FileRead>
```

hoặc:

```axiom
Capability<NetworkConnect>
```

Capability không phải chỉ là boolean permission.

---

# 603.6 — Permission vs capability

Permission:

> chính sách cho phép hoặc từ chối hành động.

Capability:

> authority cụ thể mà code đang sở hữu.

Ví dụ:

```text
permission:
    application may read files

capability:
    read authority for /data/app/
```

---

# 603.7 — Capability principle

Không kiểm tra:

```text
"application có permission không?"
```

ở mọi nơi nếu capability đã xác nhận authority.

Thay vào đó:

```text
operation(capability, resource)
```

---

# 603.8 — Opaque capability

Capability không expose:

```text
pointer
OS handle
filesystem path
kernel object internals
```

trực tiếp.

---

# 603.9 — Capability ownership

Capability là value/handle có ownership semantics rõ ràng.

Copy chỉ được phép nếu capability type cho phép.

---

# 603.10 — Capability attenuation

Capability có thể bị giảm quyền:

```text
full file capability
        ↓
read-only capability
        ↓
specific directory capability
```

Không được tăng quyền bằng attenuation.

---

# 603.11 — Monotonic authority

Một function nhận capability chỉ được:

```text
use
delegate
attenuate
```

không tự tạo capability mạnh hơn.

---

# 603.12 — Capability creation

Capability mới chỉ được tạo bởi:

```text
trusted runtime
OS authority
explicit privileged subsystem
```

---

# 603.13 — Application bootstrap capabilities

Application nhận initial capabilities từ:

```text
deployment manifest
OS sandbox
runtime bootstrap
```

---

# 603.14 — Capability manifest

BOOTSTRAP-601 deployment manifest có thể khai báo:

```text
capabilities:
    filesystem.read
    filesystem.write
    network.connect
```

---

# 603.15 — Default-deny

Capability không được cấp:

```text
→ operation denied
```

---

# 603.16 — Compatibility mode

Native desktop application có thể chạy legacy-compatible mode:

```text
security.mode = native
```

Trong mode này OS permissions là boundary chính.

---

# 603.17 — Hardened mode

```text
security.mode = hardened
```

mọi resource access đi qua explicit capability.

---

# 603.18 — Minimal mode

```text
security.mode = minimal
```

chỉ giữ security primitives cần thiết cho target.

---

# 603.19 — Security profiles

Recommended:

```text
desktop
server
sandbox
embedded
mobile
wasm
```

---

# 603.20 — Capability namespaces

Canonical namespaces:

```text
filesystem
network
process
thread
memory
device
graphics
audio
camera
microphone
ipc
environment
clock
random
debug
```

---

# 603.21 — Filesystem capabilities

Types:

```text
FileRead
FileWrite
DirectoryList
DirectoryCreate
FileDelete
FileRename
FileExecute
```

---

# 603.22 — File capability granularity

Capability có thể giới hạn:

```text
resource
operation
path scope
```

Ví dụ:

```text
Read /app/data/*
```

---

# 603.23 — Path canonicalization

Security check phải canonicalize path trước khi quyết định authority.

Phải chống:

```text
../
symlink escape
junction escape
case confusion
alternate path syntax
```

tùy platform.

---

# 603.24 — Symlink policy

Filesystem capability phải có policy:

```text
follow
deny
follow-within-root
```

Default hardened mode:

```text
follow-within-root
```

---

# 603.25 — TOCTOU

Không dựa vào:

```text
check(path)
→ later open(path)
```

nếu platform có secure descriptor-based operation.

---

# 603.26 — Secure open

Ưu tiên:

```text
resolve + open + verify
```

trong một security-aware operation.

---

# 603.27 — File handle capability

Sau khi file được mở:

```text
FileHandle
```

có thể trở thành capability độc lập với path.

---

# 603.28 — Path capability vs handle capability

Path capability:

> quyền mở resource.

Handle capability:

> quyền thao tác trên resource đã mở.

---

# 603.29 — Directory capability

Directory capability giới hạn descendant resources.

---

# 603.30 — Temporary file capability

Runtime có thể cung cấp:

```axiom
temp.create(capability)
```

không cần cấp toàn filesystem write.

---

# 603.31 — Network capabilities

Types:

```text
NetworkConnect
NetworkListen
NetworkResolve
NetworkRaw
```

---

# 603.32 — Endpoint restriction

Network capability có thể giới hạn:

```text
protocol
host
port
direction
```

---

# 603.33 — DNS capability

DNS resolution có thể tách:

```text
NetworkResolve
```

khỏi:

```text
NetworkConnect
```

---

# 603.34 — Listen capability

Server application cần explicit:

```text
NetworkListen
```

---

# 603.35 — Raw socket capability

Raw networking là elevated capability.

Không cấp mặc định trong hardened profile.

---

# 603.36 — Localhost policy

Localhost không mặc định được coi là harmless.

Security policy phải phân biệt:

```text
loopback
LAN
internet
```

nếu target cần.

---

# 603.37 — Process capabilities

Types:

```text
ProcessSpawn
ProcessSignal
ProcessInspect
ProcessDebug
ProcessTerminate
```

---

# 603.38 — Child process authority

Child process mặc định không tự động nhận toàn bộ parent capabilities.

---

# 603.39 — Capability inheritance

Explicit policy:

```text
inherit-none
inherit-selected
inherit-all
```

Default hardened:

```text
inherit-selected
```

---

# 603.40 — Capability passing

Capability có thể được truyền qua trusted IPC nếu platform hỗ trợ.

---

# 603.41 — Capability duplication

OS resource handle duplication phải tạo capability mới với authority không vượt quá source.

---

# 603.42 — Thread capabilities

Thread creation không mặc định tạo privilege.

Thread inherits execution context nhưng authority propagation phải explicit đối với privileged capabilities.

---

# 603.43 — Memory capabilities

Memory authority gồm:

```text
Allocate
Map
Execute
Protect
SharedMemory
```

---

# 603.44 — W^X principle

Executable memory mặc định:

```text
write XOR execute
```

Không cho:

```text
write + execute
```

trừ target/policy explicitly yêu cầu.

---

# 603.45 — JIT capability

JIT runtime cần:

```text
MemoryJIT
```

explicit capability.

---

# 603.46 — Executable memory

`ExecutableMemory` không được tạo chỉ từ:

```text
MemoryAllocate
```

---

# 603.47 — Memory protection transitions

Cho phép:

```text
RW → RX
```

khi policy cho phép.

Hạn chế:

```text
RWX
```

---

# 603.48 — Dynamic code loading

Dynamic executable loading yêu cầu:

```text
ModuleLoad
```

và tùy target:

```text
ExecutableMemory
```

---

# 603.49 — Library loading

Capability:

```text
LibraryLoad
```

có thể giới hạn:

```text
trusted directories
signed modules
known build IDs
```

---

# 603.50 — DLL/shared library search

Security-sensitive loader không dùng unrestricted search path.

Ưu tiên:

```text
explicit absolute/validated path
known module directory
trusted search scope
```

---

# 603.51 — Module trust

Module metadata:

```text
module_id
build_id
publisher
signature
trust_level
```

nếu platform cung cấp.

---

# 603.52 — Signed module

Optional policy:

```text
require_signed_modules = true
```

---

# 603.53 — Signature verification

Verification thuộc security loader/tooling layer.

Không cần crypto implementation trong language syntax.

---

# 603.54 — Crypto boundary

Axiom security API có thể expose:

```text
hash
MAC
signature
key
random
```

nhưng cryptographic primitives thuộc một subsystem riêng.

---

# 603.55 — Random capability

Secure randomness:

```text
SecureRandom
```

phải đến từ trusted OS/runtime source.

---

# 603.56 — Deterministic random

Testing có thể dùng deterministic RNG.

Không được nhầm với cryptographic random.

---

# 603.57 — Environment capability

Environment variable access:

```text
EnvironmentRead
```

có thể bị giới hạn theo key allowlist.

---

# 603.58 — Secret environment variables

Secret environment variables không tự động được expose vào arbitrary application modules.

---

# 603.59 — BOOTSTRAP-601 Secret integration

`Secret<T>` chỉ được unwrap khi code sở hữu capability tương ứng.

---

# 603.60 — Secret capability

Ví dụ:

```text
SecretRead<DatabaseCredential>
```

---

# 603.61 — Secret non-copy policy

Sensitive secret capability nên hỗ trợ move-only semantics khi phù hợp.

---

# 603.62 — Secret lifetime

Secret value phải có explicit lifetime.

Runtime không giữ bản sao không cần thiết.

---

# 603.63 — Secret zeroization

Memory containing sensitive material có thể được zeroized trước release nếu semantics/optimizer cho phép.

---

# 603.64 — Compiler-aware secret memory

Compiler phải tránh tối ưu hóa zeroization thành no-op khi API yêu cầu secure wipe.

---

# 603.65 — Debugger restriction

Debugger access là privileged capability:

```text
ProcessDebug
```

---

# 603.66 — Diagnostic integration

BOOTSTRAP-602 được phép biết:

```text
capability IDs
security policy status
```

nhưng không log capability secret material.

---

# 603.67 — Audit integration

Security-sensitive decisions có thể emit:

```text
CAPABILITY_GRANTED
CAPABILITY_DENIED
POLICY_CHANGED
MODULE_REJECTED
```

---

# 603.68 — Audit anti-recursion

Security audit failure không được gây recursive security failure.

---

# 603.69 — Permission request

Application có thể request:

```axiom
security.request(NetworkConnect)
```

Nhưng request không đảm bảo được cấp.

---

# 603.70 — Permission decision

Decision:

```text
granted
denied
unavailable
requires_user
```

---

# 603.71 — User approval

Mobile/desktop UI permission prompts thuộc platform adapter.

Core runtime không hiển thị UI.

---

# 603.72 — Permission caching

Granted authority có thể cache theo:

```text
process
session
installation
OS policy
```

tùy platform.

---

# 603.73 — Permission revocation

Capability phải phản ánh revocation khi platform yêu cầu.

---

# 603.74 — Revoked capability

Operation với revoked capability:

```text
SecurityError
```

Không undefined behavior.

---

# 603.75 — Capability generation

Capability handle có generation/version để tránh stale handle.

---

# 603.76 — Capability invalidation

Khi revoked:

```text
generation++
```

---

# 603.77 — Capability lookup

Capability IDs không phải secret.

Capability object itself phải opaque.

---

# 603.78 — Capability forgery

Không thể tạo valid capability bằng:

```text
integer cast
pointer cast
memory copy
string parsing
```

---

# 603.79 — Type safety

Compiler/runtime phải ngăn:

```text
Capability<FileRead>
```

được sử dụng như:

```text
Capability<FileWrite>
```

---

# 603.80 — No ambient authority

Không cho API kiểu:

```axiom
File.open(path)
```

trong hardened capability-only context.

Thay bằng:

```axiom
File.open(file_capability, path)
```

---

---

# 603.281 — Policy fingerprint

Security subsystem separately computes:

```text
security_policy_fingerprint
```

---

# 603.282 — Fingerprint purpose

Fingerprints identify policy/config versions.

They are not secrets.

---

# 603.283 — Security reproducibility

Crash/diagnostic tooling can determine:

```text
binary
config
security policy
```

combination.

---

# 603.284 — Build-time policy

Compiler may enforce:

```text
forbidden capability
```

for restricted targets.

---

# 603.285 — Deployment validation

Deployment tool checks:

```text
application required capabilities
vs
deployment allowed capabilities
```

---

# 603.286 — CI security validation

CI can fail build if forbidden capability appears.

---

# 603.287 — Capability diff

Tool:

```text
axiom security diff old.axsec new.axsec
```

shows additions/removals.

---

# 603.288 — No security score

Tooling reports capability changes, not a generic security rating.

---

# 603.289 — Capability documentation generation

Compiler can generate:

```text
SECURITY-MANIFEST.md
```

or machine-readable equivalent.

---

# 603.290 — Human-readable manifest

Example:

```text
Application requires:
    filesystem.read: /data/app
    network.connect: api.example.com:443
```

---

# 603.291 — Machine manifest

Canonical machine schema should use stable IDs rather than prose.

---

# 603.292 — Manifest signing

Deployment manifest may be signed.

---

# 603.293 — Signature trust

Trusted key source is platform/deployment specific.

---

# 603.294 — Unsigned development builds

Development may allow unsigned modules.

Production policy can require signatures.

---

# 603.295 — Debug bypass

Debug mode must not silently disable security policy.

A deliberate debug capability may be granted.

---

# 603.296 — Debug capability

```text
DebugControl
```

explicitly grants additional inspection.

---

# 603.297 — Production prohibition

Production deployment can reject binaries requesting `DebugControl`.

---

# 603.298 — Test capabilities

Tests may receive special:

```text
TestControl
```

capabilities.

---

# 603.299 — Test-only metadata

Compiler should strip test-only capabilities from release builds.

---

# 603.300 — Security test harness

Required tests:

```text
forged capability
stale capability
wrong capability type
revocation race
path traversal
symlink escape
policy reload
IPC spoofing
plugin restriction
FFI boundary
secret leakage
```

---

# 603.301 — Fuzzing

Security parsers should be fuzzed:

```text
policy parser
manifest parser
capability metadata parser
IPC decoder
artifact decoder
```

---

# 603.302 — Property tests

Required properties:

```text
attenuation never increases authority
revocation eventually invalidates new operations
policy deny cannot become allow through cache
capability serialization cannot recreate authority
```

---

# 603.303 — Concurrency tests

Test:

```text
concurrent grant
concurrent revoke
policy reload
resource use
task spawn
```

---

# 603.304 — Race detection

Runtime implementation should be testable with race/thread sanitization where available.

---

# 603.305 — Failure injection

Inject:

```text
policy load failure
OS permission failure
handle duplication failure
sandbox query failure
memory allocation failure
```

---

# 603.306 — Security logging

Every security denial can optionally produce BOOTSTRAP-602 event.

---

# 603.307 — Security logging overhead

Disabled audit/security logging must remain cheap.

---

# 603.308 — Security emergency path

If security subsystem itself faults:

```text
deny privileged operation
```

and emit minimal diagnostic.

---

# 603.309 — Fail-closed invariant

For security decision uncertainty:

```text
unknown → deny
```

in hardened mode.

---

# 603.310 — Platform failure

If OS security API returns unexpected error:

```text
SecurityUnavailable
```

rather than treating it as granted.

---

# 603.311 — Compatibility exception

Legacy/native profile may expose direct OS errors where required.

---

# 603.312 — Error mapping

Platform errors map to:

```text
PermissionDenied
NotFound
NotSupported
Revoked
ResourceLimit
SecurityUnavailable
```

while preserving platform code.

---

# 603.313 — Error detail

Detailed platform code may be available to privileged diagnostics tooling.

---

# 603.314 — User-facing security errors

Messages should explain:

```text
operation
required authority
denial category
```

without exposing policy secrets.

---

# 603.315 — Security API example

```axiom
fn load_config(dir: DirectoryRead) -> Result<Config> {
    let file = dir.open("config.axcfg")
    return Config.parse(file)
}
```

The function cannot read outside the directory authority.

---

# 603.316 — Network API example

```axiom
fn fetch(api: NetworkConnect) -> Result<Response> {
    return api.connect("api.example.com", 443)
}
```

---

# 603.317 — Delegation example

```axiom
fn worker(parent: DirectoryRead) {
    let limited = parent.subdirectory("cache")
    spawn(task, with = limited)
}
```

---

# 603.318 — Attenuation invariant

`limited` must never read:

```text
parent scope
```

outside its subtree.

---

# 603.319 — Function requirements

Example:

```axiom
@requires(NetworkConnect)
fn download(...)
```

Compiler records requirement.

---

# 603.320 — Capability injection

Application entrypoint may receive:

```axiom
fn main(args, caps: AppCapabilities)
```

where `AppCapabilities` is generated from deployment manifest.

---

# 603.321 — Generated capability object

Compiler/toolchain may generate:

```text
AppCapabilities.files
AppCapabilities.network
AppCapabilities.process
```

only for requested capabilities.

---

# 603.322 — No unused authority

If application never requests:

```text
ProcessSpawn
```

generated `AppCapabilities.process` should not exist.

---

# 603.323 — Capability discoverability

Developer tooling can inspect generated capability set.

---

# 603.324 — Security boundary API

Minimal:

```axiom
security.check(...)
security.require(...)
security.request(...)
security.drop(...)
security.status(...)
```

---

# 603.325 — `require`

`require(capability)` must fail deterministically if absent.

---

# 603.326 — `check`

`check` is non-throwing/preflight.

---

# 603.327 — `request`

May interact with platform permission mechanism.

---

# 603.328 — `drop`

Irreversibly attenuates current context.

---

# 603.329 — Security scope

```axiom
security.scope(limited_caps) {
    ...
}
```

restores previous context after scope.

---

# 603.330 — Scope safety

Scope restoration must occur even if error/panic propagation occurs where runtime supports structured unwinding.

---

# 603.331 — Async scope

Capability scope must propagate according to explicit task semantics.

---

# 603.332 — Capability context inheritance

Default:

```text
child task receives parent's non-sensitive capabilities
```

Sensitive/high privilege capabilities require explicit delegation.

---

# 603.333 — High-risk capability class

High-risk capabilities:

```text
ProcessDebug
RawDevice
RawSocket
ExecutableMemory
SystemConfig
CredentialAccess
```

must not automatically propagate.

---

# 603.334 — Capability classification

Capabilities can have risk metadata:

```text
normal
sensitive
privileged
system
```

This is descriptive metadata, not a generic security score.

---

# 603.335 — Capability policy

High-risk capabilities require stronger deployment approval.

---

# 603.336 — Security UI

Runtime itself remains UI-neutral.

Platform shell may display permission prompts.

---

# 603.337 — User denial

User denial returns normal `SecurityError`.

No repeated prompt loop.

---

# 603.338 — Permission persistence

Persistence semantics delegated to OS/deployment.

---

# 603.339 — Mobile lifecycle

When application backgrounded/suspended, capabilities may become temporarily unusable.

Operations must handle OS denial.

---

# 603.340 — Capability status

Status can be:

```text
active
temporarily_unavailable
revoked
denied
```

---

# 603.341 — WASM host capability

Host provides explicit imports.

Axiom runtime cannot access host resources not imported.

---

# 603.342 — WASM sandbox invariant

WASM linear memory does not imply host filesystem/network authority.

---

# 603.343 — Native sandbox

Native sandbox policy must be queried at startup.

---

# 603.344 — Security bootstrap report

Startup diagnostics can record:

```text
security profile
sandbox type
policy fingerprint
granted capability count
```

---

# 603.345 — No capability value logging

Never output actual capability token internals.

---

# 603.346 — Capability leak prevention

Capability objects should not implement generic string serialization.

---

# 603.347 — Generic serialization restriction

Compiler rejects serialization of capability types unless explicit safe projection exists.

---

# 603.348 — Equality semantics

Capability equality means:

```text
same authority/resource identity
```

not token byte equality exposed to application.

---

# 603.349 — Hash semantics

Capability can be hashable only through stable opaque identity.

---

# 603.350 — Ordering

Capabilities do not have meaningful ordering.

---

# 603.351 — Capability type system

Each capability kind is distinct at compile time.

---

# 603.352 — Generic capability constraints

Functions may accept:

```axiom
fn read<T: ReadCapability>(cap: T)
```

if useful.

---

# 603.353 — Capability traits

Traits can describe:

```text
Readable
Writable
Connectable
Delegatable
Revocable
```

---

# 603.354 — Trait semantics

Capability trait does not grant authority.

It describes operations supported by an already-authorized capability.

---

# 603.355 — Struct-only integration

Capability objects are ordinary Axiom structs with runtime-managed opaque handles.

No class hierarchy required.

---

# 603.356 — Method integration

Methods:

```axiom
fn read(self: FileRead, ...)
```

follow Axiom struct-first method convention.

---

# 603.357 — Override integration

Platform-specific capability implementations can override behavior through trait/function dispatch without requiring classes.

---

# 603.358 — Dynamic dispatch

Security-critical dispatch must not rely on mutable user-controlled vtables.

---

# 603.359 — Static dispatch preference

Compile-time known capability operations should prefer static dispatch.

---

# 603.360 — Security metadata and generics

Generic functions must preserve capability requirements after monomorphization/specialization.

---

# 603.361 — Capability requirements in IR

Compiler IR includes:

```text
requires_capability
acquire_capability
attenuate_capability
release_capability
```

where needed.

---

# 603.362 — IR validation

IR verifier must reject invalid capability operations:

```text
forge
upgrade
use-after-drop
wrong-kind
```

---

# 603.363 — Linker security verification

Linker validates final capability metadata against object/module metadata.

---

# 603.364 — Loader verification

Native loader/runtime verifies signed/trusted module metadata before granting privileged capabilities where configured.

---

# 603.365 — Runtime module quarantine

Untrusted dynamic module may load into isolated process instead of same process.

---

# 603.366 — Security policy compiler output

Compact policy:

```text
.cap
```

or equivalent.

Exact extension remains implementation detail.

---

# 603.367 — Policy format version

Security policy format must be versioned independently from application config.

---

# 603.368 — Policy parser security

Parser must be:

```text
bounded
non-executable
deterministic
```

---

# 603.369 — No policy scripting

Core security policy must not execute arbitrary user scripts.

---

# 603.370 — Policy expressions

Keep policy language declarative:

```text
allow capability X
scope resource Y
deny operation Z
```

---

# 603.371 — No arbitrary code in policy

Policy evaluation cannot call application functions.

---

# 603.372 — Policy complexity

Avoid general-purpose rule engines in runtime.

---

# 603.373 — Fast path

Common decision:

```text
capability handle valid
+
resource within scope
+
operation allowed
```

→ direct allow.

---

# 603.374 — Slow path

Only complex cases use policy engine.

---

# 603.375 — Security startup cost

Startup policy compilation should be O(policy size).

---

# 603.376 — Runtime check complexity

Common resource checks should be O(1) or bounded.

---

# 603.377 — Memory footprint

Security runtime should use:

```text
immutable policy snapshot
capability table
small generation state
```

rather than heavyweight object graphs.

---

# 603.378 — No GC dependency

Security subsystem must not require garbage collection.

---

# 603.379 — Memory safety

Capability implementation must obey Axiom memory model and cannot depend on GC or borrow checker.

---

# 603.380 — Handle safety

Generation/index validation provides use-after-free protection for runtime-managed capability handles.

---

# 603.381 — Integer overflow

Capability/resource calculations must use checked arithmetic where overflow can affect security.

---

# 603.382 — Canonical resource IDs

Resources should use canonical identifiers to avoid alternate-path authorization bypasses.

---

# 603.383 — File case sensitivity

Path security adapter must respect platform case semantics.

---

# 603.384 — Unicode normalization

Filesystem/network identifiers requiring canonicalization must define Unicode normalization policy per platform.

---

# 603.385 — Homograph handling

Security policy should avoid relying on human-readable names as identity.

---

# 603.386 — DNS security

Network authorization should account for DNS resolution changes if policy is hostname-based.

---

# 603.387 — Hostname capability semantics

If capability says:

```text
api.example.com
```

implementation must define whether authority follows:

```text
hostname
resolved IP
both
```

---

# 603.388 — TLS

TLS authentication belongs to network/security libraries, while capability controls network authority.

---

# 603.389 — Certificate authority

Certificate trust configuration is separate from capability grant.

---

# 603.390 — Network identity distinction

```text
NetworkConnect
```

does not imply:

```text
trusted server
```

---

# 603.391 — File identity distinction

```text
FileRead
```

does not imply:

```text
file contents are trusted
```

---

# 603.392 — Device identity distinction

```text
DeviceAccess
```

does not imply device data is safe.

---

# 603.393 — Trust boundary input validation

Capability grants access; parser validation still required.

---

# 603.394 — Security architecture invariant

```text
authority != trustworthiness of data
```

---

# 603.395 — Security and diagnostics

BOOTSTRAP-602 records security decisions.

BOOTSTRAP-603 decides authorization.

---

# 603.396 — Security and config

BOOTSTRAP-601 provides policy inputs.

BOOTSTRAP-603 validates/executes them.

---

# 603.397 — Security and state

BOOTSTRAP-600 persists application state, never live privilege state.

---

# 603.398 — Security and compiler

Compiler proves/records declared authority requirements.

Runtime enforces actual authority.

---

# 603.399 — Security and OS

OS remains final authority for kernel-protected resources.

Axiom cannot grant more than OS allows.

---

# 603.400 — Security core invariant

The complete authority chain is:

```text
OS authority
    ↓
deployment policy
    ↓
Axiom security policy
    ↓
capability
    ↓
operation
```

A lower layer cannot increase authority beyond the upper boundary.

---

# 603.401 — Required implementation phases

### Phase 1 — Capability primitives

```text
Capability<T>
generation
opaque handle
attenuation
drop
```

### Phase 2 — Filesystem/network

```text
FileRead
FileWrite
NetworkConnect
NetworkListen
```

### Phase 3 — Process/IPC

```text
ProcessSpawn
ProcessDebug
IPC
SharedMemory
```

### Phase 4 — Compiler integration

```text
@requires
capability metadata
IR validation
linker merge
```

### Phase 5 — Platform integration

```text
Windows
Linux
macOS
iOS
Android
WASM
```

### Phase 6 — Sandboxing/trust

```text
plugin isolation
module trust
signature verification
policy enforcement
```

### Phase 7 — Advanced security

```text
revocation
quotas
audit
policy reload
security tooling
```

---

# 603.402 — Required tests

At minimum:

```text
capability forgery
wrong capability type
stale handle
revoked handle
attenuation escape
path traversal
symlink escape
network scope violation
process privilege violation
IPC unauthorized request
plugin overreach
FFI boundary
policy reload
policy corruption
secret leakage
concurrent revoke/use
```

---

# 603.403 — Cross-platform acceptance

Required targets:

```text
Windows x64
Linux x64
Linux ARM64
macOS ARM64
iOS ARM64
Android ARM64
WASM
```

Unsupported platform capability must return:

```text
NotSupported
```

not silently grant access.

---

# 603.404 — Performance acceptance

Common authorized operation must not require:

```text
string permission lookup
global mutex
dynamic policy parsing
```

on every call.

---

# 603.405 — Binary-size acceptance

Applications that do not use advanced security capabilities should not pull:

```text
policy compiler
plugin verifier
signature subsystem
advanced audit
```

into the final binary unnecessarily.

---

# 603.406 — Security acceptance

Must prove:

```text
no capability forgery
no authority escalation through attenuation
no stale capability reuse
no policy-cache bypass
no partial policy reload
no secret serialization
no silent fail-open
```

---

# 603.407 — Developer experience acceptance

Simple application:

```axiom
fn main(caps: AppCapabilities) {
    let file = caps.data.read("hello.txt")
    print(file)
}
```

should not require developers to understand the complete security engine.

---

# 603.408 — Advanced developer experience

Security-sensitive server:

```axiom
fn run(caps: ServerCapabilities) {
    let listener = caps.network.listen(443)

    spawn(worker, with = [
        caps.data.read_only()
    ])
}
```

should make authority explicit and easy to audit.

---

# 603.409 — Final architectural principle

Axiom security should follow:

> **Explicit authority, least privilege, monotonic attenuation, fail-closed enforcement, platform-native isolation, and negligible overhead when unused.**

BOOTSTRAP-603 is complete at architecture level when:

```
