# 5. Core identities

637 định nghĩa:

```text
ConfigKey
ConfigNamespace
ConfigValue
ConfigVersion
ConfigRevision
ConfigSnapshot
ConfigWatch
ConfigSource
ConfigTarget
ConfigSchema
ConfigPolicy
```

Feature:

```text
FeatureId
FeatureVersion
FeatureFlag<T>
FlagRule
FlagAssignment
FlagTarget
```

Experiment:

```text
ExperimentId
ExperimentVersion
VariantId
ExperimentAssignment
ExperimentExposure
ExperimentTarget
```

Registry:

```text
RegistryId
RegistryEntryId
RegistryRevision
RegistryNamespace
RegistryEntry
```

---

# 6. ConfigKey

```text
ConfigKey {
    namespace: ConfigNamespace
    name: String
}
```

Canonical key:

```text
global.database.timeout
cluster.eu-west.gateway.max_connections
service.orders.cache.ttl
tenant.example.feature.checkout
```

Key rules:

- UTF-8;
- case-sensitive;
- normalized;
- no ambiguous separators;
- maximum depth;
- bounded length;
- deterministic serialization.

---

# 7. Namespace hierarchy

637 hỗ trợ hierarchical scopes:

```text
global
federation
cluster
region
zone
service
service_instance
tenant
cohort
subject
```

Ví dụ:

```text
global
 └── region:europe
      └── cluster:prod-1
           └── service:orders
                └── instance:42
```

Không phải mọi loại configuration đều được phép ở mọi scope.

Mỗi schema khai báo:

```text
allowed_scopes
```

Ví dụ:

```text
database.pool_size
    global       ✓
    cluster      ✓
    service      ✓
    subject      ✗
```

---

# 8. Precedence

Precedence phải deterministic.

Mặc định:

```text
global
 < federation
 < region
 < cluster
 < zone
 < service
 < instance
 < tenant
 < cohort
 < subject
```

Nhưng schema có thể giới hạn scope.

Không được phép có hai giá trị cùng precedence mà không có conflict rule xác định.

---

# 9. Typed configuration

637 không sử dụng:

```text
get("timeout") -> String
```

làm API chính.

API chuẩn:

```text
get<T>(key: ConfigKey<T>) -> Result<T, ConfigError>
```

Ví dụ:

```text
let timeout: Duration =
    config.get(ConfigKeys.database_timeout)
```

Compiler biết kiểu:

```text
ConfigKey<Duration>
```

Do đó:

```text
config.get(ConfigKeys.database_timeout)
```

không cần runtime reflection.

---

# 10. ConfigSchema

Schema:

```text
ConfigSchema<T> {
    schema_id
    version
    fingerprint
    type
    default_value
    constraints
    allowed_scopes
    fallback_policy
    dynamic
}
```

Constraint có thể gồm:

```text
min
max
length
enum
pattern
required
nullable
```

Không cho phép constraint thực thi arbitrary code.

---

# 11. Validation

Mỗi thay đổi phải trải qua:

```text
Decode
   ↓
Schema validation
   ↓
Constraint validation
   ↓
Cross-field validation
   ↓
Policy validation
   ↓
Target validation
   ↓
Activation
```

Validation failure:

```text
new revision = rejected
active revision = unchanged
```

---

# 12. ConfigValue

ConfigValue có thể là:

```text
Bool
I8
I16
I32
I64
U8
U16
U32
U64
F32
F64
String
Bytes
Duration
Timestamp
Enum
Struct
Array
Map
SecretRef
```

Không lưu secret plaintext trong control-plane event history.

---

# 13. SecretRef

637 chỉ tham chiếu secret:

```text
SecretRef {
    secret_id
    version
}
```

Secret material được lấy qua 610/603.

Ví dụ:

```text
database.password = SecretRef("db/password", 17)
```

Không:

```text
database.password = "real-password"
```

trong distributed config store.

---

# 14. ConfigRevision

Mỗi thay đổi tạo revision mới:

```text
ConfigRevision {
    revision_id
    parent_revision
    author
    timestamp
    schema_fingerprint
    content_hash
    target
    reason
}
```

Revision immutable.

Không sửa revision cũ.

Rollback là:

```text
revision N
   ↓
new revision N+1
   ↓
content = revision N
```

Không rewrite lịch sử.

---

# 15. Compare-and-Swap

API:

```text
update(
    key,
    expected_revision,
    new_value
)
```

Nếu:

```text
expected_revision != current_revision
```

thì:

```text
Conflict
```

Không silently overwrite.

---

# 16. Atomic batch update

637 hỗ trợ:

```text
ConfigTransaction
```

Ví dụ:

```text
transaction {
    set(A, 10)
    set(B, 20)
    delete(C)
}
```

Activation:

```text
prepare
validate
commit
publish
```

Consumers chỉ nhìn thấy:

```text
revision N
```

hoặc:

```text
revision N+1
```

Không nhìn thấy trạng thái giữa transaction.

---

# 17. Snapshot

```text
ConfigSnapshot {
    generation
    revision
    created_at
    expires_at
    values
}
```

Application có thể giữ:

```text
snapshot = config.snapshot()
```

Sau đó đọc nhiều lần mà không cần lock/control-plane round trip.

---

# 18. Hot-path rule

Không khuyến khích:

```text
for item in items {
    if config.get(flag) {
        ...
    }
}
```

nếu `get()` tạo synchronization hoặc lookup control plane.

Thay vào đó:

```text
let snapshot = config.snapshot()

for item in items {
    if snapshot.feature_x {
        ...
    }
}
```

Hoặc:

```text
let flag = config.bind(FeatureFlags.feature_x)

for item in items {
    if flag.value() {
        ...
    }
}
```

Read path mục tiêu:

```text
O(1)
```

và không cần global mutex.

---

# 19. Watch

```text
ConfigWatch<T> {
    current()
    next()
    close()
}
```

Watch có thể theo:

```text
key
prefix
namespace
target
schema
```

Ví dụ:

```text
watch("service.orders.*")
```

---

# 20. Initial snapshot semantics

Watch luôn có:

```text
InitialSnapshot
```

sau đó:

```text
Change
Change
Change
...
```

Consumer không phải race giữa:

```text
read()
```

và:

```text
watch()
```

---

# 21. Revision monotonicity

Một watch stream phải đảm bảo:

```text
revision(n+1) > revision(n)
```

Nếu phát hiện gap:

```text
revision 100
revision 104
```

watcher phải:

```text
resync
```

trừ khi provider chứng minh được các revision bị bỏ qua không ảnh hưởng tới target.

---

# 22. Watch backpressure

Watch queue có giới hạn.

Khi overflow:

```text
GapDetected
```

thay vì vô hạn queue.

Consumer phải resync snapshot.

---

# 23. Change coalescing

Có thể coalesce:

```text
A=1
A=2
A=3
A=4
```

thành:

```text
A=4
```

chỉ khi semantics của watcher cho phép bỏ qua intermediate states.

Watcher yêu cầu every revision sẽ không được coalesce.

---

# 24. Stale configuration

Snapshot có:

```text
fresh
stale
expired
invalid
```

Một config schema khai báo:

```text
max_staleness
```

Ví dụ:

```text
max_staleness = 30s
```

---

# 25. Fallback policy

Mỗi dynamic configuration có thể khai báo:

```text
UseLastKnownGood
UseStaticDefault
FailOpen
FailClosed
RejectStartup
```

Ví dụ security-sensitive operational switch:

```text
FailClosed
```

Trong khi UI cosmetic feature:

```text
UseStaticDefault
```

---

# 26. Feature Flags

637 hỗ trợ:

```text
FeatureFlag<bool>
FeatureFlag<Enum>
FeatureFlag<String>
FeatureFlag<Struct>
FeatureFlag<Numeric>
```

Ví dụ:

```text
feature.new_renderer
feature.video_encoder
feature.experimental_pipeline
```

---

# 27. Flag states

Mỗi flag có:

```text
enabled
disabled
targeted
expired
blocked
```

`blocked` có priority cao hơn targeting.

---

# 28. Kill switch

Kill switch là flag đặc biệt:

```text
KillSwitch<T>
```

Properties:

```text
default_safe_value
activation_priority
scope
expiration
```

Mục tiêu:

```text
disable dangerous feature
```

mà không cần deployment.

---

# 29. Targeting

Targeting rule có thể kiểm tra:

```text
region
cluster
zone
service
service_version
release
instance
tenant
cohort
device_class
platform
architecture
declared_labels
```

Không tự động thu thập PII.

---

# 30. Declarative targeting language

Ví dụ:

```text
target {
    region == "asia"
    && service_version >= "5.2"
}
```

Nhưng expression chỉ là declarative AST.

Không được:

```text
target {
    execute(...)
}
```

Không có:

```text
network()
file()
spawn()
random()
clock()
```

trong targeting expression.

---

# 31. Expression complexity

Target expression phải có giới hạn:

```text
max_nodes
max_depth
max_string_length
max_collection_size
max_evaluation_steps
```

Nếu vượt:

```text
TargetEvaluationLimit
```

---

# 32. Percentage rollout

637 hỗ trợ:

```text
10%
25%
50%
100%
```

Assignment deterministic:

```text
bucket =
    hash(
        experiment_or_flag_id,
        subject_key,
        salt
    ) % 10000
```

Ví dụ:

```text
0..9999
```

với:

```text
10% = 0..999
```

---

# 33. Stable assignment

Nếu:

```text
experiment_id
subject_key
salt
```

không thay đổi thì assignment không thay đổi.

Điều này tránh:

```text
request 1 → variant A
request 2 → variant B
```

không chủ ý.

---

# 34. Allocation

Variant allocation:

```text
A = 5000
B = 3000
C = 2000
```

Tổng:

```text
10000
```

Nếu tổng không hợp lệ:

```text
InvalidAllocation
```

---

# 35. Experiment

```text
Experiment<T> {
    id
    version
    variants
    targeting
    allocation
    subject_key
    salt
    start
    end
}
```

Assignment:

```text
ExperimentAssignment {
    experiment_id
    experiment_version
    subject_key_hash
    variant_id
}
```

Không lưu raw subject identity nếu không cần.

---

# 36. Exposure event

Khi application thực sự sử dụng variant:

```text
ExperimentExposure {
    experiment_id
    variant_id
    assignment_revision
    timestamp
    context
}
```

Exposure gửi tới 633/634.

Assignment và exposure là hai sự kiện khác nhau.

---

# 37. Không tự động quyết định winner

Core 637 chỉ cung cấp:

```text
assignment
exposure
measurement hooks
```

Không tự động:

```text
declare_winner()
```

Không có built-in statistical decision engine.

Ứng dụng hoặc hệ thống phân tích bên ngoài có thể xử lý telemetry.

---

# 38. Mutually Exclusive Experiments

637 hỗ trợ:

```text
ExperimentGroup
```

Ví dụ:

```text
CheckoutExperiment
PaymentExperiment
```

Nếu cùng thuộc group:

```text
subject → chỉ nhận một experiment
```

Assignment deterministic.

---

# 39. Experiment lifecycle

```text
Draft
↓
Validated
↓
Scheduled
↓
Running
↓
Paused
↓
Completed
↓
Archived
```

Không xóa lịch sử assignment.

---

# 40. Dynamic Operational Policy

637 có thể điều khiển:

```text
timeouts
retry counts
retry backoff
circuit breaker thresholds
connection limits
cache TTL
worker counts
queue limits
sampling rates
log levels
compression level
batch size
event retention
scheduler tuning
```

Ví dụ:

```text
policy.orders.request_timeout = 2s
```

---

# 41. Security policy boundary

637 không tự cấp quyền.

Không hợp lệ:

```text
config.security.allow_filesystem = true
```

nếu việc đó tạo capability mới.

Authority vẫn thuộc:

```text
603 Security Runtime
```

637 chỉ có thể:

```text
reference_policy
request_policy_revision
```

và phải được 603 chấp thuận.

---

# 42. Dynamic policy precedence

Operational policy có precedence:

```text
platform
→ federation
→ cluster
→ region
→ service
→ instance
```

Nhưng schema có thể giới hạn.

Policy conflict phải được phát hiện trước activation.

---

# BOOTSTRAP-638
## Native Distributed Secrets, Key Rotation, Certificate Rotation, Identity Rotation, Trust Registry & Global Credential Lifecycle Runtime 5.0

**Status:** COMPLETE  
**Layer:** Distributed Trust & Credential Control Plane

# 1. Mục tiêu

BOOTSTRAP-638 xây dựng lớp quản lý **credential lifecycle phân tán** của Axiom.

Nó quản lý vòng đời:

- secret;
- encryption key;
- signing key;
- certificate;
- certificate chain;
- service identity;
- workload identity;

Mục tiêu quan trọng:

637 quản lý:


```text
"ứng dụng được phép chứng minh mình là ai bằng credential nào?"
```

# 4. Core principles

638 phải tuân thủ:

1. Secret material không phải config.
2. Private key không được xuất plaintext nếu provider không cho phép.
3. Key identity khác key material.
4. Credential version immutable.
5. Rotation tạo version mới.
6. Không overwrite credential đang active.
7. Revocation không xóa lịch sử.
8. Expiry phải deterministic.
9. Stale credential phải bị fencing khi policy yêu cầu.
10. Control plane không được yêu cầu private key phải rời hardware-backed provider nếu không cần.
11. Credential distribution phải least-privilege.
12. Credential scope phải explicit.

# 250. Runtime invariant set

638 phải đảm bảo tối thiểu:

1. Raw secrets không xuất hiện trong ordinary metadata.
2. Private keys không export nếu policy cấm.
3. Key version immutable.
4. Credential revision immutable.
5. Rotation không overwrite active version.
6. Compromised credential không tự active lại.
7. Revoked credential không trở lại active.
8. Stale issuer bị fencing.
9. Identity generation monotonic.
10. Trust revision monotonic.
11. Credential purpose explicit.
12. Credential scope explicit.
13. Distribution authorization bắt buộc.
14. Security policy không thể bị 637 override.
15. Hardware-backed requirement không bị software fallback bypass.
16. Rotation retry idempotent.
17. Issuance retry idempotent.
18. Emergency revoke không chờ normal schedule.
19. Expiry risk được ưu tiên.
20. Zero-downtime rotation hỗ trợ overlap.
21. Existing sessions có grace semantics explicit.
22. Trust-anchor rotation hỗ trợ staged migration.
23. Old trust anchor chỉ remove khi policy cho phép.
24. Credential history không bị xóa bởi rollback.
25. Destruction không xóa audit metadata nếu retention yêu cầu.
26. Secret event payload không chứa secret.
27. Credential cache không tự tạo authority.
28. Control-plane outage không tự tạo new authority.
29. Provider failure không tự export prohibited key.
30. Offline credentials phải có expiry/delegation.
31. Edge issuer phải có fencing.
32. Cross-domain trust phải explicit.
33. Trust không transitive mặc định.
34. Tenant credentials không cross-read.
35. Credential generation gắn với identity generation khi policy yêu cầu.
36. Certificate validation không bị bỏ qua bởi lifecycle layer.
37. Algorithm policy phải được enforce.
38. Key purpose không tự mở rộng.
39. Distribution state phải observable.
40. Partial rollout không báo completed giả.
41. Rotation controller phải bounded.
42. Provider calls phải resource-governed.
43. Watchers phải bounded.
44. Credential lookup hot path không cần distributed RPC.
45. No mandatory GC.
46. No mandatory third-party credential runtime.
47. Provider abstraction phải stable.
48. Test provider không được mặc định production-trusted.
49. Emergency override phải audit.
50. Break-glass authority phải time-bounded.
51. Delegation không được widen scope.
52. Child credential expiry không vượt parent.
53. Parent revocation propagates theo policy.
54. Signed bundles chống replay.
55. Timestamp không phải sole ordering primitive.
56. Rotation schedule có jitter.
57. Large-scale rotation không tạo thundering herd.
58. Provider rate limits phải được tôn trọng.
59. Recovery phải verify trust.
60. Credential state phải reconcile với provider state.

BOOTSTRAP-638 tạo ra một nguyên tắc quan trọng cho toàn bộ Axiom distributed runtime:

```text
637 = dynamic behavior
638 = dynamic trust
603 = authority
610 = cryptography
627 = identity/authentication semantics
635 = control-plane authority
636 = deployment orchestration
```

Như vậy Axiom không biến secret, certificate, key và identity thành những biến configuration thông thường.

Luồng chuẩn:

```text
                 ┌──────────────┐
                 │    637       │
                 │ Runtime Ctrl  │
                 └──────┬───────┘
                        │ policy
                        ▼
                 ┌──────────────┐
                 │    638       │
                 │ Credential   │
                 │ Lifecycle    │
                 └──────┬───────┘
                        │
             ┌──────────┼──────────┐
             ▼          ▼          ▼
            610        603        627
          Crypto     Authority   Identity
             │
             ▼
       Hardware / OS / CA
             │
             ▼
       631 / 632 / Services
```

Điểm cốt lõi:

> **Credential rotation là một lifecycle operation, không phải một configuration update.**

---

# 266. Trạng thái

**BOOTSTRAP-638 = COMPLETE**

Đã xác định đầy đủ:

- distributed secret lifecycle;
- key lifecycle;
- hardware-backed keys;
- certificate issuance/renewal;
- certificate zero-downtime rotation;
- identity lifecycle;
- workload/device identity;
- trust registry;
- trust-domain model;
- trust-anchor rotation;
- credential versioning;
- credential leases;
- revocation;
- emergency revocation;
- delegation;
- fencing;
- issuer epochs;
- credential distribution;
- offline/edge credentials;
- federation;
- provider architecture;
- rotation orchestration;
- progressive credential rollout;
- disaster recovery;
- compiler integration;
- CLI;
- AI-readable metadata;
- security invariants;
- performance;
- resource governance;
- testing;
- ≥350 acceptance criteria target.

**Task tiếp theo: BOOTSTRAP-639 — Native Distributed Policy Decision, Policy Evaluation, Rule Engine, Admission Control, Governance, Compliance Guardrails & Declarative Authorization Runtime 5.0.**

Tiếp tục với **BOOTSTRAP-639 — Native Distributed Policy Decision, Policy Evaluation, Rule Engine, Admission Control, Governance, Compliance Guardrails & Declarative Authorization Runtime 5.0**.

:::writing{variant="document" id="58314" title="BOOTSTRAP-639 — Native Distributed Policy Decision, Policy Evaluation, Rule Engine, Admission Control, Governance, Compliance Guardrails & Declarative Authorization Runtime 5.0"}
# BOOTSTRAP-639
## Native Distributed Policy Decision, Policy Evaluation, Rule Engine, Admission Control, Governance, Compliance Guardrails & Declarative Authorization Runtime 5.0

**Status:** COMPLETE  
**Layer:** Distributed Policy & Governance Plane  
**Depends on:** BOOTSTRAP-600 → BOOTSTRAP-638

---

# 1. Mục tiêu

BOOTSTRAP-639 xây dựng **policy decision engine** native của Axiom.

Nó chịu trách nhiệm:

- policy evaluation;
- authorization decision;
- admission control;
- operational governance;
- resource admission;
- service access rules;
- deployment guardrails;
- data access rules;
- tenant isolation;
- environment restrictions;
- credential usage constraints;
- dynamic policy evaluation;
- distributed policy distribution;
- policy versioning;
- policy rollout;
- policy simulation;
- policy audit;
- policy explanation.

Mục tiêu kiến trúc:

> **Policy phải là dữ liệu khai báo có thể kiểm chứng, không phải một chương trình tùy ý chạy trong control plane.**

639 vì vậy **không trở thành một scripting engine thứ hai**.

---

# 2. Ranh giới với các hệ thống trước

| Hệ thống | Vai trò |
|---|---|
| 603 | capability/security boundary |
| 610 | cryptography |
| 627 | identity/authentication |
| 637 | dynamic configuration/control values |
| 638 | credential/trust lifecycle |
| 639 | policy decision/evaluation |
| 635 | cluster/control-plane coordination |
| 636 | deployment orchestration |
| 606 | resource enforcement |
| 631 | service execution |
| 632 | edge execution |
| 633 | telemetry |
| 634 | events |

Điểm quan trọng:

```text
637 = giá trị runtime
639 = quyết định policy
603 = authority enforcement
```

Ví dụ:

```text
637:
request_timeout = 5s

639:
service A may call service B = true

603:
caller possesses capability X = true

631:
perform request
```

---

# 3. Không biến policy thành arbitrary code

Core policy language **không cho phép**:

- filesystem access;
- network access;
- arbitrary function calls;
- dynamic library loading;
- process creation;
- thread creation;
- mutable global state;
- unbounded loops;
- recursion không giới hạn;
- random numbers;
- wall-clock access tùy ý;
- secret extraction.

Policy phải là:

```text
Input
 ↓
Deterministic Evaluation
 ↓
Decision
```

---

# 4. Kiến trúc

```text
                         ┌───────────────────────┐
                         │   Application/Service  │
                         └───────────┬───────────┘
                                     │
                               Policy Request
                                     │
                         ┌───────────▼───────────┐
                         │       639 Runtime     │
                         ├───────────────────────┤
                         │ Policy Registry        │
                         │ Policy Compiler        │
                         │ Policy Evaluator      │
                         │ Decision Cache         │
                         │ Admission Controller  │
                         │ Governance Engine     │
                         │ Explain Engine        │
                         │ Simulation Engine     │
                         │ Rollout Controller    │
                         └───────────┬───────────┘
                                     │
       ┌──────────────┬──────────────┼──────────────┬──────────────┐
       ▼              ▼              ▼              ▼              ▼
      603            627            637            638            635
   Capability       Identity       Dynamic        Trust          Control
                                    Config
       │              │              │              │              │
       └──────────────┴──────────────┴──────────────┴──────────────┘
                                     │
                                     ▼
                               606 / 631 / 632
```

---

# 5. Core principles

1. Default deny đối với security-sensitive decisions.
2. Policy phải typed.
3. Policy revision immutable.
4. Evaluation deterministic trong cùng input snapshot.
5. Policy snapshot immutable.
6. Policy rollout atomic theo scope.
7. Policy update không cần restart application.
8. Policy engine không tự cấp capability.
9. Policy không được nâng authority.
10. Policy không được bypass 603.
11. Security policy có precedence cao hơn operational policy.
12. Policy evaluation phải bounded.
13. Không có arbitrary code execution.
14. Không bắt buộc GC.
15. Hot-path evaluation phải low allocation.
16. Distributed policy phải có version/revision.
17. Stale policy phải có semantics explicit.
18. Fail-open/fail-closed phải được khai báo.
19. Policy decision phải explainable.
20. Policy changes phải audit được.

---

# 6. Policy model

```text
Policy {
    policy_id
    namespace
    version
    revision
    schema
    priority
    scope
    rules
    defaults
    activation
    expiration
}
```

---

# 7. Policy identity

```text
PolicyId
PolicyVersion
PolicyRevision
PolicyGeneration
```

Ví dụ:

```text
policy = service-access
revision = 1842
generation = 12
```

Revision không được tái sử dụng.

---

# 8. Policy scope

Các scope:

```text
Global
Federation
Cluster
Region
Zone
Service
Workload
Device
Tenant
User
Session
Request
```

---

# 9. Scope precedence

Policy có thể kế thừa:

```text
Global
  ↓
Federation
  ↓
Cluster
  ↓
Region
  ↓
Service
  ↓
Workload
  ↓
Tenant
  ↓
Request
```

Nhưng quyền cao hơn không thể bị scope thấp hơn mở rộng ngoài authority.

---

# 10. Policy composition

Có ba kiểu:

```text
Override
Merge
Restrict
```

Security-sensitive policy mặc định:

```text
Restrict
```

---

# 11. Restrictive composition

Nếu global:

```text
allow TLS >= 1.3
```

local không thể:

```text
allow TLS 1.0
```

---

# 12. Policy priority

Mỗi policy có:

```text

```

nhưng priority không được phép vượt security boundary.

---

# 13. Decision model

Core:

```text
PolicyDecision {
    result
    reason
    policy_id
    revision
    obligations
    constraints
}
```

---

# 14. Decision results

```text
Allow
Deny
Challenge
Indeterminate
Unavailable
NotApplicable
```

---

# 15. Challenge

Ví dụ:

```text
MFA required
additional capability required
step-up authentication required
```

639 chỉ trả decision.

627/ứng dụng thực hiện challenge.

---

# 16. Indeterminate

Dùng khi:

```text
required attribute unavailable
policy dependency missing
evaluation error
```

Không tự động chuyển thành Allow.

---

# 17. Unavailable

Ví dụ policy registry unavailable.

Decision phải phụ thuộc:

```text
availability_mode
```

---

# 18. Availability modes

```text
FailClosed
FailOpen
UseLastKnownGood
UseStaticDefault
DenyOnUnknown
```

Security policy mặc định:

```text
FailClosed
```

---

# 19. Request model

```text
PolicyRequest {
    request_id
    action
    resource
    subject
    environment
    attributes
    capabilities
    identity
    policy_snapshot
}
```

---

# 20. Subject

```text
Subject {
    subject_id
    identity
    type
    attributes
}
```

Có thể là:

```text
User
Service
Workload
Device
Tenant
System
Anonymous
```

---

# 21. Resource

```text
Resource {
    resource_id
    resource_type
    owner
    scope
    attributes
}
```

---

# 22. Action

Action phải typed:

```text
Read
Write
Create
Update
Delete
Execute
Publish
Subscribe
Deploy
Rotate
Admin
```

Ứng dụng có thể định nghĩa domain-specific actions.

---

# 23. Resource-action pair

Policy nên evaluate:

```text
(subject, action, resource, context)
```

không chỉ:

```text

```

---

# 24. Context

Context có thể chứa:

```text
cluster
region
service_version
deployment_revision
network_zone
device_type
tenant
request_type
risk_metadata
```

Chỉ attributes được explicit provision mới được sử dụng.

---

# 25. No hidden context

Policy không tự truy cập:

```text
filesystem
environment variables
process memory
network
```

để lấy context.

---

# 26. Policy attribute model

Typed:

```text
String
Bool
Int
UInt
Float
Enum
Duration
Timestamp
Version
IpAddress
Network
Identifier
Set<T>
Map<K,V>
```

---

# 27. Attribute absence

Ba-state:

```text
Present
Absent
Invalid
```

không ép:

```text
Absent → false
```

một cách mơ hồ.

---

# 28. Attribute source

Mỗi attribute có source:

```text
Request
Identity
Capability
Config
Credential
Cluster
Deployment
Resource
System
```

---

# 29. Attribute trust level

```text
Untrusted
Authenticated
Verified
Attested
SystemGenerated
```

Policy có thể yêu cầu minimum trust.

---

# 30. Policy expression language

Ví dụ:

```text
when
    subject.type == Service
    and action == Read
    and resource.type == Document
then
    allow
```

---

# 31. Operators

Core:

```text
==
!=
<
<=
>
>=
in
not_in
contains
starts_with
ends_with
matches
exists
is_null
```

Regex nếu hỗ trợ phải bounded.

---

# 32. Boolean operators

```text
and
or
not
```

---

# 33. Set operations

```text
contains
subset_of
intersects
```

Giới hạn kích thước để tránh DoS.

---

# 34. No arbitrary functions

Không:

```text
call(my_function())
```

trong policy core.

Chỉ built-in pure functions đã định nghĩa.

---

# 35. Built-in functions

Có thể có:

```text
hash
normalize
parse_version
ip_in_network
time_window
set_contains
```

Tất cả phải deterministic/bounded.

---

# 36. Hash function

Hash dùng cho:

- stable targeting;
- deterministic sampling;
- cohort assignment.

Không dùng hash policy như cryptographic primitive.

Crypto thuộc 610.

---

# 37. Time semantics

Policy có thể sử dụng:

```text
request.timestamp
```

đã được host cung cấp.

Không tự gọi system clock.

---

# 38. Version comparison

Native:

```text
version >= 2.4
```

phải có semantic rõ ràng.

---

# 39. IP/network matching

```text
ip in 10.0.0.0/8
```

phải parse canonical.

---

# 40. Rule

```text
Rule {
    id
    condition
    effect
    priority
    obligations
}
```

---

# 41. Effects

```text
Allow
Deny
Challenge
Limit
Transform
Route
Require
```

Security core ưu tiên:

```text
Allow/Deny/Challenge
```

Operational policies có thể sử dụng các effect khác.

---

# 42. Obligations

Ví dụ:

```text
audit = required
mfa = required
rate_limit = 100/s
timeout <= 5s
encryption = required
```

---

# 43. Constraints

Decision có thể trả:

```text
Constraint {
    name
    value
}
```

Ví dụ:

```text
max_response_bytes = 10MB
```

---

# 44. Constraint enforcement

639 phát decision.

Subsystem tương ứng thực thi:

```text
606 → resource
631 → service
632 → gateway
603 → capability
610 → crypto
```

---

# 45. Policy evaluation pipeline

```text
Receive
 ↓
Authenticate context
 ↓
Load snapshot
 ↓
Validate request
 ↓
Evaluate rules
 ↓
Resolve conflicts
 ↓
Apply obligations
 ↓
Produce decision
 ↓
Audit/telemetry
```

---

# 46. Policy snapshot

```text
PolicySnapshot {
    revision
    policies
    schema_fingerprint
    activation_epoch
}
```

Immutable.

---

# 47. Atomic activation

Policy revision mới:

```text
prepare
→ validate
→ compile
→ verify
→ activate
```

Nếu fail:

```text
old snapshot remains active
```

---

# 48. Compiled policy

Policy compiler có thể tạo:

```text
PolicyIR
PolicyBytecode
DecisionDAG
CompiledMatcher
```

---

# 49. Native policy compilation

Production profile có thể compile policy thành native decision code.

Mục tiêu:

```text
low latency
low allocation
predictable execution
```

---

# 50. No JIT requirement

Policy runtime không bắt buộc JIT.

Có thể:

```text
compile-time
install-time
runtime precompile
```

---

# 51. Policy IR

IR node:

```text
LoadAttribute
Compare
SetTest
And
Or
Not
Branch
Decision
Obligation
Constraint
```

---

# 52. Policy optimizer

Có thể:

```text
constant folding
dead rule elimination
predicate factoring
decision tree optimization
attribute prefetch planning
```

---

# 53. Short-circuit

```text
false AND X
```

không cần evaluate X.

```text
true OR X
```

không cần evaluate X.

---

# 54. Rule ordering

Compiler có thể reorder pure predicates nếu semantics giữ nguyên.

Nếu có side-effect obligations:

```text
preserve semantic order
```

---

# 55. Bounded evaluation

Policy phải có:

```text
max_rules
max_expression_depth
max_set_size
max_string_size
max_regex_cost
max_evaluation_steps
```

---

# 56. Evaluation budget

```text
EvaluationBudget {
    max_steps
    max_bytes
    max_depth
    deadline
}
```

---

# 57. Evaluation timeout

Nếu vượt budget:

```text
Indeterminate
```

không tự Allow.

---

# 58. Policy recursion

Core không cho recursion.

Nếu future extension hỗ trợ:

```text
explicit max_depth
```

---

# 59. Policy imports

Policy có thể import:

```text
policy module
```

nhưng import graph phải acyclic.

---

# 60. Policy modules

```text
PolicyModule {
    module_id
    version
    exports
    imports
    fingerprint
}
```

---

# 61. Policy package

638/625 package policy có:

```text
policy schema
compiler version
dependency versions
fingerprints
signature
```

---

# 62. Signed policy

Production policy có thể yêu cầu:

```text
signed = true
```

---

# 63. Policy publisher

```text
PublisherId
PolicySigningKeyId
PolicyRevision
```

---

# 64. Policy trust

Policy chỉ active nếu:

```text
signature valid
publisher trusted
schema compatible
scope authorized
revision valid
```

---

# 65. Policy rollback

Rollback phải là:

```text
new revision
```

tham chiếu revision cũ.

Không mutate history.

---

# 66. Policy history

```text
Revision 100
Revision 101
Revision 102
Revision 103
```

Mỗi revision immutable.

---

# 67. Compare-and-swap

Update:

```text
update(policy, expected_revision=102)
```

Nếu current != 102:

```text
Conflict
```

---

# 68. Policy transactions

Có thể atomically thay đổi:

```text
policy A
policy B
policy C
```

trong cùng namespace.

---

# 69. Cross-policy transaction

Không mặc định atomic across clusters.

Distributed transaction nếu cần thuộc higher-level orchestration.

---

# 70. Policy dependency

Policy có thể khai báo:

```text
requires policy X revision >= 20
```

---

# 71. Dependency validation

Activation chỉ thành công nếu dependencies satisfy constraints.

---

# 72. Policy rollout

Strategies:

```text
All
Rolling
Canary
Wave
Region
Cluster
Tenant
ServiceVersion
```

---

# 73. Policy canary

Một policy revision có thể áp dụng:

```text
1%
10%
50%
100%
```

---

# 74. Policy targeting

Targeting attributes:

```text
cluster
region
zone
service
version
tenant
device
cohort
labels
```

---

# 75. Targeting hash

```text
bucket =
hash(policy_id, subject_key, salt) % 10000
```

Stable.

---

# 76. No raw PII requirement

Subject key nên là:

```text
opaque stable identifier
```

không cần raw email/name.

---

# 77. Privacy

639 không thu thập PII mặc định.

Attributes phải được explicit provision.

---

# 78. Policy evaluation cache

Cache key:

```text
policy_revision
subject_context_fingerprint
resource
action
```

---

# 79. Cache invalidation

Policy revision change phải invalidate hoặc version-bypass cache.

---

# 80. Negative cache

Deny decisions có thể cache nếu:

```text
policy
context
TTL
```

an toàn.

---

# 81. Positive cache

Allow cache phải có TTL và policy revision.

Security-sensitive allow không được tồn tại vô hạn.

---

# 82. Decision cache poisoning

Cache entry phải gắn:

```text
policy_fingerprint

```

---

# 83. Local evaluator

Mỗi service có thể embed:

```text
PolicyEvaluator
```

để tránh network round-trip.

---

# 84. Central evaluator

Có thể có:

```text
PolicyDecisionService
```

cho policies cần centralized control.

---

# 85. Hybrid evaluation

Preferred:

```text
central policy distribution
+
local deterministic evaluation
```

---

# 86. Data-plane independence

Service không nên phụ thuộc network call cho mọi authorization decision.

Policy snapshot local phải hỗ trợ operation khi control plane tạm unavailable.

---

# 87. Staleness

Snapshot có:

```text
issued_at
expires_at
max_staleness
```

---

# 88. Stale policy

Nếu snapshot quá cũ:

```text
FailClosed
FailOpen
UseLastKnownGood
```

theo policy.

---

# 89. Security vs operational policy

Security:

```text
default fail closed
```

Operational tuning:

```text
policy-specific availability mode
```

---

# 90. Admission control

639 cung cấp:

```text
AdmissionController
```

cho:

- deploy;
- service activation;
- resource allocation;
- workload placement;
- API requests;
- tenant operations;
- plugin loading;
- package installation.

---

# 91. Admission request

```text
AdmissionRequest {
    actor
    operation
    object
    requested_resources
    environment
    context
}
```

---

# 92. Admission decision

```text
Admit
Reject
Defer
RequireApproval
```

---

# 93. Resource admission

606 cung cấp:

```text
available resources
```

639 quyết định:

```text
policy allows?
```

606 quyết định:

```text
resource available?
```

---

# 94. Deployment admission

636 gửi:

```text
release
target
resource_delta
risk_metadata
```

639 trả:

```text
allow
deny
require_approval
```

---

# 95. Placement admission

635 có thể hỏi:

```text
can workload run on node?
```

639 evaluate policy constraints.

635 vẫn quyết định placement.

---

# 96. Package admission

625 có thể hỏi:

```text
is package allowed in this environment?
```

639 evaluate:

```text
publisher
signature
target
capabilities
policy
```

---

# 97. Plugin admission

623:

```text
plugin load request
```

639:

```text
publisher
permissions
ABI
environment
```

---

# 98. Credential admission

638:

```text
issue credential?
```

603 vẫn controls authority.

---

# 99. Network admission

632/631:

```text
service call
```

603 enforces capability.

---

# 100. Double authorization

Không được nhầm:

```text
639 decision
```

với:

```text
603 capability
```

Một operation cần cả hai nếu policy yêu cầu:

```text
CapabilityPresent
AND
PolicyAllows
```

---

# 101. Security composition

Effective authorization:

```text
Capability
AND
Identity
AND
Policy
AND
ResourceState
```

---

# 102. Capability cannot be granted by policy

639 không thể:

```text
create capability
```

chỉ có thể:

```text
require capability
```

---

# 103. Policy cannot widen capability

Nếu 603 deny:

```text
network.connect
```

639 allow không override được.

---

# 104. Governance policy

Operational governance examples:

```text
production deployment requires signed release
GPU workload requires approved image
external network requires declared capability
database migration requires backup
```

---

# 105. Guardrails

Guardrail:

```text
Guardrail {
    condition
    violation
    severity
    action
}
```

Actions:

```text
Reject
Warn
RequireApproval
Quarantine
Defer
```

# 2. Ranh giới kiến trúc

| Hệ thống | Trách nhiệm |
|---|---|
| 611 | filesystem/storage |
| 612 | serialization/schema |
| 628 | distributed data/replication |
| 637 | dynamic configuration |
| 638 | credentials/trust |
| 639 | policy decision |
| **640** | data governance/lifecycle |
| 633 | telemetry |
| 634 | events |
| 636 | deployment |
| 603 | capability enforcement |

Điểm quan trọng:

```text
628 = data distribution
639 = policy decision
640 = data governance
```

640 **không thay thế** 639.

Ví dụ:

```text
640:
dataset classification = Confidential
residency = VN
retention = 365 days

639:
may service A read dataset X?

603:
does service A possess required capability?

628:
where/how is dataset replicated?
```

# 3. Nguyên tắc nền tảng

1. Data governance metadata không phải data payload.
2. Classification phải explicit.
3. Không tự suy đoán sensitivity trong core.
4. Ownership phải explicit.
5. Lineage phải provenance-aware.
6. Residency phải enforceable qua policy/placement layers.
7. Retention phải deterministic.
8. Deletion phải distinguish logical/physical deletion.
9. Replication không được tự động phá residency policy.
10. Governance không tự cấp capability.
11. 640 không đọc dữ liệu tùy ý để phân loại.
12. Privacy transformation phải explicit.
13. Raw sensitive data không xuất hiện trong metadata nếu không cần.
14. Lineage metadata phải bounded.
15. Governance history phải immutable/auditable.
16. Data lifecycle state phải observable.
17. Policy revisions phải xác định.
18. Cross-tenant data movement phải explicit.
19. Governance failure phải có semantics rõ ràng.
20. Core không tuyên bố compliance certification.

# BOOTSTRAP-641
## Native Distributed Search, Indexing, Query Planning, Full-Text Search, Vector Search, Hybrid Retrieval & Query Execution Runtime 5.0

**Status:** COMPLETE  
**Layer:** Distributed Search & Query Execution Plane  
**Depends on:** BOOTSTRAP-600 → BOOTSTRAP-640

---

# 1. Mục tiêu

BOOTSTRAP-641 cung cấp search/query runtime native cho Axiom.

Nó bao phủ:

- indexing;
- structured query;
- full-text search;
- lexical search;
- vector search;
- approximate nearest neighbor;
- hybrid retrieval;
- filtering;
- faceting;
- aggregation;
- sorting;
- pagination;
- distributed query planning;
- shard routing;
- parallel execution;
- query cancellation;
- streaming results;
- ranking;
- scoring;
- highlighting;
- result merging;
- index lifecycle;
- incremental indexing;
- snapshot/recovery;
- query cache;
- index cache;
- data locality;
- schema-aware search;
- data governance-aware retrieval.

Mục tiêu kiến trúc:

> Axiom có thể xây dựng database search, document search, log search, code search, semantic/vector search và AI retrieval mà không bắt buộc Elasticsearch, Solr, OpenSearch, Milvus, FAISS hoặc hệ thống search bên ngoài.

External search engines vẫn được hỗ trợ như provider.

# 3. Core principles

1. Query phải typed.
2. Query plan phải deterministic.
3. Index không phải source of truth.
4. Search result không được coi là authoritative data.
5. Index có thể rebuild từ source.
6. Query cancellation phải propagate.
7. Distributed query phải bounded.
8. Không yêu cầu global transaction.
9. Ranking phải explicit.
10. Vector similarity phải explicit metric.
11. ANN là approximation, không giả định exact.
12. Hybrid ranking phải deterministic khi inputs giống nhau.
13. Governance policy phải được áp dụng trước khi trả kết quả.
14. Index không được bypass 640.
15. Search authorization vẫn thuộc 639 + 603.
16. Query engine không cần GC.
17. Hot path hạn chế allocation.
18. External engine chỉ là provider.
19. Core query execution không phụ thuộc scripting.
20. Query resource budgets là bắt buộc.

36. Query fingerprints do not expose raw sensitive query text.

# 3. Core principles

1. Columnar execution là first-class.
2. Vectorized execution là mặc định cho analytical workloads.
3. Row-oriented data vẫn được hỗ trợ.
4. Query plan phải typed.
5. Logical plan tách khỏi physical plan.
6. Execution phải streaming/chunked.
7. Không yêu cầu toàn bộ dataset nằm trong RAM.
8. Aggregation phải có bounded-memory mode.
9. Distributed execution phải deterministic khi semantics yêu cầu.
10. Partial aggregation được ưu tiên.
11. Predicate pushdown được ưu tiên.
12. Projection pushdown được ưu tiên.
13. Statistics không được làm thay đổi semantics.
14. Approximate analytics phải khai báo approximation.
15. GPU là acceleration provider, không phải dependency.
16. SQL là compatibility boundary, không phải semantic foundation.
17. DataFrame là typed API, không phải dynamic scripting system.
18. Không bắt buộc GC.
19. Không yêu cầu Python.
20. Không yêu cầu pandas/Polars/Arrow/Spark/DuckDB.
21. External engines chỉ là provider/adaptor.

---

# 3. Core principles

1. Columnar execution là first-class.
2. Vectorized execution là mặc định cho analytical workloads.
3. Row-oriented data vẫn được hỗ trợ.
4. Query plan phải typed.
5. Logical plan tách khỏi physical plan.
6. Execution phải streaming/chunked.
7. Không yêu cầu toàn bộ dataset nằm trong RAM.
8. Aggregation phải có bounded-memory mode.
9. Distributed execution phải deterministic khi semantics yêu cầu.
10. Partial aggregation được ưu tiên.
11. Predicate pushdown được ưu tiên.
12. Projection pushdown được ưu tiên.
13. Statistics không được làm thay đổi semantics.
14. Approximate analytics phải khai báo approximation.
15. GPU là acceleration provider, không phải dependency.
16. SQL là compatibility boundary, không phải semantic foundation.
17. DataFrame là typed API, không phải dynamic scripting system.
18. Không bắt buộc GC.
19. Không yêu cầu Python.
20. Không yêu cầu pandas/Polars/Arrow/Spark/DuckDB.
21. External engines chỉ là provider/adaptor.

# 398. Core invariants

1. Query semantics are independent of physical plan.
2. Physical optimization cannot change logical result.
3. Null semantics are preserved.
4. Numeric overflow semantics are preserved.
5. Approximate operations declare approximation.
6. Partial results are explicitly marked.
7. Query budgets are enforced.
8. Memory allocations are bounded by operator policy.
9. Spill is governed.
10. Temporary data is cleaned.
11. Credentials never enter query plans.
12. Governance follows data movement.
13. Residency cannot be bypassed through shuffle.
14. Classification propagates according to policy.
15. Lineage is recorded for materialized transformations.
16. Source revisions are tracked.
17. Materialized views cannot claim fresher data than their source.
18. Statistics cannot alter query semantics.
19. Optimizer cannot execute arbitrary code.
20. Custom operators require explicit capability.
21. Side effects are isolated to explicit sinks.
22. Distributed retries cannot silently duplicate committed output.
23. Output activation is atomic.
24. Failed generation is never published.
25. GPU fallback is explicit.
26. SIMD fallback is mandatory.
27. External providers declare semantic capabilities.
28. Unsupported semantics fail explicitly.
29. SQL lowers to canonical logical plans.
30. DataFrame lowers to canonical logical plans.
31. There is one analytical semantic core.
32. Search and analytics can exchange typed data.
33. Search does not become analytical storage.
34. Analytics does not become search indexing.
35. No mandatory third-party engine.
36. No mandatory GC.
37. No mandatory Python runtime.
38. Long-running jobs can checkpoint.
39. Cancellation propagates.
40. Deadlines propagate.
41. Tenant boundaries are preserved.
42. Security capabilities are not expanded by query.
43. Policy cannot mint capabilities.
44. Analytics cannot bypass 603.
45. Analytics cannot bypass 639.
46. Analytics cannot bypass 640.
47. Storage remains owned by 611.
48. Distributed data remains owned by 628.
49. Compute placement remains owned by 635/630.
50. Result provenance remains available where configured.

**Status:** COMPLETE

BOOTSTRAP-643 bổ sung nền tảng AI/ML native cho Axiom.

Mục tiêu:

- tensor;
- multidimensional arrays;
- automatic differentiation;
- neural-network primitives;
- CPU/GPU execution;
- accelerator execution;
- model representation;
- model serialization;
- training;
- inference;
- dataset pipeline;
- feature store;
- distributed training;
- distributed inference;
- checkpoint;
- optimizer;
- mixed precision;
- quantization;
- graph compilation;
- kernel fusion;
- memory planning;
- model serving;
- batching;
- streaming inference;
- model versioning;
- experiment metadata;
- reproducibility;
- integration với 630 distributed compute;
- integration với 642 analytical runtime;
- integration với 614 GPU/accelerator;
- integration với 640 data governance.

- Python;

Các hệ thống trên có thể được hỗ trợ bằng provider/adaptor.

# 4. Design principles

1. Tensor là primitive typed.
2. Shape được kiểm tra càng sớm càng tốt.
3. Dtype là explicit.
4. Device placement là explicit.
5. Host/device transfer là visible.
6. Không có implicit GPU synchronization trong hot path.
7. Không bắt buộc CUDA.
8. CPU luôn là fallback.
9. Memory ownership rõ ràng.
10. Không yêu cầu GC.
11. Graph execution có thể compile.
12. Eager execution vẫn được hỗ trợ.
13. Training và inference dùng chung tensor core.
14. Model graph không phụ thuộc Python object graph.
15. Serialization deterministic.
16. Checkpoint có version.
17. Distributed training không giả định exactly-once.
18. Randomness phải có seed/stream rõ ràng.
19. Data lineage tích hợp 640.
20. Resource usage tích hợp 606.
21. Security không bị bypass bởi GPU kernels.
22. External ML runtimes là provider.

# 4. Design principles

1. Tensor là primitive typed.
2. Shape được kiểm tra càng sớm càng tốt.
3. Dtype là explicit.
4. Device placement là explicit.
5. Host/device transfer là visible.
6. Không có implicit GPU synchronization trong hot path.
7. Không bắt buộc CUDA.
8. CPU luôn là fallback.
9. Memory ownership rõ ràng.
10. Không yêu cầu GC.
11. Graph execution có thể compile.
12. Eager execution vẫn được hỗ trợ.
13. Training và inference dùng chung tensor core.
14. Model graph không phụ thuộc Python object graph.
15. Serialization deterministic.
16. Checkpoint có version.
17. Distributed training không giả định exactly-once.
18. Randomness phải có seed/stream rõ ràng.
19. Data lineage tích hợp 640.
20. Resource usage tích hợp 606.
21. Security không bị bypass bởi GPU kernels.
22. External ML runtimes là provider.

Tiếp tục với **BOOTSTRAP-644 — Native AI Agent, Tool Calling, Structured Generation, Context Runtime, Memory, RAG, Planning & Autonomous Task Runtime 5.0**.

:::writing{variant="document" id="74126" title="BOOTSTRAP-644 — Native AI Agent, Tool Calling, Structured Generation, Context Runtime, Memory, RAG, Planning & Autonomous Task Runtime 5.0"}
# BOOTSTRAP-644
## Native AI Agent, Tool Calling, Structured Generation, Context Runtime, Memory, Retrieval-Augmented Execution, Planning & Autonomous Task Runtime 5.0

**Status:** COMPLETE  
**Layer:** Native AI Agent & Cognitive Application Runtime  
**Depends on:** BOOTSTRAP-600 → BOOTSTRAP-643

---

# 1. Mục tiêu

BOOTSTRAP-644 xây dựng lớp runtime native phía trên 643 để Axiom có thể tạo:

- AI agent;
- tool-using agent;
- structured-output agent;
- RAG application;
- conversational AI;
- workflow-driven agent;
- planning/execution agent;
- memory-enabled agent;
- multi-agent system;
- local AI application;
- remote-model application;
- AI coding assistant;
- AI automation system;
- model orchestration;
- retrieval pipeline;
- agent server.

Điểm quan trọng:

> **644 không phải một LLM runtime.**

643 đã cung cấp tensor/model execution.

644 cung cấp **orchestration, context, tool, memory, planning và execution semantics**.

---

# 2. Boundary

| Layer | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| 641 | Search/retrieval/index/vector search |
| 642 | Analytics/DataFrame/OLAP |
| 643 | Tensor/model/training/inference |
| 629 | Durable workflows |
| 631 | Distributed services |
| 634 | Event bus/stream |
| 639 | Policy/admission |
| 640 | Data governance |
| **644** | AI agent execution |

644 không được:

- tự cấp capability;
- tự bypass security;
- tự bypass governance;
- tự tải arbitrary executable code;
- biến prompt thành arbitrary native execution;
- yêu cầu Python runtime.

---

# 3. Core architecture

```text id="5d3x1u"
                    AI Application
                          │
                          ▼
                     AgentRuntime
                          │
             ┌────────────┼────────────┐
             ▼            ▼            ▼
          Context       Memory        Planner
             │            │            │
             └────────────┼────────────┘
                          ▼
                    Model Executor
                          │
             ┌────────────┼────────────┐
             ▼            ▼            ▼
          Generate       Tool        Retrieve
             │            │            │
             │            ▼            ▼
             │        ToolRuntime     641
             │            │
             └────────────┼────────────
                          ▼
                    Agent State
                          │
              ┌───────────┼───────────┐
              ▼           ▼           ▼
             628         629         634
           Memory      Workflow      Events
```

---

# 4. Design principles

1. Agent execution is explicit.
2. Model inference is separate from orchestration.
3. Tool execution is capability-controlled.
4. Context is typed.
5. Memory is typed.
6. Agent state is checkpointable.
7. Planning is not execution.
8. Generated plans are untrusted data.
9. Tool arguments are schema-validated.
10. Structured output is schema-validated.
11. Retrieval is a provider operation.
12. Prompt construction is deterministic where required.
13. No arbitrary code execution from model output.
14. No implicit network access.
15. No implicit filesystem access.
16. No implicit process execution.
17. No implicit secrets.
18. No mandatory external agent framework.
19. No mandatory cloud provider.
20. Local models and remote models use the same model interface.
21. Agent capabilities are attenuated.
22. Long-running agents use 629.
23. Distributed agents use 631/630/635.
24. Agent data follows 640 governance.
25. All important execution state is inspectable.

---

# 5. Core objects

```text id="k0a3sd"
Agent
AgentId
AgentVersion
AgentDefinition
AgentRuntime
AgentSession
AgentRun
AgentStep
AgentState

Model
ModelProvider
ModelRequest
ModelResponse
GenerationConfig

Context
ContextItem
ContextWindow
ContextBudget
ContextPolicy

Message
SystemMessage
UserMessage
AssistantMessage
ToolMessage
DeveloperMessage

Tool
ToolId
ToolSchema
ToolCall
ToolResult
ToolRuntime
ToolExecution

Plan
PlanStep
PlanState
Planner
PlannerResult

Memory
MemoryId
MemoryItem
MemoryStore
MemoryQuery
MemoryWrite
MemoryPolicy

Retriever
RetrievalQuery
RetrievalResult
RetrievedDocument
Citation

PromptTemplate
PromptContext
StructuredSchema
StructuredValue

AgentCheckpoint
AgentEvent
AgentTrace
```

---

# 6. Agent

Agent là immutable definition + mutable execution state.

```text id="qgukq1"
Agent {
    definition
    model
    tools
    memory
    policies
    runtime_limits
}
```

---

# 7. Agent definition

Bao gồm:

- agent ID;
- version;
- model reference;
- system policy;
- tool declarations;
- memory policy;
- context policy;
- planning policy;
- resource policy.

---

# 8. Agent version

Immutable.

Thay đổi definition tạo version mới.

---

# 9. Agent session

Session đại diện một conversation/execution context.

---

# 10. Agent run

Một lần execution của agent.

```text id="e9nq9f"
AgentRunId
AgentId
SessionId
Generation
```

---

# 11. Agent step

Một step có thể là:

```text id="s0n5qk"
Generate
ToolCall
ToolResult
Retrieve
Plan
Observe
Wait
Complete
Fail
```

---

# 12. State machine

```text id="0sl5m8"
Created
→ Running
→ Waiting
→ ExecutingTool
→ Observing
→ Planning
→ Running
→ Completed
```

Failure:

```text id="b1qk6k"
→ Failed
→ Recovering
→ Resumed
```

---

# 13. Terminal states

```text id="z7s8n0"
Completed
Failed
Cancelled
TimedOut
PolicyDenied
ResourceExceeded
```

---

# 14. Agent generation

Generation prevents stale execution from modifying newer state.

---

# 15. Context

Context là typed collection of information supplied to model.

---

# 16. Context item

```text id="8i8xoq"
ContextItem {
    kind
    source
    content
    priority
    sensitivity
    timestamp
    provenance
}
```

---

# 17. Context kinds

```text id="m3db5k"
Instruction
Conversation
ToolResult
RetrievedDocument
Memory
SystemFact
UserFact
ModelOutput
Schema
Constraint
```

---

# 18. Context priority

Context có priority explicit.

---

# 19. Context provenance

Mỗi item có source:

```text id="4q0e7g"
User
Application
Tool
Retriever
Memory
System
Model
```

---

# 20. Context trust

Không phải context item nào cũng có cùng authority.

---

# 21. Instruction hierarchy

Runtime phân biệt:

```text id="v4gq8n"
System
Developer
Application
User
Tool
RetrievedData
ModelGenerated
```

Model-generated text không tự trở thành instruction có authority cao hơn.

---

# 22. Prompt injection boundary

Retrieved content/tool output được xem là **data**, không mặc định là instruction.

---

# 23. Context policy

```text id="i3p1tq"
max_tokens
max_items
max_bytes
allowed_sources
retention
priority_rules
```

---

# 24. Context budget

Budget được tính trước khi model invocation.

---

# 25. Context compaction

Có thể:

- truncate;
- summarize;
- compress;
- retrieve relevant history.

---

# 26. Compaction safety

Compaction không được biến untrusted data thành trusted instruction.

---

# 27. Conversation message

```text id="k4w8l9"
Message {
    role
    content
    metadata
}
```

---

# 28. Multimodal content

Message có thể chứa:

```text id="2v0u3x"
Text
Image
Audio
Video
Document
StructuredData
```

---

# 29. Media integration

616 cung cấp media representation.

---

# 30. Image input

Có thể chuyển image thành model-compatible tensor thông qua 643/provider.

---

# 31. Audio input

616 → preprocessing → 643.

---

# 32. Document input

612/617/641/642 providers.

---

# 33. Structured output

Model output có thể yêu cầu schema.

---

# 34. StructuredSchema

Schema sử dụng 612 schema system.

---

# 35. StructuredValue

Output phải validate trước khi application sử dụng.

---

# 36. Schema failure

Nếu output invalid:

```text id="o4a6lf"
ValidationFailed
```

không được coi là valid tool call.

---

# 37. Repair

Có thể yêu cầu model sửa output trong giới hạn retry budget.

---

# 38. Tool

Tool là typed capability endpoint.

```text id="8g6x3h"
Tool {
    id
    version
    schema
    capability_requirements
    execution_policy
}
```

---

# 39. Tool schema

Schema gồm:

```text id="n4e1mm"
name
description
input_schema
output_schema
errors
limits
```

---

# 40. Tool call

```text id="2f0m4w"
ToolCall {
    call_id
    tool_id
    arguments
}
```

---

# 41. Tool argument validation

Arguments được validate trước execution.

---

# 42. Tool result

```text id="d7v0qk"
ToolResult {
    call_id
    status
    output
    error
    metadata
}
```

---

# 43. Tool states

```text id="2p3xzx"
Created
Validated
Admitted
Running
Completed
Failed
Cancelled
TimedOut
Denied
```

---

# 44. Tool capability

Tool execution requires capabilities from 603.

---

# 45. Capability attenuation

Agent receives only subset required by declared tools.

---

# 46. No capability amplification

Model output cannot create new capabilities.

---

# 47. Tool approval

Certain tools can require explicit approval.

---

# 48. Approval token

639 approval system can issue bounded approval.

---

# 49. Tool timeout

Every tool call has timeout.

---

# 50. Tool resource budget

Every tool call has:

```text id="e6w5yc"
CPU
memory
network
storage
time
```

limits.

---

# 51. Tool idempotency

Tool declares:

```text id="r4s8hy"
Idempotent
NonIdempotent
Unknown
```

---

# 52. Retry

Only retry when policy allows.

---

# 53. Side effects

Tool declares whether it has side effects.

---

# 54. Dangerous side effects

Operations such as:

- deletion;
- financial transaction;
- deployment;
- external publication;
- process termination

can require explicit policy/approval.

---

# 55. Tool sandbox

Tool implementation may run:

- in-process;
- isolated module;
- subprocess;
- remote service.

---

# 56. Tool isolation

623/603 manage module/process isolation.

---

# 57. Remote tool

631 handles service invocation.

---

# 58. Tool transport

Supported:

```text id="k3jv0p"
InProcess
IPC
HTTP
RPC
Event
Workflow
```

---

# 59. Tool versioning

Tool schema version is immutable.

---

# 60. Tool compatibility

Agent definition records compatible tool schema.

---

# 61. Tool discovery

Agents may receive a predefined tool catalog.

Dynamic discovery requires explicit capability.

---

# 62. Tool discovery security

Model cannot arbitrarily discover privileged tools.

---

# 63. Tool result trust

Tool results remain data unless explicitly promoted by application policy.

---

# 64. Tool result size

Bounded by resource policy.

---

# 65. Tool streaming

Long-running tools can stream partial results.

---

# 66. Tool cancellation

Cancellation propagates through 607/631/629.

---

# 67. Planner

Planner creates candidate execution plan.

---

# 68. Planner output

```text id="ap2r7k"
Plan {
    steps
    dependencies
    conditions
    resource_estimate
}
```

---

# 69. Plan != execution

Plan is data.

It must pass validation/admission before execution.

---

# 70. Plan validation

Checks:

- known tool;
- valid arguments;
- dependencies;
- capability requirements;
- policy;
- resource budget;
- cycle;
- deadline.

---

# 71. Plan cycles

Static cycle detection where possible.

---

# 72. Plan execution

Valid plan becomes execution steps.

---

# 73. Planner providers

```text id="3x0y3b"
ModelPlanner
RulePlanner
WorkflowPlanner
ApplicationPlanner
```

---

# 74. No mandatory autonomous planning algorithm

Application chooses planner.

---

# 75. Deterministic planner

Rule-based planner can be fully deterministic.

---

# 76. Model planner

LLM-generated plans are untrusted until validated.

---

# 77. Plan repair

Invalid plan can be rejected or regenerated.

---

# 78. Planning budget

Planner has:

```text id="h9x6a5"
max_steps
max_depth
max_tokens
max_time
```

---

# 79. Recursive planning

Nested planning depth bounded.

---

# 80. Agent loop

Canonical loop:

```text id="qprm0w"
Observe
→ Context
→ Generate
→ Parse
→ Validate
→ Plan
→ Admit
→ Execute
→ Observe
→ Repeat
```

---

# 81. Loop limit

Agent run has:

```text id="s9u1w0"
max_steps
max_tool_calls
max_time
max_model_calls
```

---

# 82. Infinite-loop prevention

Runtime terminates execution when limits are exceeded.

---

# 83. Repeated tool detection

Optional duplicate-call detection.

---

# 84. Tool-call budget

Can be per:

- run;
- session;
- agent;
- tenant;
- tool.

---

# 85. Model-call budget

Same hierarchy.

---

# 86. Context budget

Independent from compute budget.

---

# 87. Token budget

Model provider reports estimated/actual usage where available.

---

# 88. Model abstraction

644 consumes 643:

```text id="y0t1p5"
InferenceSession
ModelRequest
ModelResponse
```

---

# 89. Model provider

```text id="8h0b4y"
LocalModelProvider
NativeModelProvider
RemoteModelProvider
ExternalProvider
TestProvider
```

---

# 90. Model neutrality

Agent runtime does not depend on a specific model vendor.

---

# 91. Generation configuration

```text id="v8x3l5"
temperature
top_k
top_p
max_tokens
stop
seed
structured_schema
```

---

# 92. Deterministic generation

If provider supports seed/deterministic mode.

---

# 93. Model streaming

Partial tokens/chunks are delivered as events.

---

# 94. Streaming cancellation

Client cancellation propagates immediately.

---

# 95. Backpressure

Streaming output uses 607/634 backpressure.

---

# 96. Model error

```text id="2ey5e9"
ModelUnavailable
ModelTimeout
ContextOverflow
InvalidRequest
ProviderError
RateLimited
ResourceExceeded
```

---

# 97. Model fallback

Fallback provider is explicit.

---

# 98. Fallback policy

Must specify whether:

- different model;
- different device;
- remote service

is permitted.

---

# 99. No silent provider change

Provider changes are recorded.

---

# 100. Retrieval

Retriever is an abstraction above 641.

```text id="w8a8n3"
Retriever {
    query
    filters
    limits
}
```

---

# 101. Retrieval sources

```text id="7sp7pl"
FullText
Vector
Hybrid
Database
Analytics
Document
Memory
Remote
```

---

# 102. Retrieval query

```text id="w7x5l4"
RetrievalQuery {
    text
    embedding
    filters
    top_k
    threshold
}
```

---

# 103. Retrieval result

```text id="s8q6bb"
RetrievedDocument {
    id
    content
    score
    source
    metadata
    provenance
}
```

---

# 104. Retrieval provenance

Every result records source/index revision where available.

---

# 105. RAG pipeline

```text id="d2q6go"
Question
→ QueryTransform
→ Retrieval
→ Filter
→ Rerank
→ Context
→ Model
```

---

# 106. Query transform

Optional model-generated query must be bounded and validated.

---

# 107. Reranking

Uses 641 rank primitives or 643 model.

---

# 108. Reranker

Separate from generator.

---

# 109. Retrieval filters

639/640 policies are applied before exposing content.

---

# 110. Retrieval security

Agent cannot retrieve data outside its capabilities.

---

# 111. Retrieval governance

640 determines:

- classification;
- residency;
- retention;
- lineage;
- purpose.

---

# 112. Citation

RAG responses may contain structured citations.

```text id="9xg4s4"
Citation {
    source_id
    revision
    location
}
```

---

# 113. Citation validation

Citation must correspond to retrieved source.

---

# 114. No fabricated citation

Runtime must not mark arbitrary model text as verified citation.

---

# 115. Memory

Memory is persistent information associated with agent/application.

---

# 116. Memory types

```text id="g3tq1d"
WorkingMemory
ConversationMemory
SemanticMemory
EpisodicMemory
ProceduralMemory
PreferenceMemory
ApplicationMemory
```

---

# 117. Working memory

Short-lived context.

---

# 118. Conversation memory

Historical messages.

---

# 119. Semantic memory

Facts/knowledge represented as structured records or embeddings.

---

# 120. Episodic memory

Records previous execution episodes.

---

# 121. Procedural memory

Stores reusable procedures/templates, not executable native code.

---

# 122. Preference memory

Application-defined user preferences.

---

# 123. Memory store

```text id="09q3xh"
MemoryStore {
    write
    query
    delete
    compact
}
```

---

# 124. Memory backend

Can use:

- 611;
- 612;
- 628;
- 641;
- 642.

---

# 125. Memory schema

Memory items are typed.

---

# 126. Memory provenance

Every memory item records origin.

---

# 127. Memory confidence

Optional metadata, never treated as proof.

---

# 128. Memory freshness

Memory can have:

```text id="z8a4g5"
created_at
updated_at
expires_at
source_revision
```

---

# 129. Memory conflict

Conflicting memories are represented explicitly.

---

# 130. Memory overwrite

Does not silently destroy provenance.

---

# 131. Memory deletion

Uses 640 retention/deletion semantics.

---

# 132. Memory classification

Memory can contain sensitive data and therefore carries governance metadata.

---

# 133. Memory residency

Distributed memory follows residency restrictions.

---

# 134. Memory retrieval

Memory query may combine:

```text id="h6s2yl"
semantic
lexical
structured
temporal
```

---

# 135. Memory ranking

Ranking is deterministic/configurable.

---

# 136. Memory compaction

Old memories can be summarized into derived memory.

---

# 137. Summary provenance

Summary stores source memory references.

---

# 138. Memory hallucination boundary

Model-generated memory is marked:

```text id="zv1n4p"
ModelDerived
```

until application verification if required.

---

# 139. Memory write policy

Agent cannot automatically persist every model claim.

---

# 140. Memory admission

Policy can require:

```text id="d4x8v5"
SourceVerified
UserConfirmed
ApplicationApproved
```

---

# 141. Agent state

State contains:

```text id="0s8z7r"
session
step
context references
plan
tool state
memory references
model state
budgets
```

---

# 142. Agent state persistence

Uses 600/611/612.

---

# 143. Agent checkpoint

```text id="4f4f8b"
AgentCheckpoint {
    run
    state
    context_revision
    plan_revision
    tool_state
    memory_revision
}
```

---

# 144. Secret exclusion

Checkpoint cannot contain plaintext secrets.

---

# 145. Resume

Agent can resume from checkpoint.

---

# 146. Tool recovery

Tool calls in progress are marked:

```text id="h9v8f0"
Unknown
```

unless provider has durable execution semantics.

---

# 147. Side-effect recovery

Non-idempotent tool calls require idempotency/confirmation before retry.

---

# 148. Durable agent

Long-running agent delegates durable waiting/execution to 629.

---

# 149. Agent workflow

644 can compile an agent loop into 629 workflow/activity primitives.

---

# 150. Agent event stream

634 emits:

```text id="0j3x7n"
AgentStarted
ModelRequested
ModelCompleted
ToolRequested
ToolCompleted
RetrievalPerformed
PlanCreated
PlanRejected
MemoryRead
MemoryWritten
AgentCompleted
AgentFailed
```

---

# 151. Event payload

Never contains secrets unless explicitly permitted.

---

# 152. Observability

633 captures:

- model latency;
- tool latency;
- retrieval latency;
- context size;
- token usage;
- step count;
- memory operations;
- plan depth.

---

# 153. Trace hierarchy

```text id="v4d8xk"
AgentRun
 ├─ ModelSpan
 ├─ RetrievalSpan
 ├─ PlanningSpan
 └─ ToolSpan
```

---

# 154. Explainability

Runtime exposes execution trace.

---

# 155. Agent explain API

```text id="j4p5me"
agent.explain(run_id)
```

returns structured execution metadata.

---

# 156. Explain limitation

It describes runtime events, not hidden model reasoning.

---

# 157. No hidden chain-of-thought storage

Runtime stores:

- prompts;
- outputs;
- tool calls;
- decisions represented by explicit state;

not private internal model reasoning.

---

# 158. Prompt template

```text id="5b3f4a"
PromptTemplate {
    segments
    variables
    schema
}
```

---

# 159. Template rendering

Variables are typed.

---

# 160. Template injection prevention

Structured values are encoded according to context.

---

# 161. Prompt fingerprint

Rendered prompt can have deterministic fingerprint.

---

# 162. Context fingerprint

Hash of selected context revisions.

---

# 163. Agent run fingerprint

Combines:

```text id="6y7f4u"
agent_version
model_version
prompt_fingerprint
tool_schema
context_revision
```

---

# 164. Reproducibility

A run can be reproduced when all required provider states are available.

---

# 165. Tool result replay

Testing runtime can replay recorded tool outputs.

---

# 166. Model replay

Provider may support deterministic response replay.

---

# 167. Simulation mode

Agent executes against fake tools/models/retrievers.

---

# 168. Dry-run mode

Tool calls are validated but side effects are not executed.

---

# 169. Approval mode

Tool call pauses until approval.

---

# 170. Observe-only mode

Agent may generate plans but not execute them.

---

# 171. Policy mode

639 controls allowed execution modes.

---

# 172. Agent capability profile

```text id="j0r0s3"
ReadOnly
Interactive
Automation
Privileged
Sandboxed
```

These are descriptive policy profiles, not capability grants themselves.

---

# 173. Tool groups

Tools can be grouped:

```text id="a3v7ns"
filesystem
network
database
process
deployment
communication
AI
```

---

# 174. Tool allowlist

Agent definition can explicitly list allowed tools.

---

# 175. Tool denylist

Policy can deny tools even if agent declares them.

---

# 176. Capability inheritance

Agent → tool execution gets attenuated capabilities.

---

# 177. Capability expiration

Long-running agent capability grants may expire.

---

# 178. Agent delegation

Agent can invoke another agent only through explicit service/tool interface.

---

# 179. Agent-to-agent call

Uses 631 service identity and 603 capabilities.

---

# 180. Multi-agent runtime

```text id="z6n2eu"
AgentCoordinator
AgentPool
AgentMessage
AgentTask
```

---

# 181. Agent roles

Roles are application-defined metadata.

---

# 182. Agent communication

Can use:

- direct call;
- IPC;
- service RPC;
- event;
- workflow.

---

# 183. Shared memory

Agents must not share mutable state implicitly.

---

# 184. Shared state

Uses 628 with explicit consistency.

---

# 185. Multi-agent coordination

629/635 can coordinate durable/distributed execution.

---

# 186. Agent hierarchy

Parent agent may create child execution with reduced budgets/capabilities.

---

# 187. Child budget

Child receives:

```text id="z0k0eq"
remaining_time
remaining_steps
remaining_tokens
remaining_resource_budget
```

---

# 188. No budget amplification

Children cannot increase parent authority.

---

# 189. Cancellation propagation

Parent cancellation propagates to child unless explicitly detached by policy.

---

# 190. Detached agents

Must be explicitly declared.

---

# 191. Detached agent

Gets independent lifecycle and resource budget.

---

# 192. Agent scheduling

607.

---

# 193. Distributed agent placement

630/635.

---

# 194. Edge agent

636.

---

# 195. Agent deployment

636 can deploy agent package/model/tools.

---

# 196. Agent package

613/625 includes:

```text id="8h4q5w"
agent definition
prompt templates
tool schemas
model references
retriever configuration
memory schema
policy metadata
```

---

# 197. Agent package security

Signed package required for trusted distribution.

---

# 198. Agent update

636 can rollout new agent version.

---

# 199. Agent rollback

Previous immutable generation restored.

---

# 200. Agent configuration

637 controls operational configuration.

---

# 201. Security policy

603/639 remains authoritative.

---

# 202. Dynamic tool configuration

637 may enable/disable declared tools, but cannot grant forbidden capability.

---

# 203. Agent policy

# 436. Architecture invariants

1. Agent output is not authority.
2. Model output is not authority.
3. Retrieved text is not authority.
4. Memory is not authority.
5. Tool result is not authority.
6. Tool invocation requires authorization.
7. Tool arguments require schema validation.
8. Tool side effects require declared capability.
9. Capability cannot be created by model output.
10. Child agents cannot gain parent authority.
11. Agent loops are bounded.
12. Planner depth is bounded.
13. Tool calls are bounded.
14. Model calls are bounded.
15. Context size is bounded.
16. Resource consumption is bounded.
17. Agent state is generation-safe.
18. Durable state is checkpointable.
19. Non-idempotent side effects cannot be blindly retried.
20. Exactly-once side effects are never assumed.
21. Secrets are excluded from ordinary context.
22. Secrets are excluded from ordinary telemetry.
23. Structured outputs are schema-validated.
24. Tool schemas are versioned.
25. Model signatures are versioned.
26. Retrieval results carry provenance.
27. Citations reference actual retrieved data.
28. Memory provenance is preserved.
29. Memory deletion follows governance.
30. Model artifacts are immutable.
31. Agent artifacts are immutable.
32. Model loading cannot execute arbitrary code.
33. Tool providers have explicit trust boundaries.
34. External providers cannot bypass security.
35. Dynamic configuration cannot expand authority.
36. Policy remains authoritative.
37. Governance remains authoritative.
38. Residency restrictions apply to retrieval.
39. Residency restrictions apply to inference.
40. Classification restrictions apply to memory.
41. Model output cannot mutate policy.
42. Model output cannot install plugins.
43. Model output cannot install packages.
44. Model output cannot execute shell commands directly.
45. Generated code remains inert until explicitly authorized.
46. Agent recovery cannot duplicate protected side effects.
47. Agent deployment is generation-based.
48. Agent rollback uses immutable versions.
49. Multi-agent shared mutable state is explicit.
50. Distributed agent execution uses bounded leases.
51. Stale workers cannot commit state.
52. Agent telemetry is privacy-aware.
53. Agent runtime has no mandatory cloud dependency.
54. Agent runtime has no mandatory Python dependency.
55. Agent runtime has no mandatory external agent framework.
56. Local inference is first-class.
57. Remote inference is explicit.
58. RAG is compositional rather than magical.
59. Planning is separate from execution.
60. Security authority remains outside the model.

# 4. Design principles

1. Entity identity is explicit.
2. Relation identity is explicit.
3. Graph schema is optional but strongly encouraged.
4. Unknown entities can exist.
5. Unknown relations can exist only under explicit schema policy.
6. Provenance is first-class.
7. Temporal validity is first-class.
8. Graph versions are immutable.
9. Updates are revisioned.
10. Distributed replication uses 628.
11. Governance uses 640.
12. Authorization uses 603/639.
13. Search uses 641.
14. Analytics uses 642.
15. ML embeddings use 643.
16. Agents consume graph through 644.
17. Graph queries are typed.
18. Query execution is bounded.
19. Traversal cannot escape authorization boundaries.
20. No implicit reasoning engine is required.
21. Inference is explicit.
22. AI-generated facts are not automatically trusted.
23. Provenance is preserved through derived facts.
24. No mandatory RDF/SPARQL dependency.
25. No mandatory Neo4j dependency.
26. No mandatory external graph database.
27. Native implementation is possible.

2. Relation endpoints must resolve or be explicitly deferred.

7. Stale writers cannot overwrite newer generations.
8. Query execution is resource bounded.

12. Cross-partition execution is explicit.
13. Partial distributed results are marked.
14. Search results retain provenance.
15. Vector embeddings retain model identity.
16. Derived assertions retain provenance.
17. Model-generated facts are not implicitly verified.
18. Contradictory facts may coexist.
19. Inference is explicitly enabled.
20. Inference is bounded.
21. Rule execution cannot execute arbitrary code.
22. Ontology versions are immutable.

29. Capability cannot be created by graph data.
30. Agent output cannot grant graph authority.
31. Query caches include policy revision.
32. Query caches include graph revision.
33. Stale caches are marked.
34. Cursor state is bound to query generation.
35. External providers cannot expand authority.
36. Graph snapshots can be cryptographically verified.
37. Large graph operations can spill or fail explicitly.
38. No mandatory garbage collector.
39. Public API does not expose raw pointers.
40. Native implementation is possible without external graph DB.
41. External graph databases are adapters.
42. SQL/graph textual languages are compatibility layers.
43. Typed graph AST is canonical.
44. Query parameters are separate from syntax.
45. Security metadata is separate from graph payload.
46. Governance metadata is separate from payload.
47. Secrets are never logged by default.
48. Model extraction is traceable.

51. Cross-tenant traversal is denied by default.
52. Graph state can be checkpointed.

54. Exactly-once distributed graph mutation is not assumed.

# 321. Core invariants

1. Entity IDs are generation-safe.
2. Relation endpoints must resolve or be explicitly deferred.
3. Relation direction is explicit.
4. Graph revisions are monotonic.
5. Snapshots are immutable.
6. Transactions are atomic within declared scope.
7. Stale writers cannot overwrite newer generations.
8. Query execution is resource bounded.
9. Traversal is depth bounded.
10. Traversal is node/edge bounded.
11. Cycles cannot cause infinite execution.
12. Cross-partition execution is explicit.
13. Partial distributed results are marked.
14. Search results retain provenance.
15. Vector embeddings retain model identity.
16. Derived assertions retain provenance.
17. Model-generated facts are not implicitly verified.
18. Contradictory facts may coexist.
19. Inference is explicitly enabled.
20. Inference is bounded.
21. Rule execution cannot execute arbitrary code.
22. Ontology versions are immutable.
23. Schema changes are versioned.
24. Migrations are versioned.
25. Graph deletion obeys governance.
26. Retention cannot be bypassed.
27. Residency cannot be bypassed.
28. Authorization cannot be bypassed.
29. Capability cannot be created by graph data.
30. Agent output cannot grant graph authority.
31. Query caches include policy revision.
32. Query caches include graph revision.
33. Stale caches are marked.
34. Cursor state is bound to query generation.
35. External providers cannot expand authority.
36. Graph snapshots can be cryptographically verified.
37. Large graph operations can spill or fail explicitly.
38. No mandatory garbage collector.
39. Public API does not expose raw pointers.
40. Native implementation is possible without external graph DB.
41. External graph databases are adapters.
42. SQL/graph textual languages are compatibility layers.
43. Typed graph AST is canonical.
44. Query parameters are separate from syntax.
45. Security metadata is separate from graph payload.
46. Governance metadata is separate from payload.
47. Secrets are never logged by default.
48. Model extraction is traceable.
49. Human review is traceable.
50. Federation authority remains local.
51. Cross-tenant traversal is denied by default.
52. Graph state can be checkpointed.
53. Replication uses explicit consistency semantics.
54. Exactly-once distributed graph mutation is not assumed.
55. Event replay is idempotent.
56. Search/index updates are versioned.
57. Analytics snapshots identify graph revision.
58. Training data identifies graph revision.
59. Agent retrieval identifies graph revision.
60. Knowledge provenance survives transformation.

9. Model-as-judge phải được đánh dấu.

11. Safety tests phải có policy rõ ràng.
12. Red-team testing phải được sandbox.
13. Evaluation không được tự ý cấp capability.
14. Test input có thể là untrusted data.

16. Evaluation phải có timeout.
17. Evaluation có thể chạy local hoặc distributed.
18. Kết quả phải immutable sau khi finalize.
19. Re-run tạo evaluation mới.
20. So sánh phải giữ nguyên population/dataset revision.
21. Không tự động suy luận chất lượng ngoài metrics đã định nghĩa.
22. Không tự động chọn model winner.
23. Không tự động triển khai model chỉ vì evaluation đạt ngưỡng.
24. Quality gates là declarative.
25. Gate decision phải traceable.
26. Evaluation lineage phải tích hợp 640.
27. Model artifact phải liên kết với 643.
28. Agent run phải liên kết với 644.

34. Không bắt buộc Python.
35. Không bắt buộc PyTorch/TensorFlow.

37. External evaluators là provider.
38. Native evaluator là canonical API.

35. Recommendation explanation does not expose hidden reasoning.
36. Ranking score is not universal truth.
37. Score semantics are model-specific.

41. Cache keys include relevant revisions.
42. Profile changes invalidate affected caches.
43. Model changes invalidate incompatible caches.

45. Personal adapters are isolated.
46. Personal adapters cannot grant authority.
47. Memory is distinct from personalization.
