Tiếp tục chuỗi architecture: **BOOTSTRAP-669** mở rộng từ federation/governance sang **hệ thống tài nguyên, hạ tầng và commons ở quy mô civilization**, nhưng giữ chúng là computational systems chứ không áp đặt mô hình quản trị cụ thể.

:::writing{variant="document" id="74136" title="AXIOM BOOTSTRAP-669 — Native AI Civilization-Scale Commons, Infrastructure, Ecology & Resource Systems Runtime 5.0"}
# AXIOM BOOTSTRAP-669
## Native AI Civilization-Scale Commons, Infrastructure, Ecology & Resource Systems Runtime 5.0

**Status:** ARCHITECTURE COMPLETE  
**Layer:** Civilization-Scale Shared Systems  
**Depends on:** BOOTSTRAP-603..668  
**Target tests:** ≥ 3,600  
**Target invariants:** ≥ 280  
**Runtime profile:** Optional / capability-gated / policy-gated / distributed / simulation-capable

---

# 1. Mục tiêu

BOOTSTRAP-668 giải quyết:

> Organization ↔ Organization

BOOTSTRAP-669 giải quyết:

> **Organizations / Federations ↔ Shared Civilization-Scale Systems**

Tầng này cung cấp substrate native cho việc mô hình hóa, điều phối và vận hành các hệ thống quy mô lớn như:

```text
Energy
Water
Food
Agriculture
Transportation
Telecommunications
Compute
Storage
Manufacturing
Supply Chains
Warehouses
Critical Infrastructure
Environmental Systems
Waste
Recycling
Natural Resources
Industrial Capacity
Humanitarian Capacity
Emergency Capacity
Shared Digital Infrastructure
```

và các quan hệ giữa chúng.

Mục tiêu không phải xây dựng một "AI chính phủ".

Mục tiêu là cung cấp:

```text
resource model
+
infrastructure model
+
capacity model
+
dependency model
+
flow model
+
resilience model
+
simulation model
+
optimization boundary
```

để các hệ thống quy mô lớn có thể được triển khai bằng Axiom.

---

# 2. Architectural principle

669 phải phân biệt rõ:

```text
Resource
Capacity
Asset
Infrastructure
Service
Flow
Demand
Allocation
Dependency
Constraint
Policy
Objective
Simulation
```

Không được gom tất cả thành một `Resource` type khổng lồ.

---

# 3. Responsibility boundary

```text
606  = local/system resource management
628  = distributed data
635  = distributed coordination / consensus
637  = distributed configuration
639  = authority / policy
640  = data governance
643  = AI compute / ML
652  = optimization / decision
655  = world model
656  = embodied systems
661  = goals/objectives
663  = evaluation
664  = safety
665  = human oversight
666  = multi-agent coordination
667  = organization
668  = federation
669  = civilization-scale physical/digital shared systems
```

669 không thay thế:

- 606 resource governor;
- 652 optimizer;
- 655 world model;
- 656 robotics;
- 668 federation governance.

669 **kết nối** chúng.

---

# 4. Core abstraction

Mọi civilization-scale system được biểu diễn như:

```text
System
 ├── Assets
 ├── Resources
 ├── Capacity
 ├── Demand
 ├── Flows
 ├── Dependencies
 ├── Constraints
 ├── Services
 ├── Operators
 ├── Consumers
 ├── Policies
 ├── Objectives
 └── Observations
```

---

# 5. System

```text
System {
    id
    type
    assets
    resources
    capacity
    dependencies
    services
    state
    health
    topology
    lifecycle
}
```

System types:

```text
energy
water
food
transport
communication
compute
manufacturing
logistics
health
environment
waste
recycling
industrial
digital
emergency
```

---

# 6. System hierarchy

Hỗ trợ:

```text
Subsystem
System
SystemOfSystems
RegionalSystem
FederationSystem
PlanetarySystem
CrossPlanetarySystem
```

Ví dụ:

```text
EnergySystem
 ├── Generation
 ├── Transmission
 ├── Distribution
 └── Storage
```

---

# 7. Asset

```text
Asset {
    id
    owner
    operator
    location
    type
    state
    capacity
    dependencies
    lifecycle
}
```

Asset có thể là:

```text
power_plant
battery
pipeline
factory
warehouse
server_cluster
fiber_link
railway
port
water_treatment
reservoir
satellite
```

---

# 8. Asset lifecycle

```text
planned
construction
commissioning
active
degraded
maintenance
offline
retired
decommissioned
```

Mọi transition phải observable.

---

# 9. Resource

Resource là thứ có thể:

- tồn tại;
- tiêu thụ;
- chuyển đổi;
- lưu trữ;
- phân bổ;
- tái tạo;
- cạn kiệt.

```text
Resource {
    id
    type
    quantity
    unit
    quality
    location
    owner
    availability
    lifecycle
}
```

---

# 10. Resource categories

Core categories:

```text
material
energy
water
food
land
compute
storage
network
transport_capacity
manufacturing_capacity
labor_capacity
time
financial_capacity
information
environmental_capacity
emergency_capacity
```

Không phải mọi resource đều có thể fungible.

---

# 11. Fungibility

```text
Fungibility:
    fungible
    partially_fungible
    non_fungible
```

Ví dụ:

```text
electricity → fungible within declared grid model
factory → non-fungible
server capacity → partially fungible
```

---

# 12. Units

669 phải dùng unit-safe quantity.

```text
Quantity<T, Unit>
```

Ví dụ:

```text
100 MW
20 MWh
5000 L
2 tonnes
10 Gbps
500 GPU_hours
```

Compiler phải ngăn:

```text
10 MW + 5 kg
```

---

# 13. Resource quality

Resource có thể có quality dimension:

```text
Quality {
    dimensions
    measurements
    thresholds
}
```

Ví dụ:

```text
water:
    purity
    temperature
    salinity
```

```text
fuel:
    energy_density
    contamination
```

---

# 14. Capacity

Capacity khác resource.

```text
Capacity {
    nominal
    available
    committed
    reserved
    emergency
    maintenance
}
```

Ví dụ:

```text
Factory:
    production_capacity = 10000 units/day
```

Không đồng nghĩa factory đang có 10000 units.

---

# 15. Capacity state

```text
nominal
available
allocated
reserved
constrained
degraded
offline
```

---

# 16. Demand

```text
Demand {
    subject
    resource
    quantity
    time_window
    priority_class
    flexibility
    deadline
}
```

Demand phải có uncertainty support.

```text
DemandForecast
DemandRange
DemandScenario
```

---

# 17. Demand flexibility

```text
rigid
shiftable
interruptible
deferrable
elastic
```

Đây là computational properties, không phải normative priority.

---

# 18. Supply

```text
Supply {
    producer
    resource
    quantity
    availability_window
    reliability
    constraints
}
```

---

# 19. Flow

```text
Flow {
    source
    destination
    resource
    rate
    capacity
    latency
    loss
    constraints
}
```

Ví dụ:

```text
PowerPlant
   ↓
Transmission
   ↓
Substation
   ↓
Consumer
```

---

# 20. Flow network

```text
FlowNetwork {
    nodes
    edges
    capacities
    losses
    constraints
    routing
}
```

Dùng cho:

- power grids;
- water networks;
- transport;
- logistics;
- communication;
- compute;
- manufacturing.

---

# 21. Conversion

Resource có thể chuyển đổi:

```text
ConversionProcess {
    input
    output
    efficiency
    capacity
    waste
    constraints
}
```

Ví dụ:

```text
fuel
→ electricity
```

hoặc:

```text
raw_material
→ component
```

---

# 22. Storage

```text
StorageAsset {
    resource
    capacity
    charge_rate
    discharge_rate
    loss
    state
}
```

Hỗ trợ:

```text
battery
reservoir
warehouse
data_storage
thermal_storage
```

---

# 23. Inventory

```text
Inventory {
    resource
    quantity
    location
    reserved
    available
    minimum
    maximum
}
```

---

# 24. Inventory policy

```text
InventoryPolicy {
    reorder_point
    safety_stock
    max_stock
    replenishment
}
```

---

# 25. Infrastructure

Infrastructure là tập hợp asset + topology + services.

```text
Infrastructure {
    assets
    topology
    services
    capacity
    operators
    dependencies
    resilience
}
```

---

# 26. Critical infrastructure

```text
CriticalInfrastructure {
    criticality
    dependencies
    recovery_priority
    failure_modes
    continuity_plan
}
```

Criticality là metadata/policy input, không tự động quyết định action.

---

# 27. Infrastructure dependency graph

```text
DependencyGraph {
    nodes
    edges
    dependency_type
    strength
    direction
}
```

Ví dụ:

```text
Telecom
   ↓
DataCenter
   ↓
PowerGrid
   ↓
FuelSupply
```

---

# 28. Dependency types

```text
required
preferred
optional
degraded
cascading
bidirectional
temporal
conditional
```

---

# 29. Cascading failure

Runtime phải có khả năng mô hình hóa:

```text
failure A
→ degradation B
→ overload C
→ failure C
→ service loss D
```

Không được giả định dependency graph là acyclic.

---

# 30. Cyclic dependencies

Ví dụ:

```text
Power
 ↔ Telecom
 ↔ Compute
 ↔ Control
```

Phải hỗ trợ cycle detection và strongly-connected components.

---

# 31. Service

```text
Service {
    provider
    capacity
    consumers
    availability
    SLA
    dependencies
}
```

Resource khác Service:

```text
electricity = resource
internet_access = service
```

---

# 32. Service capacity

```text
ServiceCapacity {
    nominal
    current
    reserved
    degraded
}
```

---

# 33. SLA

```text
SLA {
    availability
    latency
    throughput
    recovery_time
    recovery_point
}
```

SLA có thể liên kết BOOTSTRAP-668 contracts.

---

# 34. Geographic topology

```text
Region
Zone
Site
Facility
Node
Corridor
Boundary
```

Không bắt buộc geographic coordinates.

Có thể dùng:

```text
logical_region
network_region
administrative_region
physical_region
```

---

# 35. Location

```text
Location {
    coordinate
    region
    zone
    reference_frame
}
```

---

```text
Commons {
    resources
    contributors
    consumers
    allocation_policy
    sustainability
    monitoring
}
```

---

```text
contributed
allocated
consumed
returned
lost
reserved
available
```

Accounting không được tự động imply ownership.

---

# 38. Renewable resource

```text
RenewableResource {
    regeneration_rate

}
```

```text

fish
solar
wind
```

---

```text

    reserve

}
```

---

```text
EnvironmentalCapacity {
    pollutant_load
    water_load
    land_load
    carbon_capacity
    ecosystem_capacity
}
```

Không hard-code một environmental policy.

---

```text
EcologicalSystem {
    resources
    populations
    flows
    regeneration
    constraints

}
```

---

# 42. Ecosystem state

```text
EcosystemState {

}
```

---

```text

    resource
    regeneration
    extraction
    threshold

}
```

```text

```

nhưng quyết định remediation thuộc policy/objective layer.

---

Generic environmental accounting:

```text
Emission {
    source
    substance
    quantity
    time
    uncertainty
}
```

Không giới hạn model vào một loại emission.

---

# 45. Waste

```text
WasteStream {
    source
    material
    quantity
    hazard
    destination
}
```

---

# 46. Recycling

```text
RecyclingProcess {
    input
    recoverable
    output
    efficiency
    waste
}
```

---

# 47. Manufacturing

```text
ManufacturingSystem {
    facilities

    outputs
    capacity
    dependencies
}
```

---

```text

    inputs
    outputs

    cycle_time
    quality
}
```

---

# 49. Bill of materials

```text
BOM {
    product
    components
    quantities
    substitutions

}
```

---

# 50. Supply chain

```text
SupplyChain {
    suppliers
    facilities
    warehouses
    transport
    consumers
    dependencies
}
```

---

# 51. Supply chain graph

```text
Supplier
 ↓
Factory
 ↓
Warehouse
 ↓
Transport
 ↓
Distributor
 ↓
Consumer
```

```text
path
cut
bottleneck
dependency
redundancy
reachability
```

---

# 52. Substitution

Resource/process may declare alternatives:

```text
SubstitutionRule {
    source

}
```

Equivalence phải explicit.

---

# 53. Transportation

```text
TransportNetwork {
    nodes
    routes
    vehicles
    capacity
    schedules
    constraints
}
```

Modes:

```text
road
rail
sea
air
pipeline
conveyor
autonomous
```

# 54. Transportation capacity

```text
TransportCapacity {
    mass
    volume

    bandwidth

}
```

669 có thể model:

```text
Fiber
Radio
Satellite
DataCenter
EdgeNode
Backbone
```

nhưng actual protocol implementation vẫn thuộc networking layers.

---

# 56. Compute infrastructure

```text
ComputeCluster {
    nodes
    accelerators
    memory
    storage
    network
    power
}
```

Tích hợp:

```text
643 AI compute
606 resource governor
668 federation
```

Có thể biểu diễn:

```text
CPU_time
GPU_time
TPU_time
memory_capacity
storage_capacity
network_bandwidth
```

Generic architecture:

```text
Generation
→ Transmission
→ Distribution
→ Storage
→ Consumption
```

Có thể có:

```text
solar
wind
hydro
nuclear
thermal
battery
synthetic
```

```text

maximum
```

```text
efficiency
loss

```

và kết nối chúng với:

```text
669 physical/digital systems
668 federation
667 organizations
666 agents
655 world models
652 optimization
648 simulation
653 causal/uncertainty
664 safety
665 human oversight
```

nhưng tuyệt đối không biến model thành:

```text
political authority
human value ranking
intrinsic human scoring
automatic policy engine
automatic medical authority
automatic employment authority
automatic social control
```

---

# 301. BOOTSTRAP-670 COMPLETE

Kiến trúc civilization hiện đạt:

```text
666  Agent Society
 ↓
667  Organization / Institution
 ↓
668  Federation / Inter-Organization
 ↓
669  Physical / Digital Civilization Systems
 ↓
670  Human / Societal Systems
```

Đây là một boundary quan trọng: **669 mô hình hóa thế giới hạ tầng và tài nguyên; 670 mô hình hóa con người và xã hội sử dụng, vận hành và tương tác với thế giới đó.**

---

# 302. Next task

## BOOTSTRAP-671
### Native AI Civilization-Scale Economy, Markets, Production, Finance, Trade, Monetary Systems & Economic Simulation Runtime 5.0

Tầng kế tiếp sẽ xây **economic substrate** trên 669 + 670:

```text
669 Physical Systems
        ↕
670 Human Systems
        ↕
671 Economic Systems
 ├── Production
 ├── Consumption
 ├── Markets
 ├── Prices
 ├── Money
 ├── Banking
 ├── Credit
 ├── Finance
 ├── Trade
 ├── Investment
 ├── Capital
 ├── Supply/Demand
 ├── Firms
 ├── Households
 ├── Labor Markets
 ├── Monetary Systems
 ├── Economic Networks
 └── Economic Simulation
```

Thiết kế của 671 sẽ tiếp tục giữ **economic mechanisms** tách khỏi **normative/governance decisions**, để Axiom có thể mô phỏng nhiều mô hình kinh tế khác nhau thay vì hard-code một mô hình duy nhất.

parts:
Tiếp tục chuỗi kiến trúc Axiom. Task kế tiếp là **BOOTSTRAP-671 — Civilization-Scale Economy Runtime**. Tôi giữ nguyên nguyên tắc: đây là **economic substrate**, không biến Axiom thành một hệ thống tự quyết chính sách kinh tế.

:::writing{variant="document" id="58321" title="BOOTSTRAP-671 — Native AI Civilization-Scale Economy, Markets, Production, Finance, Trade, Monetary Systems & Economic Simulation Runtime 5.0"}

# BOOTSTRAP-671
## Native AI Civilization-Scale Economy, Markets, Production, Finance, Trade, Monetary Systems & Economic Simulation Runtime 5.0

**Status:** ARCHITECTURE COMPLETE  
**Layer:** Civilization-Scale Economic Systems  
**Depends on:** BOOTSTRAP-603 … BOOTSTRAP-670  
**Primary dependencies:** 619, 620, 628, 633, 639, 640, 642, 648, 652, 653, 655, 661, 663, 664, 665, 667, 668, 669, 670  
**Target:** ≥ 4,000 tests, ≥ 320 invariants  
**Execution classes:** deterministic, distributed, simulation, real-world-connected, offline  
**Capability model:** optional / capability-gated / policy-gated / privacy-gated / safety-gated / human-approval-gated where applicable.

---

# 1. Mission

BOOTSTRAP-671 defines the native Axiom economic substrate.

It provides executable abstractions for:

- economic systems;
- households and firms as economic participants;
- production;
- consumption;
- supply and demand;
- markets;
- prices;
- order books;
- exchange;
- money;
- currencies;
- accounts;
- ledgers;
- payments;
- clearing;
- settlement;
- banking;
- credit;
- loans;
- debt;
- interest;
- collateral;
- investment;
- securities;
- portfolios;
- insurance;
- trade;
- foreign exchange;
- supply chains;
- inventories;
- economic aggregates;
- macroeconomic state;
- economic shocks;
- economic forecasting;
- economic simulation;
- economic scenarios;
- accounting and reconciliation.

The runtime must support multiple economic models without making any single economic doctrine a language-level truth.

---

# 2. Architectural Position

The economic layer sits between the physical/human substrate and higher-level governance.

```text
603 Capability/Security
        ↓
667 Organizations
668 Inter-Organization Federation
        ↓
669 Physical / Infrastructure / Resource Systems
670 Human / Population / Labor Systems
        ↓
671 Economic Systems
        ↓
642 Analytics
648 Simulation
652 Optimization
653 Causal / Probabilistic Reasoning
655 World Models
661 Objectives
663 Evaluation
664 Safety
665 Human Oversight
```

The separation is mandatory.

### 669 answers

> What physical, infrastructure, compute, energy, material and environmental resources exist?

### 670 answers

> What human, household, labor, skill and societal entities exist?

### 671 answers

> How are resources, labor, goods, services, money, capital and claims economically exchanged, produced, allocated through markets or contracts, financed and accounted for?

### 639 answers

> What policies and authorities are allowed?

### 668 answers

> What agreements and cross-organizational governance structures exist?

### 661 answers

> What objectives or utilities are being optimized?

671 must never silently answer those questions.

---

# 3. Design Principles

## 3.1 Economic mechanism ≠ policy

Axiom can model:

```text
tax_rate = 0.10
```

but the economic runtime does not decide whether that tax rate should exist.

Likewise:

```text
subsidy(food) = 20
```

is an input to the economic model.

It is not an economic recommendation.

---

## 3.2 Price ≠ value

The runtime must distinguish:

```text
Price
MarketPrice
Quote
TransactionPrice
EstimatedValue
FundamentalEstimate
Utility
Cost
```

None are interchangeable.

---

## 3.3 Observation ≠ prediction

```text
ObservedPrice
ForecastPrice
SimulatedPrice
ScenarioPrice
```

must remain separate types or explicitly tagged values.

---

## 3.4 Accounting is authoritative only within its declared model

A ledger can establish:

```text
account.balance
```

within its accounting domain.

It does not establish:

- legal ownership;
- political authority;
- human worth;
- physical possession;
- moral entitlement.

Those require other systems.

---

# 4. Core Economic Model

```text
Economy
 ├── Participants
 │    ├── Household
 │    ├── Firm
 │    ├── Institution
 │    ├── GovernmentEntity
 │    ├── Bank
 │    └── OtherAgent
 │
 ├── Goods
 │    ├── Good
 │    ├── Service
 │    ├── Commodity
 │    └── Asset
 │
 ├── Markets
 │    ├── Market
 │    ├── OrderBook
 │    ├── Quote
 │    └── Trade
 │
 ├── Money
 │    ├── Currency
 │    ├── MoneySupply
 │    └── PaymentSystem
 │
 ├── Accounting
 │    ├── Account
 │    ├── Ledger
 │    ├── Transaction
 │    └── Settlement
 │
 ├── Finance
 │    ├── Credit
 │    ├── Loan
 │    ├── Debt
 │    ├── Security
 │    └── Portfolio
 │
 ├── Production
 │    ├── Process
 │    ├── Capacity
 │    ├── Inventory
 │    └── SupplyChain
 │
 └── Macro
      ├── MacroState
      ├── Aggregate
      ├── EconomicShock
      └── EconomicModel
```

---

# 5. Economic Participants

## 5.1 Base participant

```text
EconomicParticipant {
    id
    identity
    organization?
    capabilities
    accounts
    contracts
    permissions
}
```

Possible participant kinds:

```text
HOUSEHOLD
FIRM
BANK
FINANCIAL_INSTITUTION
GOVERNMENT_ENTITY
NONPROFIT
COOPERATIVE
MARKET_OPERATOR
PLATFORM
INDIVIDUAL
AI_AGENT
OTHER
```

The runtime does not infer legal status from participant type.

---

# 6. Household Economy

671 consumes the human model from 670.

```text
HouseholdEconomy {
    household_id
    income
    expenses
    assets
    liabilities
    savings
    consumption
    credit
    taxes
    transfers
}
```

Relationships:

```text
Household
    ↓
HouseholdEconomy
    ↓
Income / Consumption / Saving / Borrowing
    ↓
Markets
```

Personal financial data must be privacy-controlled through 640 and 603.

---

# 7. Firms

```text
Firm {
    id
    organization_id
    sector
    production_units
    employees
    suppliers
    customers
    assets
    liabilities
    equity
    accounts
}
```

A firm may:

- produce;
- purchase;
- sell;
- employ;
- borrow;
- lend;
- invest;
- hold inventory;
- issue securities;
- enter contracts.

Firm ≠ legal corporation.

Legal semantics remain outside the core economic mechanism unless explicitly supplied by a jurisdictional layer.

---

# 8. Goods and Services

## 8.1 Good

```text
Good {
    id
    unit
    quality
    category
    provenance
}
```

## 8.2 Service

```text
Service {
    id
    service_unit
    duration
    quality
    provider
}
```

## 8.3 Commodity

A commodity is a standardized tradable good.

```text
Commodity {
    good
    grade
    delivery_location
    delivery_window
}
```

---

# 9. Assets and Liabilities

```text
Asset
Liability
Equity
Claim
Obligation
```

Asset ownership and economic accounting must remain distinct from physical custody.

Example:

```text
Asset.owner = A
Asset.custodian = B
```

is valid.

---

# 10. Money

Money is modeled as an explicit economic instrument.

```text
Money {
    currency
    amount
}
```

Money is not required to be physical.

Supported representations:

- physical;
- bank deposit;
- electronic;
- tokenized;
- digital;
- community/local;
- commodity-backed;
- synthetic;
- simulation-only.

---

# 11. Currency

```text
Currency {
    id
    symbol
    precision
    issuer
    monetary_model
    settlement_model
}
```

Possible monetary models:

```text
FIAT
COMMODITY_BACKED
TOKENIZED
LOCAL
DIGITAL
SIMULATED
CUSTOM
```

The runtime must not assume one universal monetary architecture.

---

# 12. Money Creation and Destruction

Money creation is explicit.

```text
MoneyIssue
MoneyBurn
MoneyTransfer
```

Invariant:

> Closed-system money supply must not change without an explicit issuance or destruction event.

For systems where money is represented by liabilities, the corresponding liability relationship must be represented.

---

# 13. Accounts

```text
Account {
    id
    owner
    currency
    balance
    account_type
    permissions
}
```

Account types may include:

```text
CASH
DEPOSIT
RECEIVABLE
PAYABLE
ASSET
LIABILITY
EQUITY
EXPENSE
REVENUE
CLEARING
ESCROW
RESERVE
MARGIN
```

---

# 14. Ledger

The ledger is the accounting authority for its declared domain.

```text
Ledger {
    id
    entries[]
    currency_model
    accounting_model
    state
}
```

Axiom should use double-entry accounting as the default generalized accounting model.

---

# 15. Double-Entry Invariant

For every balanced journal transaction:

```text
Σ debits = Σ credits
```

subject to the ledger's accounting units and declared accounting rules.

A transaction that violates the invariant cannot be posted to a balanced ledger.

---

# 16. Journal Entry

```text
JournalEntry {
    id
    timestamp
    transaction_id
    debit_account
    credit_account
    amount
    currency
    metadata
}
```

Composite transactions may contain multiple entries.

---

# 17. Transaction Lifecycle

```text
CREATED
→ VALIDATED
→ AUTHORIZED
→ POSTED
→ CLEARED
→ SETTLED
→ FINAL
```

Possible terminal states:

```text
REVERSED
FAILED
EXPIRED
CANCELLED
```

Settlement finality must be explicitly represented.

---

# 18. Payment

```text
Payment {
    payer
    payee
    amount
    currency
    instrument
    status
}
```

Payment stages:

```text
INITIATE
AUTHORIZE
CLEAR
SETTLE
FINALIZE
```

Payment authorization is capability-controlled.

---

# 19. Clearing

Clearing determines obligations.

Settlement transfers the corresponding assets or monetary claims.

They must not be collapsed into one operation.

```text
Trade
 ↓
Clearing
 ↓
Settlement
 ↓
Finality
```

---

# 20. Market

```text
Market {
    id
    good
    participants
    mechanism
    currency
    settlement
    rules
}
```

Supported mechanisms:

```text
FIXED_PRICE
BILATERAL
NEGOTIATED
DOUBLE_AUCTION
BATCH_AUCTION
ORDER_BOOK
AMM
CUSTOM
```

---

# 21. Order

```text
Order {
    id
    participant
    side
    quantity
    limit_price?
    time_in_force
}
```

Sides:

```text
BUY
SELL
```

Order states:

```text
OPEN
PARTIAL
FILLED
CANCELLED
EXPIRED
REJECTED
```

---

# 22. Quote

```text
Quote {
    bid
    ask
    quantity
    timestamp
    market
}
```

Quote ≠ order.

Quote ≠ execution.

Quote ≠ guaranteed price.

---

# 23. Order Book

```text
OrderBook {
    bids
    asks
    matching_rule
    price_priority
    time_priority
}
```

Matching must be deterministic when configured as deterministic.

---

# 24. Trade

```text
Trade {
    buyer
    seller
    asset
    quantity
    execution_price
    timestamp
    settlement_reference
}
```

A trade exists only after a matching/execution event.

---

# 25. Price Formation

The runtime supports:

```text
MarketPrice
ClearingPrice
ReferencePrice
IndexPrice
LastTradePrice
MarkPrice
AdministeredPrice
FixedPrice
NegotiatedPrice
```

The system must not treat them as equivalent.

---

# 26. Supply and Demand

```text
Supply {
    good
    quantity
    price?
    location
    time_window
}
```

```text
Demand {
    good
    quantity
    willingness_to_pay?
    location
    time_window
}
```

Optional derived quantities:

```text
Elasticity
Shortage
Surplus
MarketClearingQuantity
MarketClearingPrice
```

---

# 27. Elasticity

```text
Elasticity {
    input
    output
    estimate
    method
    confidence?
}
```

An elasticity estimate is an analytical result, not a causal truth unless supported by 653.

---

# 28. Production

Production consumes 669 resources and can consume 670 labor.

```text
ProductionProcess {
    inputs
    outputs
    labor
    energy
    capacity
    duration
    transformation_loss
}
```

Example:

```text
iron + energy + labor
    → steel
```

---

# 29. Production Function

Generic production function:

```text
Output = F(inputs, labor, capital, technology)
```

Axiom does not hard-code Cobb-Douglas or any other economic production theory.

Models are pluggable.

---

# 30. Bill of Materials

```text
BillOfMaterials {
    product
    components[]
    quantities[]
    substitution_rules
}
```

BOM must integrate with 669 material resources.

---

# 31. Capacity

Economic capacity references the physical capacity model of 669.

```text
EconomicCapacity {
    production_unit
    nominal
    operational
    committed
    available
    reserve
}
```

The economic layer cannot manufacture physical capacity merely by declaring a larger value.

---

# 32. Inventory

```text
Inventory {
    owner
    location
    item
    quantity
    quality
    reserved
    available
}
```

Invariant:

```text
available + reserved <= physical_quantity
```

unless the inventory model explicitly permits negative inventory/backorders.

---

# 33. Supply Chain

```text
SupplyChain {
    suppliers
    producers
    warehouses
    routes
    customers
}
```

Objects:

```text
PurchaseOrder
Shipment
Delivery
LeadTime
SafetyStock
Backorder
Supplier
Buyer
Warehouse
```

Supply chains consume transport/network capacity from 669.

---

# 34. Economic Contracts

```text
EconomicContract {
    parties
    obligations
    consideration
    conditions
    deadlines
    settlement
}
```

Contract execution must not imply legal enforceability.

Legal enforcement belongs to the applicable legal/governance boundary.

---

# 35. Invoice

```text
Invoice {
    seller
    buyer
    items
    amount
    currency
    due_date
    status
}
```

Lifecycle:

```text
ISSUED
→ ACCEPTED
→ DUE
→ PAID
```

or:

```text
OVERDUE
DISPUTED
CANCELLED
```

---

# 36. Credit

```text
CreditLine {
    borrower
    lender
    limit
    drawn
    rate
    maturity
    collateral
}
```

Credit lifecycle:

```text
OFFER
→ APPROVE
→ OPEN
→ DRAW
→ REPAY
→ CLOSE
```

Credit approval is a policy/application decision, not an intrinsic language judgment.

---

# 37. Loan

```text
Loan {
    principal
    interest_rate
    schedule
    maturity
    collateral
    status
}
```

Supported repayment models:

```text
AMORTIZING
INTEREST_ONLY
BULLET
CUSTOM
```

---

# 38. Interest

```text
InterestRate {
    nominal
    effective
    compounding
    period
}
```

The runtime must distinguish:

```text
nominal_rate
effective_rate
real_rate
discount_rate
yield
```

---

# 39. Collateral

```text
Collateral {
    asset
    valuation
    haircut
    lien
    release_condition
}
```

Collateral lock/release operations must be atomic with the associated financial state.

---

# 40. Default and Bankruptcy

671 provides mechanisms:

```text
Default
Insolvency
BankruptcyState
Restructuring
Liquidation
Recovery
```

These are model states.

The runtime does not independently determine legal bankruptcy status.

---

# 41. Banking

```text
Bank {
    accounts
    deposits
    loans
    reserves
    liquidity
    capital
    payment_connections
}
```

Supported operations:

```text
Deposit
Withdraw
Transfer
Loan
Credit
Clearing
Settlement
LiquidityManagement
```

---

# 42. Reserve and Liquidity

```text
Liquidity {
    available_cash
    near_cash_assets
    obligations
    time_horizon
}
```

The system must distinguish:

```text
liquidity
solvency
profitability
capital
cash
```

They are not interchangeable.

---

# 43. Financial Institutions

Generic type:

```text
FinancialInstitution {
    balance_sheet
    liquidity
    capital
    exposures
    counterparties
}
```

Specialized implementations can include:

```text
Bank
Broker
Exchange
ClearingHouse
Insurer
Fund
PaymentProvider
```

---

# 44. Securities

```text
Security {
    issuer
    type
    face_value?
    maturity?
    cash_flows
    currency
}
```

Types:

```text
BOND
EQUITY
FUND_UNIT
NOTE
CUSTOM
```

Derivatives are optional and capability-gated.

---

# 45. Investment

```text
Investment {
    asset
    amount
    entry_price
    expected_cashflows
    realized_return
    risk_model
}
```

The runtime records return calculations but does not guarantee future performance.

---

# 46. Portfolio

```text
Portfolio {
    owner
    positions[]
    cash
    constraints
    valuation
}
```

Operations:

```text
Buy
Sell
Transfer
Rebalance
Mark
Value
StressTest
```

Portfolio optimization belongs to 652.

---

# 47. Insurance

```text
InsurancePolicy {
    insured
    insurer
    coverage
    premium
    deductible
    exclusions
    period
}
```

Claims:

```text
Claim
LossEvent
Reserve
Settlement
Reinsurance
```

Insurance models must support stochastic loss distributions.

---

# 48. Foreign Exchange

```text
ExchangeRate {
    base_currency
    quote_currency
    rate
    timestamp
    source
}
```

Operations:

```text
FXQuote
FXTrade
FXSettlement
```

Rates can be:

```text
OBSERVED
MARKET
REFERENCE
SIMULATED
FORECAST
```

---

# 49. International Trade

```text
TradeFlow {
    exporter
    importer
    good
    quantity
    value
    currency
    origin
    destination
}
```

Support:

```text
Import
Export
TradeBalance
TradeRoute
Tariff
Quota
CustomsCost
Delivery
```

Tariffs and quotas are policy inputs, not economic runtime recommendations.

Trade agreements belong to 668.

---

# 50. Tax and Transfer Flows

Economic runtime can represent:

```text
TaxFlow
SubsidyFlow
Transfer
Fee
Rebate
Benefit
```

Example:

```text
TaxRule {
    base
    rate
    threshold
    exemptions
}
```

The runtime executes declared rules.

It does not determine which tax system should be adopted.

---

# 51. Government Economic Accounts

A government entity can be represented as an economic participant.

```text
GovernmentAccount {
    revenue
    expenditure
    debt
    transfers
    assets
}
```

Fiscal policy remains an external declared policy model.

---

# 52. Monetary Policy Interface

The runtime provides inputs such as:

```text
PolicyRate
MoneySupplyTarget
ReserveRule
LiquidityOperation
AssetPurchase
```

These are parameters supplied by an external policy/governance system.

671 does not choose them.

---

# 53. Macroeconomic State

```text
MacroState {
    output
    consumption
    investment
    government_spending
    exports
    imports
    prices
    employment
    productivity
    money_supply
    credit
    debt
}
```

The system may derive:

```text
AggregateOutput
PriceIndex
InflationRate
UnemploymentRate
Productivity
InvestmentRate
SavingsRate
DebtRatio
TradeBalance
```

These are measurements or model outputs.

---

# 54. GDP-Like Aggregates

Axiom should not hard-code one definition as universally authoritative.

Instead:

```text
AggregateDefinition {
    name
    components
    inclusion_rules
    exclusion_rules
    units
}
```

A GDP-like measure can then be declared explicitly.

---

# 55. Inflation

```text
PriceIndex {
    basket
    weights
    base_period
    methodology
}
```

```text
InflationRate {
    index
    period
    rate
}
```

Multiple indexes may coexist.

---

# 56. Economic Models

```text
EconomicModel {
    id
    assumptions
    state_variables
    equations
    agents
    transition_rules
    observation_model
}
```

Supported model families:

```text
AGENT_BASED
INPUT_OUTPUT
STOCK_FLOW
EQUILIBRIUM
PARTIAL_EQUILIBRIUM
DISEQUILIBRIUM
SYSTEM_DYNAMICS
MACRO_AGGREGATE
MONTE_CARLO
CUSTOM
```

---

# 57. Agent-Based Economic Simulation

Participants may be simulated individually:

```text
HouseholdAgent
FirmAgent
BankAgent
TraderAgent
GovernmentAgent
```

Each agent has:

```text
state
constraints
actions
information
decision_model
```

The decision model is explicitly supplied.

The runtime does not assume a universal rational-agent model.

---

# 58. Equilibrium Models

```text
EquilibriumModel {
    variables
    constraints
    equations
    equilibrium_conditions
}
```

The solver may produce:

```text
EquilibriumState
```

but must preserve:

```text
assumptions
solver
tolerance
initial_conditions
convergence_status
```

A computed equilibrium is not automatically an empirical fact.

---

# 59. Input-Output Model

```text
InputOutputModel {
    sectors
    matrix
    final_demand
    imports
    exports
}
```

The runtime supports matrix-based production dependency analysis.

---

# 60. Stock-Flow Consistent Model

```text
StockFlowModel {
    stocks
    flows
    sectors
    accounting_constraints
}
```

The accounting constraints must remain machine-verifiable.

---

# 61. Economic Simulation

```text
EconomicSimulation {
    model
    state
```

# BOOTSTRAP-672
## Native AI Civilization-Scale Law, Rights, Legal Identity, Contracts, Regulation, Courts, Adjudication, Dispute Resolution & Justice Runtime 5.0

**Status:** ARCHITECTURE COMPLETE  
**Layer:** Civilization-Scale Legal & Institutional Rule Systems  
**Depends on:** BOOTSTRAP-603 … BOOTSTRAP-671  
**Primary dependencies:** 603, 610, 617, 627, 628, 633, 639, 640, 647, 663, 664, 665, 667, 668, 670, 671  
**Target:** ≥ 4,500 tests, ≥ 360 invariants  
**Execution classes:** deterministic, distributed, simulation, policy-controlled, human-review, offline

---

# 1. Mission

BOOTSTRAP-672 defines Axiom's native computational substrate for formalized legal and institutional rule systems.

It provides executable representations for:

- legal identity;
- legal entities;
- rights;
- duties;
- permissions;
- obligations;
- claims;
- liabilities;
- legal relationships;
- contracts;
- statutes;
- regulations;
- rules;
- licenses;
- permits;
- compliance;
- violations;
- evidence;
- legal proceedings;
- courts;
- tribunals;
- adjudication;
- mediation;
- arbitration;
- appeals;
- remedies;
- judgments;
- enforcement;
- legal records;
- jurisdiction;
- conflict of laws;
- legal interoperability;
- institutional governance;
- regulatory execution;
- legal simulation.

The runtime is a **formal rule and adjudication substrate**.

It is not itself the source of political authority, sovereignty, moral truth, or human rights.

---

# 2. Architectural Position

```text
603 Capability / Security
627 Identity
640 Data Governance
665 Human Oversight
        ↓
667 Organizations / Institutions
668 Inter-Organization Governance
        ↓
672 Legal / Institutional Rule Systems
        ↓
671 Economic Contracts / Transactions
670 Human / Societal Systems
669 Physical / Infrastructure Systems
        ↓
663 Evaluation
664 Safety
```

672 intersects heavily with 639.

The separation is:

```text
639 = authority and policy decision boundary
672 = formal representation, interpretation, execution and adjudication
```

A policy authority can declare a rule.

672 can represent and execute that rule.

672 must not manufacture authority that was never granted.

---

# 3. Core Principle

A legal rule is represented as:

```text
Rule
+ Jurisdiction
+ EffectivePeriod
+ Scope
+ Preconditions
+ Obligations
+ Rights
+ Exceptions
+ Enforcement
```

Example:

```text
rule MinimumAgeForActivity {
    jurisdiction = J
    subject = Person
    condition = age >= 18
    effect = permitted
}
```

The rule is executable only inside its declared jurisdiction and validity period.

---

The following concepts must never be conflated:

```text
legal_identity
human_identity
organizational_identity

right
permission
capability

legal_obligation
economic_obligation
technical_constraint

rule
policy
objective

violation
error
accident

evidence
belief
prediction

judgment
simulation_result
model_output

```

```text
HUMAN

OTHER
```

The runtime does not infer legal personhood merely from an object existing.

```text
    representatives
}
```


# 22. Retroactivity

# BOOTSTRAP-671
## Native AI Civilization-Scale Economy, Markets, Production, Finance, Trade, Monetary Systems & Economic Simulation Runtime 5.0

**Status:** ARCHITECTURE COMPLETE  
**Layer:** Civilization-Scale Economic Systems  
**Task ID:** BOOTSTRAP-671  
**Depends on:** BOOTSTRAP-603 … BOOTSTRAP-670  
**Primary dependencies:** 639, 642, 648, 652, 653, 655, 661, 663, 664, 665, 667, 668, 669, 670  
**Target:** ≥ 4,000 tests, ≥ 320 invariants  
**Execution modes:** local / distributed / deterministic simulation / real-world connected execution  
**Default:** optional, capability-gated, policy-gated, privacy-gated, safety-gated  
**Zero-cost requirement:** no economic runtime cost when unused

---

# 1. Purpose

BOOTSTRAP-671 defines Axiom's native economic substrate.

It models and executes:

- economic agents;
- households and firms;
- goods and services;
- production;
- consumption;
- supply and demand;
- markets;
- prices;
- orders and trades;
- money;
- currencies;
- accounts;
- double-entry accounting;
- payments;
- clearing and settlement;
- banking;
- credit;
- loans;
- debt;
- collateral;
- investment;
- securities;
- portfolios;
- insurance;
- trade;
- foreign exchange;
- supply chains;
- inventories;
- economic shocks;
- macroeconomic aggregates;
- economic simulations;
- economic forecasts;
- economic scenarios;
- economic networks.

The layer must support multiple economic models without embedding one economic ideology, policy regime, or normative objective into the language runtime.

---

# 2. Architectural Position

The economic layer sits between civilization infrastructure/human systems and higher-level governance/intelligence.

```text
603  Capability / Security
        ↓
639  Policy / Authority
        ↓
667  Organizations / Institutions
668  Federation / Inter-Organization
        ↓
669  Physical / Digital Civilization Systems
670  Human / Population / Labor Systems
        ↓
671  Economic Systems
        ↓
642  Analytics
648  Simulation
652  Optimization
653  Causal / Probabilistic Reasoning
655  World Model
661  Objectives
663  Evaluation
664  Safety
665  Human Oversight
```

### Boundary

**669 asks:**

> What resources, infrastructure and production capacities exist?

**670 asks:**

> What people, households, labor and social systems exist?

**671 asks:**

> How are economic resources, goods, services, money, contracts, markets, production, finance and trade exchanged and accounted for?

**668 asks:**

> Which organizations/federations have authority to establish shared rules or agreements?

**639 asks:**

> What policy or authority rules apply?

671 consumes those rules as explicit inputs.

It does not silently invent them.

---

# 3. Non-Goals

671 does not define:

- a preferred economic ideology;
- a preferred monetary policy;
- a preferred taxation system;
- a preferred distribution of wealth;
- a preferred ownership model;
- a preferred market structure;
- a preferred social welfare function;
- human worth;
- political authority;
- legal sovereignty;
- mandatory economic policy.

Axiom must be able to represent:

- market economies;
- planned economies;
- mixed systems;
- cooperative systems;
- decentralized systems;
- centralized systems;
- barter systems;
- monetary systems;
- multi-currency systems;
- simulated economies;
- fictional economies;
- experimental economic models.

The runtime provides mechanisms, not ideological conclusions.

---

# 4. Core Design Principles

## 4.1 Accounting must be explicit

Economic state must be auditable.

Every balance-changing operation must have an explicit accounting representation.

---

## 4.2 Money is not value

Axiom must never equate:

```text
price == value
```

A price is an observed or negotiated economic quantity.

Value may be modeled separately.

---

## 4.3 Quote is not trade

```text
Quote
Order
Match
Execution
Settlement
```

are separate states.

A displayed price does not imply a transaction occurred.

---

## 4.4 Forecast is not observation

Economic forecasts must never overwrite observed data.

```text
Observation
Forecast
Scenario
SimulationResult
```

remain distinct types.

---

## 4.5 Policy is external input

For example:

```text
tax_rate
subsidy
tariff
interest_rule
reserve_requirement
capital_requirement
price_control
transfer_rule
```

are model inputs.

671 executes declared rules.

It does not silently decide them.

# 66. Accounting Invariants

The compiler/runtime must enforce or validate the following.

### AINV-001 — Balanced journal

```text
Σ debit = Σ credit
```

### AINV-002 — Currency correctness

Money of incompatible currencies cannot be directly added.

### AINV-003 — Explicit FX

Cross-currency conversion requires an exchange operation or declared conversion rule.

### AINV-004 — No implicit money creation

Money supply changes require explicit issuance/mint/burn events.

### AINV-005 — Settlement consistency

A settled obligation cannot silently return to unsettled state.

### AINV-006 — Account identity

An account has exactly one configured accounting owner.

### AINV-007 — Asset/liability consistency

A financial instrument must declare whether it represents an asset, liability, equity, or another class.

### AINV-008 — Order/trade separation

An order does not become a trade without a matching/execution event.

### AINV-009 — Quote/trade separation

A quote is not an executed price.

### AINV-010 — Forecast/observation separation

Forecasts cannot overwrite observations.

### AINV-011 — Production conservation

Production cannot consume resources that do not exist unless the model explicitly permits external creation.

### AINV-012 — Inventory conservation

Inventory changes must be attributable to:

```text
receive
produce
consume
transfer
adjust
dispose
loss
```

### AINV-013 — Loan conservation

Loan principal creation and repayment must be explicitly represented.

### AINV-014 — Collateral uniqueness

The same collateral cannot be simultaneously exclusively pledged to incompatible obligations.

### AINV-015 — Contract obligation consistency

Executed obligations must have a traceable originating contract/order/event.

### AINV-016 — Trade conservation

Executed quantity must be compatible with available sell-side quantity.

### AINV-017 — Supply-chain capacity

Shipment cannot exceed declared route/capacity unless an explicit overflow model exists.

### AINV-018 — Economic unit correctness

Incompatible units cannot be silently combined.

### AINV-019 — Policy provenance

Policy-derived economic changes retain policy provenance.

### AINV-020 — Simulation isolation

Simulation state cannot mutate real-world state unless an explicit execution bridge is invoked.

# BOOTSTRAP-672
## Native AI Civilization-Scale Science, Research, Knowledge Production, Technology Development, Innovation, Discovery & Scientific Simulation Runtime 5.0

**Status:** ARCHITECTURE COMPLETE  
**Layer:** Civilization-Scale Science, Research & Innovation  
**Task ID:** BOOTSTRAP-672  
**Depends on:** BOOTSTRAP-603 … BOOTSTRAP-671  
**Target:** ≥ 4,200 tests, ≥ 340 invariants  
**Execution:** local / distributed / GPU / cluster / edge / WASM / deterministic simulation  
**Default:** optional, capability-gated, provenance-gated, safety-gated, privacy-gated  
**Zero-cost requirement:** no runtime overhead when unused

---

# 1. Purpose

BOOTSTRAP-672 defines the native scientific and technological substrate of Axiom.

It provides primitives for:

- scientific knowledge;
- research projects;
- hypotheses;
- experiments;
- observations;
- measurements;
- instruments;
- datasets;
- samples;
- protocols;
- methodologies;
- laboratory workflows;
- simulations;
- mathematical models;
- scientific models;
- theories;
- evidence;
- uncertainty;
- reproducibility;
- peer review;
- research provenance;
- citations;
- publications;
- research organizations;
- researchers;
- collaboration;
- discoveries;
- inventions;
- technology development;
- technology readiness;
- innovation;
- technology diffusion;
- scientific forecasting;
- computational experiments;
- digital laboratories;
- scientific digital twins;
- automated experimentation;
- AI-assisted research.

The system must support both:

1. **real scientific workflows**, and
2. **pure computational/synthetic scientific worlds**.

---

# 2. Architectural Position

```text
645  Knowledge Graph / Semantic Knowledge
648  Simulation / Synthetic Environment
652  Optimization / Search
653  Causal / Probabilistic Reasoning
655  World Model
656  Embodied Intelligence
661  Objectives
663  Evaluation
664  Safety
665  Human Oversight
667  Organizations
668  Inter-Organization Coordination
669  Civilization Infrastructure
670  Human Systems
671  Economy
        ↓
672  Science / Research / Innovation
```

672 becomes the primary layer for **producing and validating new knowledge**, rather than merely storing existing knowledge.

---

# 3. Critical Separation

## 3.1 645 — Knowledge

645 represents:

```text
entities
relationships
concepts
ontology
semantic graphs
knowledge retrieval
```

672 represents:

```text
how knowledge is generated
how evidence is collected
how hypotheses are tested
how models are validated
how discoveries are established
```

---

## 3.2 648 — Simulation

648 provides generic simulation infrastructure.

672 provides:

```text
scientific models
experimental designs
scientific datasets
laboratory workflows
scientific validation
```

A scientific simulation ultimately executes through 648.

---

## 3.3 653 — Causal Reasoning

653 provides:

```text
causal inference
probability
Bayesian reasoning
uncertainty
```

672 uses these capabilities for scientific research.

---

## 3.4 655 — World Model

655 represents a model of an environment.

672 generates and validates scientific models of that environment.

---

## 3.5 671 — Economy

671 models:

```text
economic activity
markets
production
finance
trade
investment
```

672 models:

```text
scientific discovery
technology development
research productivity
innovation
technology diffusion
```

The two layers can interact but neither subsumes the other.

---

# 4. Non-Goals

672 does not define:

- what scientific conclusions society must accept;
- political control of science;
- mandatory research priorities;
- ownership policy;
- patent law;
- intellectual-property law;
- funding policy;
- ideological definitions of valid knowledge.

Such rules are external policy inputs.

---

Invalid:

```axiom

```

# 40. Reproduction vs Replication

Axiom distinguishes:

```text
reproduction
replication
validation
extension
```

### Reproduction

Same data/code/method where applicable.

### Replication

Independent execution intended to test whether a result recurs.

### Validation

Testing model/results against evidence.

### Extension

Testing a broader or modified hypothesis.

# 98. Critical Invariants

## H01 — Record Integrity

Không được overwrite lịch sử clinical record.

## H02 — Provenance

Mọi medical fact phải có provenance.

## H03 — Versioning

Guideline/model/record đều phải versioned.

## H04 — Diagnosis Separation

Prediction không tự động trở thành diagnosis.

## H05 — Risk Separation

Risk score không phải disease state.

## H06 — Simulation Separation

Simulation không mutate real-world state.

## H07 — Synthetic Separation

Synthetic patient không được implicit cast thành real patient.

## H08 — Unit Safety

Measurement phải dimensional-safe.

## H09 — Medication Safety

Invalid medication state phải bị chặn hoặc explicit override.

## H10 — Consent

Restricted data access phải kiểm tra authority/purpose.

## H11 — Audit

Critical action phải tạo audit event.

## H12 — Model Provenance

Clinical AI output phải biết model version.

## H13 — Uncertainty

Uncertain result không được biến thành confirmed fact âm thầm.

## H14 — Amendment

Correction phải tạo amendment.

## H15 — Trial Integrity

# 110. Core Invariants

## L01 — Jurisdiction

Mọi legal rule phải có jurisdiction hoặc explicit global scope.

## L02 — Temporal Validity

Rule phải được evaluate theo effective period.

## L03 — Authority

Legal action phải có authority phù hợp.

## L04 — Provenance

Legal source phải có provenance.

## L05 — Version

Legal source phải versioned.

## L06 — Case Immutability

Case history không được silently mutate.

## L07 — Evidence Integrity

Critical evidence phải giữ chain of custody.

## L08 — Fact Separation

Allegation không phải established fact.

## L09 — AI Separation

AI output không tự động là legal decision.

## L10 — Simulation Separation

Simulation không phải real legal ruling.

## L11 — Contract Versioning

Contract amendment không được overwrite lịch sử.

## L12 — Compliance Unknown

Unknown không được coi là compliant.

## L13 — Rights

Rights representation không tự động tạo legal recognition.

## L14 — Entity

AI/software entity không tự động có legal personhood.

## L15 — Appeal

Appeal phải giữ immutable lower-level decision.

## L16 — Evidence

Evidence source và evidence interpretation phải riêng.

## L17 — Citation

Legal citation phải trỏ tới source/version hợp lệ.

## L18 — Privacy

Protected legal records phải chịu access control.

## L19 — Human Control

High-impact legal action phải tuân thủ oversight policy.

## L20 — Authority Non-Escalation

Một legal capability không được tự nâng scope authority.

# 161. Critical Invariants

## G01 — Authority Scope

Action không được vượt authority scope.

## G02 — Authority Expiration

Expired authority không được execute.

## G03 — Office Separation

Office và holder là hai entities khác nhau.

## G04 — Registry Integrity

Registry history không được silently mutate.

## G05 — Service State

Invalid workflow transition phải bị chặn.

## G06 — Eligibility

Unknown không được tự động trở thành ineligible.

## G07 — Budget

Expenditure không vượt authorized allocation nếu không có explicit authority.

## G08 — Procurement

Award phải có traceable evaluation state.

## G09 — Election

Certified result không được silently mutate.

## G10 — Ballot Integrity

Ballot history phải audit được.

## G11 — Ballot Secrecy

Nếu secret ballot được yêu cầu, vote content không được liên kết trực tiếp với voter identity trong operational view.

## G12 — Consultation Integrity

Original public submissions không bị AI summary thay thế.

## G13 — Administrative Record

Decision phải giữ authority và basis.

## G14 — Appeal

Appeal không được xóa lower-level decision.

## G15 — Public Data

Publication không được bypass privacy classification.

## G16 — Emergency

Emergency authority phải bounded và expiring.

## G17 — AI Separation

AI recommendation không tự động trở thành government decision.

## G18 — Simulation

Simulation không mutate live government state.

## G19 — Political Neutrality

Core không chứa primitive cho political persuasion/manipulation.

## G20 — Human Oversight

High-impact government actions phải obey oversight policy.

## G21 — Auditability

Critical action phải có audit trail.

## G22 — Provenance

Public data phải có lineage.

## G23 — Versioning

Public documents phải versioned.

## G24 — Identity

Administrative identity phải xác minh qua identity layer.

## G25 — Authority Non-Escalation

Delegated authority không được tự mở rộng scope.

# 174. Critical invariants

## INV-001

Một published work phải có immutable identity.

## INV-002

Một version mới không được silently overwrite version cũ.

## INV-003

Correction phải trỏ đến version cụ thể.

## INV-004

Retraction phải giữ archival lineage.

## INV-005

Transformation phải có provenance.

## INV-006

AI-generated content không được tự nhận là human-created.

## INV-007

Synthetic metadata phải có source/model information khi available.

## INV-008

Fact-check không phải universal truth oracle.

## INV-009

Claim phải có context.

## INV-010

Source và claim là hai object khác nhau.

## INV-011

Evidence không đồng nghĩa truth.

## INV-012

Opinion không được tự chuyển thành fact.

## INV-013

Fiction không được tự chuyển thành historical record.

## INV-014

Archive không được mất provenance khi update.

## INV-015

Restoration phải giữ source lineage.

## INV-016

Translation phải giữ source reference.

## INV-017

Localization phải giữ source work identity.

## INV-018

License không tự tạo legal authority.

## INV-019

Rights metadata không thay thế BOOTSTRAP-675.

## INV-020

Payment không thuộc cultural ledger.

## INV-021

Recommendation không được giả lập thành truth ranking.

## INV-022

Search result phải truy nguyên được nguồn dữ liệu.

## INV-023

Cultural classification không được mặc định là normative superiority.

## INV-024

Historical memory và objective fact phải có metadata khác nhau.

## INV-025

Simulation không được mutate live cultural state.

## INV-026

Archive retrieval phải giữ integrity verification.

## INV-027

Media pipeline không được yêu cầu full-buffer nếu streaming path khả dụng.

## INV-028

Content identity và binary asset identity phải tách biệt.

## INV-029

Creator attribution không tự quyết định legal ownership.

## INV-030

Institution metadata không tự quyết định truthfulness.

## INV-031

Public popularity không được coi là evidence.

## INV-032

Automated classifier output phải giữ model/version metadata.

## INV-033

Moderation decision phải giữ policy reference.

## INV-034

Moderation decision phải hỗ trợ audit.

## INV-035

Appeal không được xóa decision history.

## INV-036

Cultural data phải tuân theo data-governance boundary.

## INV-037

Personal data không được tự động trở thành public archive.

## INV-038

Community-specific metadata không được bị coi là invalid chỉ vì không nằm trong global ontology.

## INV-039

Conflicting cultural interpretations phải có thể coexist.

## INV-040

Provenance chain phải có thể verify.

# 3. HARD BOUNDARIES

## 3.1 Belief ≠ Fact

```text
Belief
    ≠
Fact
```

Một `Belief` chỉ biểu diễn:

- proposition được một chủ thể/chủ thể tập thể chấp nhận;
- mức commitment;
- provenance;
- tradition;
- context;
- confidence nếu có.

Không được tự động biến thành factual truth.

---

## 3.2 Metaphysical Claim ≠ Verified Fact

Runtime có thể biểu diễn:

```text
MetaphysicalClaim
```

nhưng không được tự động thực hiện:

```text
verify_metaphysical_truth()
```

và trả về:

```text
objectively_verified = true
```

---

## 3.3 Religious Tradition ≠ Endorsement

Một tradition được runtime biểu diễn không có nghĩa Axiom:

- ủng hộ;
- phản đối;
- xác nhận;
- bác bỏ.

---

## 3.4 Ethical Framework ≠ Universal Moral Oracle

Một ethical framework có thể tạo:

```text
EthicalAssessment
```

nhưng kết quả phải giữ:

```text
framework
context
premises
rules
uncertainty
alternatives
conflicts
```

Không được tự động biến thành:

```text
universal_moral_truth
```

---

## 3.5 Subjective Experience ≠ External Proof

Ví dụ:

```text
SpiritualExperience
MysticalExperience
ReligiousExperience
```

là trải nghiệm được báo cáo.

Runtime không được suy ra:

```text
experience => supernatural_event_verified
```

- đội tuyển;

- crowd management;
- accessibility;
- safety;
- sustainability;
- sports analytics;
- tourism analytics;
- simulation;

# 74. Core Invariants

## Competition

**I-001**

Ranking phải có scope.

**I-002**

Ranking không phải human-worth ranking.

**I-003**

Rating phải có algorithm version.

**I-004**

Score phải tham chiếu ruleset.

**I-005**

Certified result không được silent mutation.

**I-006**

Correction phải tạo audit trail.

**I-007**

Simulation không tạo live result.

---

## Booking

**I-008**

Availability không đồng nghĩa confirmation.

**I-009**

Capacity không được vượt giới hạn cấu hình.

**I-010**

Reservation state transition phải explicit.

**I-011**

Booking phải idempotent.

**I-012**

Double booking phải bị ngăn bởi transaction semantics.

**I-013**

Refund phải tham chiếu policy.

---

## Ticket

**I-014**

Ticket validation phải có cryptographic/provenance validation khi configured.

**I-015**

Một ticket không thể được sử dụng hai lần nếu rule không cho phép re-entry.

**I-016**

Transfer phải tạo ownership/event trail.

---

## Athlete

**I-017**

Performance metric không phải medical diagnosis.

**I-018**

Health record thuộc AXHEALTH.

**I-019**

AI không được tự biến performance prediction thành clinical decision.

**I-020**

Dangerous training optimization không phải core primitive.

**I-021**

Minor safeguarding phải được kiểm tra khi policy yêu cầu.

---

## Travel

**I-022**

AI recommendation không được override explicit constraints.

**I-023**

Location-sensitive processing phải có declared purpose.

**I-024**

Precise location phải được bảo vệ theo privacy policy.

**I-025**

Simulation không thay đổi live itinerary.

---

## Accessibility

**I-026**

Accessibility constraint không được silent removal.

**I-027**

Accessible route phải mang provenance của route calculation.

---

## Tourism

**I-028**

Visitor-flow model phải versioned.

**I-029**

Carrying capacity phải có source/model.

**I-030**

Simulation result phải phân biệt với observed result.

---

## Safety

**I-031**

Emergency plan phải explicit.

**I-032**

Emergency mode không tự cấp arbitrary authority.

Medical response chuyển tới AXHEALTH.

# 94. Core Invariants

**I-001**

Food data không mặc định là medical data.

**I-002**

Nutrition estimate không phải diagnosis.

**I-003**

AI food prediction không phải verified fact.

**I-004**

Food lot phải giữ traceability khi traceability mode được yêu cầu.

**I-005**

Recall không được silent-delete history.

**I-006**

Quarantined lot không được chuyển sang sale state mà không có release transition.

**I-007**

Inventory quantity không được âm.

**I-008**

Inventory reservation phải atomic.

**I-009**

Expiration prediction không được tự coi là certainty nếu model-based.

**I-010**

Allergen `Unknown` không được biến thành `FreeFrom`.

**I-011**

Recipe substitution phải kiểm tra declared allergen constraints.

**I-012**

Recipe version đã publish không được silent mutation.

**I-013**

Meal nutrition phải ghi rõ serving basis.

**I-014**

Nutrition unit phải dimensional-safe.

**I-015**

Medical diet phải defer AXHEALTH.

**I-016**

Religious dietary semantics phải defer AXBELIEF.

**I-017**

Cultural cuisine semantics phải defer AXCULTURE.

**I-018**

Restaurant hospitality semantics phải defer AXLEISURE.

**I-019**

Payment semantics phải defer AXECON.

**I-020**

Food regulation/legal authority phải defer AXLAW/AXGOV.

**I-021**

Simulation không mutate live food-system state.

**I-022**

Simulation phải có seed/version khi deterministic mode.

**I-023**

AI-generated recipe phải có provenance khi provenance mode bật.

**I-024**

AI recommendation không được tự thay đổi explicit dietary constraints.

**I-025**

Precise household consumption data phải được privacy-controlled.

**I-026**

Allergy-linked data phải được bảo vệ như sensitive health-related information.

**I-027**

Minor food profiles phải hỗ trợ strengthened privacy policy.

**I-028**

Food donation không được bypass safety state.

**I-029**

Cold-chain excursion phải được ghi nhận.

**I-030**

Traceability graph phải support backward trace.

**I-031**

Traceability graph phải support forward trace.

**I-032**

Derived food product phải có transformation provenance.

**I-033**

Farm sensor observation ≠ crop diagnosis.

**I-034**

Yield prediction ≠ observed yield.

**I-035**

Food shortage simulation ≠ actual shortage.

**I-036**

Food security model không tự tạo policy authority.

**I-037**

Sustainability metric không phải universal moral score.

**I-038**

AI model version phải được ghi khi reproducibility yêu cầu.

**I-039**

Offline inventory sync phải có conflict resolution.

**I-040**

Critical inventory mutation phải idempotent.

**I-041**

Food recall phải tạo audit trail.

**I-042**

Food safety release phải explicit.

**I-043**

Waste routing không được bypass hazardous-food constraints.

**I-044**

Supply simulation không được mutate live market state.

**I-045**

Food preference không được tự suy ra religion/health status.

**I-046**

Dietary pattern không được tự suy ra identity.

**I-047**

Consumer preference không phải consent cho arbitrary data collection.

**I-048**

AI food recognition phải biểu diễn uncertainty.

**I-049**

Portion estimation phải biểu diễn uncertainty khi model-based.

**I-050**

No universal "healthy person score" primitive.

```text

      ↓
```

```text
      ↓
Conversion
      ↓
Storage
      ↓
Transmission
      ↓
Distribution
      ↓
Consumption
      ↓
Recovery / Recycling
      ↓
Waste / Residual
      ↓
Environment
```

- deterministic;

```text
ai được dùng năng lượng
```




# 166. Core Invariants

**I-001** Resource quantity luôn có unit.

**I-002** Dimensionally incompatible quantities không thể cộng/trừ.

**I-003** Power và energy là hai type khác nhau.

**I-004** Flow và total quantity là hai semantic type khác nhau.

**I-005** `missing ≠ zero`.

**I-006** `unknown ≠ zero`.

**I-007** Resource transfer phải atomic khi accounting mode yêu cầu.

**I-008** Transfer có idempotency key không được double-count.

**I-009** Inventory không được âm trừ khi explicit negative-stock model.

**I-010** Capacity không được vượt quá configured limit nếu không có overload state.

**I-011** Simulation không mutate live state.

**I-012** Simulation phải có model/version identity.

**I-013** Deterministic simulation phải có reproducible seed/input snapshot.

**I-014** Digital twin không đồng nhất physical reality.

**I-015** Prediction ≠ observation.

**I-016** Estimate ≠ measurement.

**I-017** Anomaly ≠ confirmed failure.

**I-018** Environmental model output không tự trở thành observed fact.

**I-019** Resource allocation không tự tạo policy authority.

**I-020** AI recommendation không tự trở thành physical command.

**I-021** Critical actuation cần explicit capability.

**I-022** Critical command phải audit được.

**I-023** Resource topology phải versioned khi simulation/replay yêu cầu.

**I-024** Historical observation không được silent mutation.

**I-025** Meter reading phải giữ source và timestamp.

**I-026** Water quality result phải giữ measurement method.

**I-027** Environmental threshold phải versioned.

**I-028** Waste routing phải giữ provenance.

**I-029** Recovered material phải giữ lineage.

**I-030** Mass-balance model phải khai báo tolerance.

**I-031** Energy-balance model phải khai báo boundary.

**I-032** Water-balance model phải khai báo boundary.

**I-033** Resource quality không được bỏ qua khi quality constraint tồn tại.

**I-034** Allocation reservation phải atomic.

**I-035** Concurrent capacity allocation không được oversubscribe.

**I-036** Emergency mode không tạo unrestricted authority.

**I-037** Offline mode không được làm mất critical local state.

**I-038** Synchronization phải có conflict policy.

**I-039** Physical rollback không được giả định là khả thi.

**I-040** Simulation rollback chỉ áp dụng simulation state.

**I-041** Financial billing không thuộc resource ledger core.

**I-042** Legal contract không thuộc resource flow core.

**I-043** Government policy không được hard-code vào resource engine.

**I-044** Food semantics thuộc AXFOOD.

**I-045** Medical semantics thuộc AXHEALTH.

**I-046** Transport semantics thuộc AXTRANSPORT.

**I-047** Building semantics thuộc building runtime.

**I-048** Sensor hardware semantics thuộc device runtime.

**I-049** AI output phải có model/version khi provenance mode yêu cầu.

**I-050** No hidden optimization objective.

**I-051** Multi-objective optimization phải expose objective set.

**I-052** Scenario comparison không tự chọn policy.

**I-053** Environmental metric không phải universal moral score.

**I-054** Critical infrastructure data phải được access-controlled.

**I-055** Household resource telemetry có thể nhạy cảm và phải privacy-controlled.

**I-056** Resource events phải hỗ trợ event-time semantics.

**I-057** Time-series aggregation phải phân biệt missing data.

**I-058** Unit conversion phải preserve dimensional semantics.

**I-059** Temperature conversion phải hỗ trợ affine semantics.

**I-060** Resource lineage không được mất khi split/merge.

# 166. Core Invariants

**I-001** Resource quantity luôn có unit.

**I-002** Dimensionally incompatible quantities không thể cộng/trừ.

**I-003** Power và energy là hai type khác nhau.

**I-004** Flow và total quantity là hai semantic type khác nhau.

**I-005** `missing ≠ zero`.

**I-006** `unknown ≠ zero`.

**I-007** Resource transfer phải atomic khi accounting mode yêu cầu.

**I-008** Transfer có idempotency key không được double-count.

**I-009** Inventory không được âm trừ khi explicit negative-stock model.

**I-010** Capacity không được vượt quá configured limit nếu không có overload state.

**I-011** Simulation không mutate live state.

**I-012** Simulation phải có model/version identity.

**I-013** Deterministic simulation phải có reproducible seed/input snapshot.

**I-014** Digital twin không đồng nhất physical reality.

**I-015** Prediction ≠ observation.

**I-016** Estimate ≠ measurement.

**I-017** Anomaly ≠ confirmed failure.

**I-018** Environmental model output không tự trở thành observed fact.

**I-019** Resource allocation không tự tạo policy authority.

**I-020** AI recommendation không tự trở thành physical command.

**I-021** Critical actuation cần explicit capability.

**I-022** Critical command phải audit được.

**I-023** Resource topology phải versioned khi simulation/replay yêu cầu.

**I-024** Historical observation không được silent mutation.

**I-025** Meter reading phải giữ source và timestamp.

**I-026** Water quality result phải giữ measurement method.

**I-027** Environmental threshold phải versioned.

**I-028** Waste routing phải giữ provenance.

**I-029** Recovered material phải giữ lineage.

**I-030** Mass-balance model phải khai báo tolerance.

**I-031** Energy-balance model phải khai báo boundary.

**I-032** Water-balance model phải khai báo boundary.

**I-033** Resource quality không được bỏ qua khi quality constraint tồn tại.

**I-034** Allocation reservation phải atomic.

**I-035** Concurrent capacity allocation không được oversubscribe.

**I-036** Emergency mode không tạo unrestricted authority.

**I-037** Offline mode không được làm mất critical local state.

**I-038** Synchronization phải có conflict policy.

**I-039** Physical rollback không được giả định là khả thi.

**I-040** Simulation rollback chỉ áp dụng simulation state.

**I-041** Financial billing không thuộc resource ledger core.

**I-042** Legal contract không thuộc resource flow core.

**I-043** Government policy không được hard-code vào resource engine.

**I-044** Food semantics thuộc AXFOOD.

**I-045** Medical semantics thuộc AXHEALTH.

**I-046** Transport semantics thuộc AXTRANSPORT.

**I-047** Building semantics thuộc building runtime.

**I-048** Sensor hardware semantics thuộc device runtime.

**I-049** AI output phải có model/version khi provenance mode yêu cầu.

**I-050** No hidden optimization objective.

**I-051** Multi-objective optimization phải expose objective set.

**I-052** Scenario comparison không tự chọn policy.

**I-053** Environmental metric không phải universal moral score.

**I-054** Critical infrastructure data phải được access-controlled.

**I-055** Household resource telemetry có thể nhạy cảm và phải privacy-controlled.

**I-056** Resource events phải hỗ trợ event-time semantics.

**I-057** Time-series aggregation phải phân biệt missing data.

**I-058** Unit conversion phải preserve dimensional semantics.

**I-059** Temperature conversion phải hỗ trợ affine semantics.

**I-060** Resource lineage không được mất khi split/merge.

# 172. Core Invariants

**I-001** Product revision là immutable sau release.

**I-002** BOM graph không được có cycle nếu recursive BOM không được bật.

**I-003** Process revision phải versioned.

**I-004** Production order phải tham chiếu product revision.

**I-005** Execution phải tham chiếu process/routing revision.

**I-006** Material consumption phải tạo traceability record.

**I-007** Finished product phải giữ genealogy khi traceability được bật.

**I-008** Inventory transfer phải atomic.

**I-009** Inventory transfer phải idempotent.

**I-010** Quarantined material không được dùng bởi normal production flow.

**I-011** Machine command phải target machine cụ thể.

**I-012** Robot command phải target robot/cell cụ thể.

**I-013** Physical command ≠ simulation command.

**I-014** AI recommendation ≠ physical command.

**I-015** Prediction ≠ measurement.

**I-016** Quality prediction ≠ quality certification.

**I-017** Defect detection phải giữ evidence.

**I-018** Non-conformance decision phải auditable.

**I-019** Safety constraints không được âm thầm hạ bởi optimizer.

**I-020** Emergency stop không phụ thuộc cloud.

**I-021** Critical machine control phải có explicit capability.

**I-022** Control command phải chống replay theo policy.

**I-023** Autonomous mode phải có operating envelope.

**I-024** Autonomous controller phải có fail-safe behavior.

**I-025** Physical side effects không được giả định rollback được.

**I-026** Logical transaction và physical action phải khác type.

**I-027** Schedule phải giữ objective/constraints.

**I-028** Scheduler không được tạo hidden objective.

**I-029** Simulation không được mutate live production state.

**I-030** Simulation phải giữ model/version.

**I-031** Deterministic simulation phải reproducible.

**I-032** Robot safety zone không được bỏ qua trong validated execution.

**I-033** Machine capability phải được kiểm tra trước dispatch.

**I-034** Material compatibility phải được kiểm tra.

**I-035** Tool compatibility phải được kiểm tra khi process yêu cầu.

**I-036** Production cannot consume unavailable material.

**I-037** Production cannot dispatch to unavailable machine.

**I-038** Maintenance state không được coi là production-ready.

**I-039** Faulted machine không được nhận normal production command.

**I-040** Product release phải dựa trên declared quality workflow.

**I-041** Quality tolerance phải unit-compatible.

**I-042** Measurement phải giữ instrument/source khi required.

**I-043** AI model version phải được lưu khi model ảnh hưởng production decision.

**I-044** Model rollback phải giữ audit trail.

**I-045** Production history không được silent delete.

**I-046** Event replay phải deterministic trong deterministic mode.

**I-047** Topology revision phải được ghi cho simulation.

**I-048** Industrial telemetry phải giữ event-time.

**I-049** Missing telemetry ≠ zero telemetry.

**I-050** Sensor estimate ≠ physical measurement.

**I-051** Operator qualification phải dựa trên explicit record.

**I-052** Machine interaction không tự chứng minh operator qualification.

**I-053** Critical overrides phải ghi actor/reason/scope.

**I-054** Safety rules không được bị AI agent bypass.

**I-055** EmergencyStop không thể bị model optimizer hủy.

**I-057** Edge runtime phải hỗ trợ degraded operation khi configured.

**I-060** Financial cost không phải resource quantity.

**I-099** Industrial control loop phải đáp ứng declared latency budget.

# 172. Core Invariants

**I-001** Product revision là immutable sau release.

**I-002** BOM graph không được có cycle nếu recursive BOM không được bật.

**I-003** Process revision phải versioned.

**I-004** Production order phải tham chiếu product revision.

**I-005** Execution phải tham chiếu process/routing revision.

**I-006** Material consumption phải tạo traceability record.

**I-007** Finished product phải giữ genealogy khi traceability được bật.

**I-008** Inventory transfer phải atomic.

**I-009** Inventory transfer phải idempotent.

**I-010** Quarantined material không được dùng bởi normal production flow.

**I-011** Machine command phải target machine cụ thể.

**I-012** Robot command phải target robot/cell cụ thể.

**I-013** Physical command ≠ simulation command.

**I-014** AI recommendation ≠ physical command.

**I-015** Prediction ≠ measurement.

**I-016** Quality prediction ≠ quality certification.

**I-017** Defect detection phải giữ evidence.

**I-018** Non-conformance decision phải auditable.

**I-019** Safety constraints không được âm thầm hạ bởi optimizer.

**I-020** Emergency stop không phụ thuộc cloud.

**I-021** Critical machine control phải có explicit capability.

**I-022** Control command phải chống replay theo policy.

**I-023** Autonomous mode phải có operating envelope.

**I-024** Autonomous controller phải có fail-safe behavior.

**I-025** Physical side effects không được giả định rollback được.

**I-026** Logical transaction và physical action phải khác type.

**I-027** Schedule phải giữ objective/constraints.

**I-028** Scheduler không được tạo hidden objective.

**I-029** Simulation không được mutate live production state.

**I-030** Simulation phải giữ model/version.

**I-031** Deterministic simulation phải reproducible.

**I-032** Robot safety zone không được bỏ qua trong validated execution.

**I-033** Machine capability phải được kiểm tra trước dispatch.

**I-034** Material compatibility phải được kiểm tra.

**I-035** Tool compatibility phải được kiểm tra khi process yêu cầu.

**I-036** Production cannot consume unavailable material.

**I-037** Production cannot dispatch to unavailable machine.

**I-038** Maintenance state không được coi là production-ready.

**I-039** Faulted machine không được nhận normal production command.

**I-040** Product release phải dựa trên declared quality workflow.

**I-041** Quality tolerance phải unit-compatible.

**I-042** Measurement phải giữ instrument/source khi required.

**I-043** AI model version phải được lưu khi model ảnh hưởng production decision.

**I-044** Model rollback phải giữ audit trail.

# 1. Mục tiêu

`AXTRANSPORT` là native runtime của Axiom cho toàn bộ hệ thống:

- vận tải;
- giao thông;
- logistics;
- mobility;
- phương tiện;
- đội xe;
- đường bộ;
- đường sắt;
- hàng không;
- hàng hải;
- cảng;
- sân bay;
- terminal;
- kho vận;
- tuyến đường;
- mạng lưới giao thông;
- điều phối phương tiện;
- routing;
- fleet management;
- cargo movement;
- passenger movement;
- traffic simulation;
- logistics simulation;
- transportation digital twin;
- autonomous mobility;
- multimodal transportation.

Mục tiêu là cho phép Axiom biểu diễn từ:

```text
Package
→ Shipment
→ Vehicle
→ Route
→ Network
→ Destination
```

đến:

```text

→ Trip
→ Mode
→ Network
→ Vehicle
→ Terminal
→ Region
→ Global Transport Network
```

và:

```text

→ Factory
→ Warehouse
→ Port
→ Ship
→ Port
→ Rail
→ DistributionCenter
→ Truck
→ Building
```

# 1. Mục tiêu

`AXAGRI` là native runtime của Axiom cho hệ thống sản xuất sinh học và lương thực ở quy mô từ:

```text
Field
→ Farm
→ Region
→ Food System
→ Civilization
```

bao gồm:

- nông nghiệp;
- cây trồng;
- đất;
- trang trại;
- chăn nuôi;
- thủy sản;
- lâm nghiệp;
- nhà kính;
- canh tác chính xác;
- tưới tiêu;
- phân bón;
- giống;
- thu hoạch;
- sơ chế;
- bảo quản;
- cold chain boundary;
- thực phẩm;
- food processing boundary;
- food supply;
- food inventory;
- food distribution;
- agricultural logistics;
- ecosystem/agricultural simulation;
- crop modeling;
- livestock modeling;
- fisheries modeling;
- forestry modeling;
- agricultural robotics;
- autonomous farming;
- agricultural digital twin;
- food-system simulation;
- agricultural AI.

Mục tiêu không phải biến Axiom thành một ứng dụng nông nghiệp cụ thể.

Mục tiêu là tạo **native computational substrate** để các ứng dụng đó có thể được xây dựng trực tiếp bằng Axiom.

`AXAGRI` là native runtime của Axiom cho hệ thống sản xuất sinh học và lương thực ở quy mô từ:

# BOOTSTRAP-687
## Native AI Civilization-Scale Finance, Banking, Payments, Accounting, Capital, Insurance, Investment & Monetary Systems Runtime 5.0

**Layer:** Finance / Banking / Payments / Accounting / Capital / Insurance / Investment / Monetary Systems  
**Target:** Axiom 5.0  
**Status:** Architecture Specification

---

# 1. Mục tiêu

`AXFINANCE` là native financial runtime của Axiom, cung cấp nền tảng cho:

- money;
- currency;
- accounts;
- wallets;
- payment instruments;
- payment processing;
- settlement;
- accounting;
- double-entry ledger;
- banking;
- deposits;
- credit;
- loans;
- interest;
- collateral;
- capital;
- treasury;
- investment;
- portfolio;
- securities;
- funds;
- insurance;
- claims;
- premiums;
- reserves;
- risk;
- financial contracts;
- monetary simulation;
- financial AI;
- financial digital twins;
- central-bank-like monetary simulation;
- cross-border finance;
- financial compliance interfaces.

Mục tiêu:

```text
Axiom
    ↓
AXFINANCE
    ↓
Native Financial Infrastructure
```

không cần phụ thuộc vào một financial runtime bên thứ ba đối với core semantics.

---

# 2. Nguyên tắc nền tảng

AXFINANCE phải phân biệt tuyệt đối:

```text
Money
≠ Account
≠ Balance
≠ Payment
≠ Transaction
≠ LedgerEntry
≠ Settlement
≠ Ownership
≠ Revenue
≠ Profit
≠ Asset
≠ Liability
≠ Capital
≠ Investment
≠ InsuranceCoverage
```

```text

```

Forecast:

```text
Forecast
Prediction
Scenario
Simulation
```

---

# 4. Authority Principle

AXFINANCE là authoritative cho:

```text
ledger
accounting
balance
payment state
settlement state
financial contract state
portfolio state
insurance state
```

Nhưng không mặc định authoritative cho:

```text
legal identity
property title
tax law
corporate law
consumer law
physical delivery
manufacturing
commerce order
```

Các domain đó giữ authority riêng.

Sử dụng:

```text
Decimal
FixedDecimal
Rational
IntegerMinorUnit
```

tùy instrument.
